notes.title: Dev Log for May 27th, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

Shortly after our last dev log, we finished up work on and released the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/394690/view/530972773595481109]controller support update[/url] as well as the update to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/394690/view/530972773595481111]TU soundtrack[/url]! Since then we’ve been making progress on the next major update, the Workshop Rental Store, as well as various fixes for UI, Condos, and further Controller Support. There has also been progress on upcoming updates, such as Community Condos!

[h1]Workshop Rental Store / Beta[/h1]
We’ve finished up work on the Workshop Rental Store and are ready to beta test it with you all this week!

Work was completed on traveling to Condos/Maps, the store was expanded with more shelves, we fixed issues where griefing could occur, made changes so that people can’t change what location you go to at the last second, added some sound effects, and added notifications when players are about to group up to travel.

The public beta will likely go up this week to test this out.

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
Work has been ongoing with optimization to the Plaza. We’ve been reducing texture usage, adding more HLODs, optimizing models, and material usage.

[h1]Community Condos[/h1]
Great progress continues to be made on Community Condos!

This week we’ve successfully concluded backend work for Community Condos and have been testing connecting dedicated Condos to our Condo server list. Next up is integrating the changes with the main game, which we plan to do for the Condo Rental Store beta. We plan to have more information about how to host a dedicated Condo during the public beta!

[h1]Cooking[/h1]
Progress is being made on the recipes for cooking! We currently have 92 recipes planned out and plenty more to come. Work was done last week compiling the list of ingredients and outcomes, so now its just a matter of putting more of them together as recipes!

Plenty of the recipes involve fish you can find in the Plaza, and you’ll be able to make lots of different dishes just by using different preparation tools, like blending, grilling, or freezing!

[h1]Condo & New Items[/h1]
Some major fixes were done in Condos, such as the ability to favorite items again. The rental shelves items also got some polish!

We’ve finished new items for the next update which include Cat Café items that will be ready when the Cat Café / Pets update comes out.

Work is also being done on double wide (and thin) variants for the Canvas Elbow and Tube. The tube has been reworked to use two variable sliders instead of one so it’s easier to select which size and division you want.

[h1]Miscellaneous Bug Fixes[/h1]
There’ve also been quite a few fixes to notable bugs and some other changes. These include friends list fixes, a change where the votemap timer now pauses in singleplayer/private matches, further controller support, and bug fixes related to clicking on badges.

You can track all the upcoming changes on our Trello here: [url=https://trello.com/c/56c2GvHb/799-update-1010]https://trello.com/c/56c2GvHb/799-update-1010[/url]

[h1]That’s a Wrap![/h1]
That’s going to do it for this week’s dev log! Be sure to keep an eye out for the next one, and let us know if you’re liking the new bi-weekly format.

notes.title: Controller Support Update (1.0.0.1)
notes.content:
Welcome to our first update post 1.0!

[h1]Controller Support Update![/h1]
In this update, 1.0.0.1, we have made major changes to the game to support controllers, along with adding controller icons that support multiple types of controllers. We currently support Xbox, Playstation, Nintendo, and Steam Deck controller icon sets.

ALL Game Worlds now have full controller support! Minigolf, Accelerate, Ball Race, Zombie Massacre, Virus, Little Crusaders, and SDNL now have full controller support, along with force feedback! Plaza activities such as Casino, Arcade, Bowling, Trivia, and Billiards all have controller support as well now!

Controller force feedback was improved across the game, adding rumble to various aspects of gameplay for all the Game Worlds. In Ball Race, bumpers will rumble like a bumper should, in Minigolf you'll feel the slight taps of the railings and the HIO rocket, and in Little Crusaders you will feel the Dragon's roar!

We added controller support to the menus, so you can enter and play game worlds, browse workshop maps, enter your condo or other condos, customize yourself, buy items, or check your collection book progress all with your controller.

This was a huge undertaking and project! We're still working on controller support for the hot bar/player emotes. We are also working on full compatibility with the Steam Deck and will have more news on that soon!


[h1]Public Betas[/h1]
About two weeks ago, we started our first public beta as a test run to help get feedback on this 1.0.0.1 update. The beta testing went very well and we'll continue to use public betas going forward. 

We’ll have more formal announcements that these are going on in the future now that we’ve done this initial try!

To learn how to participate in the public betas, and to give feedback before an update goes live, check out: https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/tower-unite-public-beta-branches/53183

notes.title: The Tower Unite Soundtrack Has Been Updated!
notes.content:
The Tower Unite Soundtrack has been updated!

[h1]New Songs, Tracks, and Bonus Tracks![/h1]
The soundtrack has been updated with 64 new tracks, including 26 full songs! These include unreleased music from the Arcade, Zombie Massacre, SDNL, Accelerate, Stores, Trivia and other Plaza tracks, and more!

There are also 29 bonus tracks with more short Fishing tracks, Casino tracks, and miscellaneous music from the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/461740/Tower_Unite__Original_Soundtrack

NOTE: If tracks don’t play correctly in the Steam media player, please access them directly in your local files.

[h1]Soundtrack Sampler[/h1]
If you want a taste of the soundtrack, check out our Youtube! We’ve compiled 11 songs into a ~40 minute mix that you can put on while building Condos, racing balls, or whatever you like!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uAQufvBahkU

[h1]Next Game Update[/h1]

notes.title: Dev Log for May 12th, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Welcome to the Tower Unite Dev Log for this week, which will have a new format!

[h1]Current Roadmap[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0a9c151d110aa1949ed061de1ef394c97b5885d3.png[/img]
If you missed it, here is our Post 1.0 Roadmap featuring the major updates to come. Not every update is listed in this graphic, but you can see more detailed development progress on our Trello or Discord!

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]
Tower Unite Version 1.0 was released on April 19th, 2025! We are so appreciative for the response from you all! And thank you for any bug reports, reviews, feedback, and support!

Since the release, we’ve been making progress on the roadmap updates slated for post-1.0. Progress is being made on the various roadmap projects all at once.

[h1]Next Update: Update 1.0.0.1[/h1]
This next update will be a brief interlude before the Workshop Rental Store to fix some bugs, improve controller support, and prepare for future beta tests.

[h1]Controller Support[/h1]
With the release of 1.0, controller support is a feature near and dear to our hearts. This next update includes great improvements for controller support in Plaza and Game Worlds to the benefit of controller and Steam Deck users alike!

Here is an overview of the controller support features that will be added:

[list][*] Game World Controller Support (ALL GAME WORLDS)
[*] Menu Controller Support (Game World Select, Workshop Browser, Character Customization, Collection Book)
[*] Force Feedback (Rumble)
[*] Controller Icons
[*] Scoreboard Controller Support
[*] Settings Controller Support
[*] Plaza Map Controller Support[/list]

[h2]Force Feedback (Rumble)[/h2]
Controller force feedback will be improved across the game, adding rumble to various aspects of gameplay for all the Game Worlds. In Ball Race, bumpers will rumble like a bumper should, in Minigolf you’ll feel the slight taps of the railings and the HIO rocket, and in Little Crusaders you will feel the Dragon’s roar!

[h2]Controller Icons[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a44f2ba8a73e48d3b66d3c4cb6f4ae71c5fcf5c6.jpg[/img]
With this update, we’ll also be adding controller icons that support multiple types of controllers. It will support Xbox, Playstation, Nintendo, and Steam Deck controller icon sets.

[h2]Menu Controller Support[/h2]
We’re also adding controller support to the majority of the menus, so you can enter and play game worlds, browse workshop maps, enter your Condo or other Condos, customize yourself, or check your collection book progress all with your controller.

This has been a huge undertaking and project! We’re still working on controller support, so some of the various aspects of the game such as the hot bar are still lacking full controller support. Support for those are still being developed, as they require more work than other parts of the game.

We are also working towards full compatibility with the Steam Deck and will have more news on that soon!

We will continue to add more controller support to the game in each upcoming update!

[h1]Public Betas[/h1]
About a week and a half ago, we started our first public beta as a test run to help get feedback on the 1.0.0.1 update. The beta testing went very well and we’ll continue to use public betas going forward.

We’ll have more formal announcements that these are going on in the future now that we’ve done this initial try!

To learn how to participate in the public betas, and to give feedback before an update goes live, check out: [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/tower-unite-public-beta-branches/53183]Tower Unite Public Beta Branches![/url]

[h1]Workshop Condo Rental Store[/h1]
The Workshop Rental Store grand opening is just around the corner! This will be our next Major update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/421029ec7b79315c4c795e37224bbd54136d4e16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/452bb9dd43adbe985a91246fa47ff22527bad75d.png[/img]

A new expansion to the Condo Hub, the Workshop Rental Store displays both popular and recently released Workshop maps made by the community, allowing players to quickly grab them off the shelves and transport players to the map for easy browsing.

We are currently putting the final touches and will provide an open beta, so stay tuned and feel free to join in our open beta when announced.

[h1]Pets![/h1]
We’ve also been working on the new Condo pet system! We’ve made great progress on the pets, as they now have traits such as love and energy, and commands such as sit, follow, eating/drinking, and sleeping.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/30c111b0c5dfe7bca8bd9148e25685f6ded36964.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/69c94ee34e61949496a6c3fce5bdc35dc37fd3d6.jpg[/img]

We’ll have more information on the big pet update that comes out after the Rental Store update!

[h1]Community Condos[/h1]
Community Condos are dedicated user-hosted Condos. Since the 1.0 release, we’ve made great progress on the backend changes needed for the server browser required for Community Condos in the game. Work will continue to be done on this feature.

[h1]Surprise Planet Panic Updates?[/h1]
If you [url=https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap]follow our Trello[/url], you may have noticed work has resumed on a Game World, Planet Panic! Planet Panic was one of our earliest game worlds, but we had complaints about the gameplay design and the vehicle networking. The game simply wasn’t up to our standards. Since then, Planet Panic has been in development hell, constantly getting pushed aside due to lack of interest both by our community polls and developers. But all hope is not lost…

We’ve recently discussed some new exciting designs for the gameplay, got some inspiration, and now have developed fully working UFOs with network prediction! With the new gameplay, we hope to add more fun and challenge to the original concept while keeping the cute style.

Progress is also being made on reworking some of the old maps as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3286026382abf7d5eec8c0d905efb33f67aeb81d.png[/img]

[h1]That’s a Wrap![/h1]
That’s going to do it for this week’s dev log! Be sure to keep an eye out for the next one. We’ll be changing from our weekly schedule to a more biweekly announcement with more information than our old dev logs.

notes.title: Leaving Early Access - Tower Unite Version 1.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sYHVD-wrs_8;full][/previewyoutube]
Alright everyone, its time! We’ve been preparing for this moment for years, and with this update we’re sealing the deal:

[h1]Tower Unite is out of Early Access!!![/h1]
The dream of Tower has been part of some of our team’s lives for almost 20 years now, starting as our lead developer Mac’s highschool daydream in 2006. Now, it’s been 9 years with Tower Unite!

Time really does fly, doesn’t it?

Inspired by our love of theme parks, arcades, resorts, and a metric ton of love for gaming, we’ve been creating a loving place that has endless entertainment and fun, and we’re so happy to give it a big welcome in its 1.0 state!

Our wish was to make a jam-packed game that offers you the world and delivers it as best as it can – a place where friends can hop on and chill, play all sorts of games, and express yourselves in your own digital home.

We have been so humbled by the support we’ve been given. Early access has been an absolute gift, and you all gave us the opportunity to make Tower with our small team and work on the game at our own pace, adding the features we all wanted. It’s been a dream come true. The support from our committed community has been overwhelming, and we are so proud of how much Tower has grown.

With all of the work we’ve done on the game over the years, we feel Tower is ready and doesn’t belong in Early Access any longer.

[b]This does not mean we are done![/b]

Tower development is [b]NOT over[/b]. We have games to make, promises we are determined to keep, and we will never stop coming up with new games and ideas for Tower Unite! And, of course, we want to do our best to deliver polish and improvements. This game is our passion.

So, while we’re saying goodbye to Early Access, we want to give you all some info about how future updates will work and are happy to announce our first roadmap for post 1.0!

[h1]How Will Updates Work Post 1.0?[/h1]
If you’ve been following Tower’s journey, you’ve been beta testing the game with us with every update and providing feedback. Since we are leaving early access, we’ll be releasing future major updates on a public beta branch before they get launched into the main game.

This way players can continue to provide feedback on new features and test them before the general public.

In terms of communication updates, we’ll still be continuing our developer blogs; We’ll still be active on the forums and our Discord, and we’ll still be using Trello for updates. We’re committed to being transparent with Tower’s development, even after Early Access!

[h1]Bug Fixes Post 1.0[/h1]
No developer wants bugs or issues with their game, and we are no different. We want Tower to work as best as it can, and are always going to figure out ways to improve performance, solve issues, and make the game an enjoyable experience for all players.

If you encounter a bug or other issue with the game, we continue to encourage you to let us know on our forums. Tower Unite has a large scope and a small team, so we are always grateful to players for letting us know issues when they arise, or giving us more information on known issues.

We’ll continue to deliver hot fixes and plenty of bug fixes and optimizations in every update.

[h1]Post 1.0 Roadmap[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0a9c151d110aa1949ed061de1ef394c97b5885d3.png[/img]

[h1]Workshop Rental Store[/h1]
A new expansion to the Condo Hub, the Workshop Rental Store displays both popular and recently released Workshop maps made by the community. This store will allow players to grab a map off the shelves and throw it into a special VHS portal device that will transport players to the map for easy browsing.

This feature is very close to being done, and it just needs some fine tuning. If you’ve followed development, you know this has been in our desired roadmap for quite some time, so we’re excited to get it out to you all.

[h1]Condo Pets & Cafe Miaou[/h1]
We’re working hard on the new pet system, which will be one of the first post-1.0 updates. Pets will have the ability to walk around your Condo, follow you, eat, drink, sleep, and yes, you can pet them! Pets can be named, and you can form a bond with your pet by giving it care and attention.

With pets being added, you’ll need somewhere to adopt them. We’re very excited to finally share our progress on the new Cafe Miaou with all of you! Cafe Miaou will be a new store next to D.I.Y. and will be a place for players to adopt lovable cats to keep in their Condo.

Don’t worry dog lovers; there will also be a dog park in the Plaza, where you can adopt lovable dogs as well!

[h1]Community Condos[/h1]
A much desired feature, Community Condos are dedicated user-hosted Condos. We plan to release Community Condos in stages. The first stage will be allowing players to host a dedicated Condo with their own Condo map and to show them on the new Community Condos server list. The second stage is to add editing support, so approved players can edit the layout of the dedicated Condo and spawn their own items. Community Condos will also have their own save system.

[h1]Cooking[/h1]
Cooking is another project we are wrapping up development on! Plenty of food has been made, and the bulk of the work is now on the programming side.

[h1]Updates Beyond[/h1]
We are fully engaged with developing the updates mentioned above, and we are working our hardest to be able to continue with future updates beyond these. If things go well, we’ll be able to tackle another game world, future arcade updates, and other various projects that have been in the plans from the start.

[h2]VR Support[/h2]
VR development is one of the ongoing projects planned to be a feature of Tower. Converting a game with the scope of Tower Unite to VR is complicated, so it doesn’t have a planned date for now. However, we’ve been steadily making progress and have made huge strides in its development. We plan to roll out changes to VR throughout the months post 1.0.

[h2]Future Game Worlds[/h2]
Future Game Worlds include Planet Panic, Death Run, and a horror Game World. We’ve mentioned it before, but the horror Game World’s scope has grown, so we’re still in the midst of redesigning it to better fit Tower.

[h2]Future Game World Maps[/h2]
Now that we are in a post-1.0 state, our content developers will have more time to work on maps for existing Game Worlds.

We have plenty of Game World maps still in progress, such as Accelerate: Moon City, Virus: Theme Park, and SDNL: Skyline.

[h2]Other Upcoming Features to Tower[/h2]
Tower will continue to grow, and we plan to expand on existing features, such as releasing new Arcade games and Boardwalk Attractions. New Game World Mutators and Upgrades are also in the works.

[h1]Other Developments[/h1]
Tower Unite has been our sole project for a long time. Throughout development we’ve had many ideas and discussions about future games. We’re happy to say we’ve settled on a project we’re most passionate about! With Tower now in its post-1.0 state, we’re excited to finally announce our next game!

Introducing…

[h2]The Elevator[/h2]
The ultimate sequel to Elevator: Source! We have been eager to share this with all of you.

[b]The Elevator will be our second standalone game![/b]

The Elevator is a 6+ player multiplayer game with extended gameplay based on Elevator: Source. For those who aren’t familiar, Elevator: Source is a game about taking a mysterious elevator on a journey to places beyond your imagination. We don’t want to give away too much, but some floors you may have to get off the elevator…

We plan to have more elevating information soon in a future announcement!

[h1]Final Thoughts & Early Access Overview[/h1]
Thanks for sticking around to read this, to play the game, and to see Tower Unite grow. We make games because we love them, and gaming has been an important part of each of our lives. Tower is all about spreading that love!

We can’t wait to keep making games with you all along for the ride.

Below is an overview of every year of Early Access development, up to our last update. I’ve highlighted some updates that were significant in scale or were technical accomplishments for us. All of them are included as interesting parts of Tower’s history.

When you look at this overview, keep in mind that it only scratches the surface of bug fixes, back-end work, and other important changes that have gone on throughout development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/bc7cd1fd0711f2429b6a4984c963acf19938c8c6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/49015026818b48ff5ef667e67c3219b61bfbfa26.jpg[/img]


[h1]Dev Hangout[/h1]
In celebration of 1.0, you can join us for a Dev Hangout today at 1PM Pacific Time on Twitch! We’ll be playing Tower and talking to you all about the game.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/pixeltailgames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d4e760057612baaab1cad2d4dfd98452760b24fb.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]THANK YOU[/h1]
Thank you to our backers, early access players, supporters, patrons, and our inspiring community!

Thank you to those of you who submitted your custom maps & condos for our trailer, and thank you to those of you who joined us for trailer shots.

Thank you to everyone who filled out our Road to 1.0 feedback survey, and everyone who submitted bug reports, crash reports, and suggestions throughout the years.

Thank you to everyone who has been on or worked with our team in the past, to those who have given advice during development when we reached out for help, and to everyone who helped us keep pushing forward on this game.

Thank you for talking about the game, creating awesome things with it, and making memories in it, and forming new friendships!

Thank you for playing Tower Unite and being a part of this exciting journey!

We can’t wait for more!

[b]We love you all,
<3 PixelTail Games[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.18.11.1
notes.content:
This update adds 6 new unlockable player sprays, adds ordered NPC dialogue, and fixes various bugs from the latest update.

[h1]New Sprays![/h1]
6 new unlockable player sprays have been added to celebrate springtime!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/078587d26a2cd43738df43ff25d16fcd0efae7d1.png[/img]

[h1]Ordered NPC Dialogue[/h1]
In this update, you can set your NPC dialogue to be ordered, which allows you to create more structured stories with your NPCs (or Dialogue Volumes)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/736712a046f55b902fc748e4865e2f5743d0859b.gif[/img]


[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list][*] Added 3 new Easter Sprays: Spring Rabbit Spray, Sleepy Spring Rabbit Spray, and Baby Bird Rabbit Spray
[*] Added 3 new sprays: "I Paused My Game To Play My Game" Spray, Coloracle Spray, and Target Practice Spray
[*] Condo: Added ordered talking dialogue support to NPC / dialogue volumes. This allows creators to have talking dialogue that is not randomized.
[*] Condo: Added indicator when there's more that the NPC wants to say (ordered mode only)
[*] Updated Plaza map (boardwalk changes, casino exterior changes, changes to the beach and added Dark Voyage)
[*] Collection Book: Overall progress on each game now shows on the game's tab for easier view on overall progress for achievements, milestones, and badges
[*] Added refresh inventory buttons to both appearance menu and hot bar
[*] Minigolf - Nostalgia: Added themed course signs to the middle section, vaporwave section of the map
[*] Minigolf - Nostalgia: Various art improvements in the vaporwave area
[*] Pause Menu - Inventory: Organized the tags so it's not just a list of every single tag in the game
[*] Pause Menu - Inventory: Active selected tag now restores
[*] Updated various condo map icons (some were out of date)
[*] Added Map key prompt to bottom left of Plaza HUD
[*] Added Collection Book key prompts to EXP Bar and Achievement popups
[*] Added more variations to Gem item and improved collision on two existing variants
[*] Updated vending machine images to use the new cans that are part of the game instead of just blank cans
[*] Condo: Canvas URL history now previews the URL so you can actually see what it is before selecting it
[*]Fishing: Increased Rare Item / Treasure Fish spawn rate for Curly Grub bait
[*]Fishing: Increased Rare Fish spawn rate, decreased Common Fish spawn rate, and increased Rate Item Fish spawn rate for Mighty Ball bait
[*] Libretro: Added 3D resolution scale setting, which increases the overall rendering resolution for certain cores. Only works for Mupen 64, Parallel 64, Mednafen PSX, and PPSSPP[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed auto reconnect to Plaza not connecting you to the same region you were on
[*] Plaza: Fixed a memory leak when adding multiple items in any store carts
[*] Plaza: Fixed a bad LOD on the DIY store exterior
[*] Plaza: Fixed the entry doors for various buildings fading out when they shouldn't be
[*] Plaza: Fixed the appearance store's exterior windows having very bad and noticeable LODs
[*] Plaza: Fixed the Bowling exterior having an improper lightmap assignment
[*] Plaza: Fixed railings in the Casino entryway having broken lightmaps
[*] Plaza: Fixed Typing Derby's LODs having poor and noticeable lightmaps
[*] Plaza: Fixed a couple plaza holes near the northern area of the lazy river
[*] Bowling: Fixed pins not always spawning in properly
[*] Casino: Fixed various units earned stats not updating, and fixed double or nothing multiplier stat not updating
[*] Minigolf - Nostalgia: Fixed a missing material in the vaporwave area
[*] Minigolf - Nostalgia: Cleaned up the rolling CD's animations
[*] Minigolf - Nostalgia: Fixed an issue in the final neon area that caused a directional light to turn on and off when players putted into the hole
[*] Fixed missing animations/sounds for Throwable Cake and Hot Bar Gnome
[*] Fixed mouse wheel not working in appearance menus (notably colors, profile backgrounds, sprays)
[*] Fixed payout popups replaying old payouts if you had Hide HUD (F5) enabled
[*] Fixed Cape not fading out properly during certain games (such as Bowling)
[*] Fixed oversized helmets on the Summer and Halloween visitor Knights
[*] Condo: Fixed Elevator Cab items not applying auto-close to other doors
[*] Condo: Fixed an issue where Projector would initialize wrongly on map load, causing it to cast to the wall wrongly
[*] Condo: Fixed various condo tutorial prompts getting cut off by the item editor panel
[*] Libretro: Fixed leaving/quitting game not closing fullscreen[/list]

notes.title: Tower Unite 2025 Anniversary Events! (0.18.11.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/46a0bc099295d31e57d1797e4d3e5af31ee8f8b1.png[/img]
To celebrate Tower Unite's debut to Early Access, we're starting our Anniversary Event celebrations!

Kalleira, wanting to celebrate with everyone, caused mayhem by bringing in all the characters and minigames from all the holiday events. Due to her magic, this event features minigames from Halloween events and Winter Holiday events all at the same time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/9da5e2799d67c7df741036d9d2f8a5d20b394254.png[/img]

You can also earn Anniversary Coins from playing any of the game worlds or minigames in Tower and unlock anniversary themed items, Halloween items, and Winter Holiday items!

[b]This event will last for the entire month of April[/b], so you'll be able to take your time getting coins!

[h1]New Anniversary Items![/h1]
[list][*] Anniversary Store: Rainbow Crab, Logo Cape, Hotbar Gnome, Catsack Storm, Party Crowns (Yellow, Orange, and Purple), Clown Horn, Click-a-Clacker, Throwable Cake Slice, Rolling Balloon Pet
[*] Celebrations: Balloon String, Balloon Arch, Confetti Machine, Paper Lantern Catsack (Traditional)
[*] Tower Threads: Cat Tail, Wolf Tail, Fox Tail, Fox Twin Tails
[*] DIY: Wood-Panelled Elevator Cab, Steel Elevator Cab, Wood-Panelled Elevator Cab (Small), Steel Elevator Cab (Small), Industrial Elevator Cab, and Elevator Freight Door[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1bdc6fe199b95077768c885f356cb681958d8869.png[/img]

[h1]Head to Kalleira near the Plaza fountain![/h1]



[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list][*] Start of Anniversary 2025 events!
[*] Added new Anniversary items!

[*] Adjusted gamepad aim sensitivity. Reduced it overall, making the lower sensitivity setting more viable

notes.title: Sprays & Saves Update! (0.18.10.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/afdca3d4687000957df30902a1c9c86606f31f27.png[/img]

[h1]Player Sprays![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a3da295e0494372c7ddb00667dbfba359eb8b27b.jpg[/img]
We have been working on a selection of different sprays to be used in all areas of Tower Unite! Sprays are artwork you can spray on walls or the floor in the Plaza, Condos, and even Game Worlds. You can use sprays to express in a new way! You can spray by using the G key.

Sprays can be unlocked at the computer customization station in Tower Threads.

[b]There are over 64 unlockable sprays![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/4a1f193e3655b228836120dcef9a639f062b1a9a.png[/img]
Like the profile backgrounds, we have a big batch of sprays for all players to use, as well as a few gift sprays for Supporter Pack 2 owners and a few for Patrons.

Aside from the gift sprays from the Supporter Pack 2 or the Patreon subscription, all sprays will be earnable with Units, Tickets, or event currency (ex. Ghoul Coins). Some require achievements to unlock as well.

Along with the functionality to use sprays, we’ve made a favoriting feature which allows for easy access through a ring menu shortcut (default holding G key).


[h1]Player Outfits![/h1]
You can now save preset outfits to be equipped from the appearance menu! This means you’ll be able to save your accessory and player model combos for easy access in the future. You’ll also be able to save workshop player models in an outfit. The outfit slots are unlimited, so you can go wild with expressing your different personal styles!

Outfits are also saved as small files you can share with other players (found in Tower Unite/Cloud/Outfits). Outfits are saved to Steam Cloud as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0f605a9ad7b1f10a4ea454e5551ef9d278efb375.png[/img]


[h1]Condo Backups[/h1]
Lost or corrupted Condos are a heartbreaking issue, so we wanted to make improvements to the system to provide backups and give further information on how saving works in this update.

Now, every time your Condo is saved, a backup will be saved to a file on your computer. These files will be zipped up to save space on your system. If you have an issue with your Condo and need to revert, this will give you a secure way to access your old saves.

Backups are stored in the game files, under Tower Unite/Backups/Condos. You can restore a backup by using the new Load From File feature in the Condo Save menu.

The backup system works even when Steam Cloud is down!


[h1]Coloring Accessories[/h1]
Accessories are now colorable! You can now color most of the hats, glasses, and other appearance items in the game, with a few exceptions for some seasonal items. This is a thorough coloring system that allows you to color various parts of an appearance item like you would a Condo item! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/29dc8d10a7107a7b3ecd3eff61ca6e401b54d46b.png[/img]


[h1]Accelerate: 150CC![/h1]
There’s a new gamemode for Accelerate: 150CC mode! This mode will pick up the pace of your races and allow for new competition with its own leaderboards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/48e6456c3289bbcb5341d1da010ace0f45bd7729.png[/img]


[h1]Condo: Highrise Changes[/h1]
Highrise had a bit more cleanup work done on it in this update! There were more changes that allowed for colorability, hiding map objects, light toggles, and additional map issues.


[h1]Plaza Auto Reconnect[/h1]
Near the end of each day, we have our Plaza servers restart for maintenance. We now have a system that reconnects players to another Plaza automatically once the Plaza restarts for maintenance, reducing the need for you to have to search and find another Plaza during the maintenance.


[h1]Workshop SDK Improvements and Fixes[/h1]
We've fixed a major issue with Condo IO Movers that affected published SDK maps. Now movers work for SDK maps!

The player model creation SDK now has the ability to preview all the wearables, so you can get a better idea how the offsets will look for all the accessories.

We also added better error handling when uploading workshop player models, specifically around creating the icon for the player model.


[h1]Game World Ports Connection Issues Fixed[/h1]
In the last update, we found an issue that caused Game World Ports not to properly connect players when a game starts. This issue is now resolved!


[h1]Friends List Fixed[/h1]
And lastly, we fixed the friend list not displaying your friend activities in this update.


[b]We fixed lots of major bug fixes in this update, so be sure to check the change log below for more details![/b]


[h1]New Items[/h1]
[list][*] Added new items to Kalarry's: Storage Tank, Processing Tank, Oversized Gelatin, Explorer Cot, Explorer Tent, Dino Nest, Catzek Statuette
[*] Added new items to Vendy: Splurge Aesthetic Drink
[*] Added new items to Fresh: Bottle of Maple Syrup, Bottle of Honey, Kitchen Jars, Kitchen Cake Display
[*] Added new items to Rob's Imports: Payphone, Phone Booth (City) and (Royal), Rotary Phone, Push-Tone Phone, Wall Phone
[*] Added new items to Oasis: Tiki Dock Lamp
[*] Added new items to Seasons: Garden Gnome[/list]

[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
[list][*] Added savable player outfits! Now you can save your player model and accessories combinations and colors
[*] Added new customizable - player sprays! Sprays can be unlocked at the computer customization station in Tower Threads. You can spray on most surfaces with the key bind G. If you hold G down, you can also select from favorite sprays. You can favorite sprays by going to the Appearance > Profile > Sprays and click on the star on the spray you'd like to favorite (you can favorite as many as you'd like)
[*] Added coloring wearable support! You can now color your hats, glasses, and more!
[*] Created a bunch of achievements icons that were missing from newly added achievements[/list]

[b]Plaza Changes[/b]
[list][*] Plaza: Added auto reconnect to another Plaza if you are in a Plaza during its automatic maintenance restart
[*] Boardwalk: Milk Jug Toss now automatically ends after 8 seconds after the second ball is thrown
[*] Plaza: Added confirmation prompt when closing a store if you have items currently in the cart
[*] Added Casino tutorial
[*] Bingo: Added better feedback for when you get a bad blackout (now tells you which number you got wrong)[/list]

[b]Game World Changes[/b]
[list][*] Accelerate: Added 150CC mode. This gametype speeds up the kart speeds and has its own leaderboards
[*] Accelerate: Restored boost speed to 75mph (original boost speed)
[*] ZM: Bosses now take less damage from melee and orbital lasers
[*] ZM: Player class (survivor, etc.) now show up better on name tags
[*] Virus: Reduced fire rate of Plasma Autorifle
[*] Virus: Increased damage of Plasma Autorifle
[*] Virus: Added "patient zero" tag on scoreboard so you know who was the first infected
[*] Virus: Added "survived for" progress bars to scoreboard[/list]

[b]Condo Changes[/b]
[list][*] Condo: Added Condo backup system that backs up your Condo to your local disk instead of just Steam Cloud. This backup system will always save your Condo data even if Steam Cloud goes down. Backups are stored in Tower Unite's install folder Tower Unite/Backups/Condos/. Backups are made each time your Condo is saved by the game. Backup system is enabled by default but can be disabled in Settings > Game/HUD > Condos
[*] Condo: Added Load From File and Save To File to the condo saves menu so you can make your own condo save files and load backups or your own condo files without the need of using Steam Cloud
[*] Condo - Highrise: Lights in the Pool room are now customisable
[*] Condo - Highrise: All metal railings are toggleable
[*] Condo - Highrise: Wood panelling around the building is toggleable
[*] Condo - Highrise: Rafters, some columns, and an upstairs wall are now customisable
[*] Condo - Highrise: Added a missing wall in the main atrium room
[*] Condo - Highrise: Lights in the hidden area are now toggleable and react to light settings
[*] Condo: Art pass on Wood Door item (renamed to Victorian Wooden Door), now has 3 variants
[*] Added Condo tutorial tooltips (togglable)
[*] Added canvas URL history (saves the last 50 used canvas URLs for easy reuse)
[*] Updated workshop subscribe error messages with descriptions of the error instead of just the error code
[*] Items: Added Splurge to the Soda Vending Machine item
[*] Items: Updated Hammock to have coloring options and ability to hide stands (so you can easily "hang" it between trees)[/list]

[b]Workshop SDK Changes[/b]
[list][*] Workshop SDK: Added the ability to preview workshop wearable offsets with any wearable item
[*] Workshop SDK: Moved preview wearable button up to prevent accidentally clicking on reset instead of preview
[*] Workshop SDK: Added image requirement details when uploading workshop avatars
[*] Workshop SDK: Before uploading, the workshop avatar uploader will check the file size of the avatar image to see if its too large
[*] Workshop SDK: When failing to upload, the workshop upload popup will no longer close completely and remove all of the name/description of the model you are trying to upload[/list]

[b]Misc Changes[/b]
[list][*] Libretro: Added NeoCD core support
[*] Chat messages that are over the limit no longer clear from the chat box (on send) and now properly error
[*] Hot Bar: Moved edit option on items to the left of de-quip
[*] Inventory: Added Sweet Tooth props to Drink/Food inventory category and added Fireworks to Games category[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list][*] Optimized players and reduced tick rates[/list]



[h1]Major Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed Game World ports not traveling players to the host properly
[*] Fixed movers not working in published SDK maps
[*] Fixed friends status on main menu not always updating
[*] Fixed player models with different scales not being able to use machines or panels due to a desync change
[*] Fixed players in pool tubes flickering

[b]Condo Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Condo IO: Fixed issues where movers don't activate & get locked up after saving and reloading Condo
[*] Condo: Fixed an issue with co-op condo editing when you have both the gizmo and item property menus open and you close one of them, it'll finish editing the item before you are actually done editing the item causing either the properties to not save or the gizmo adjustments to not save

notes.title: Smoother Movement Quality of Life Update! (0.18.9.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d4d1494176625ec27a95431254a0093456175179.png[/img]

This update includes [b]massive[/b] improvements to network prediction for sprinting, walking, ladders, sliding, jumping, vehicle movement, and vehicle boosting.

[h1]Networking & Prediction Improvements[/h1]
Networking has been a longstanding complaint, and it’s a complicated issue that has been a huge challenge in development. Networking affects how you and others experience actions in any online game, such as the visual smoothness of movement, viewing other players playing games, or general connection issues.

This update includes massive improvements to network prediction for sprinting, walking, ladders, sliding, jumping, vehicle movement, and vehicle boosting. This means you will be much less likely to see jerky movements or “rubber banding” while playing or watching others play.

These changes affect different areas all throughout the game, whether you’re in the Game Worlds, Plaza, or Condos. Game Worlds also got an overhaul with their movement such as SDNL sliding, LC dragon jumping, LC knight sprinting, and ZM power ups.

[h1]Accelerate Network Overhauled[/h1]
With the improved networking, Accelerate feels and plays better in multiplayer. This has required us to rework the internals, but now there are no more network desyncs that would disrupt your racing!

Accelerate certainly got some love from the networking fixes, but there were other quality of life changes included in this update as well. We’ve adjusted the lap amounts for each map, improved handling and turning, and changed the speed of certain actions and power ups.

[h1]Ball Race[/h1]
We’ve made improvements to the visual and audio experience of playing Ball Race. Additions include more visual/audio feedback for areas that have boosts, sound effects for more interactions, and  better contrast of colors for boosts and buttons on some maps.

[h1]Plaza[/h1]
We’ve further optimized the Plaza with improvements to LODs, light/shadows, rendering, and item collision. We also fixed a large loading start-up hitch.

[h1]Jetpacks[/h1]
With our networking changes, expect smoother jetpack movement! We’ve also made improvements to the lighting of jetpacks.

[h1]Singapore and AUS Plaza Servers[/h1]
We addressed the connection issues with our APAC and AUS region Plaza servers and they are now back online.

[list][*] Added better network prediction for sprinting, walking, ladders, vehicle boosting
[*] Fixed sprinting being horribly desynced and causing network lag when toggling it (effects Plaza, Condos, and Game Worlds)
[*] Fixed walking being horribly desynced and causing network lag when toggling it (effects Plaza, Condos)
[*] Fixed vehicle boosting being horribly desynced and causing network lag when boosting (effects Plaza, Condos)
[*] Fixed ladders being horribly desynced and causing network lag when using them (effects Plaza, Condos, and Game Worlds)
[*] Fixed jetpacks having lots of desyncs when using them
[*] Fixed network desync when moving around crouched
[*] Fixed network desync when equipping potions
[*] Fixed various pool tube related desyncs
[*] Accelerate: Completely eliminated all network related lag with boosts, powerups, dirt, and walls
[*] SDNL: Fixed sliding being desynced and causing network lag when sliding
[*] LC: Fixed all network desyncs with sprinting as a Knight
[*] LC: Fixed all network desyncs with jumping and flying as a Dragon
[*] ZM: Fixed network desync with using the survivor shield powerup
[*] Added better network prediction for jetpacks
[*] Improved jetpack dynamic lights[/list]

[list][*] Plaza: Art pass on stair steps throughout Plaza area
[*] Condo: Save button has been updated to directly go to the snapshots list
[*] Condo: When resetting your condo, it'll ask you one more time before clearing it
[*] Condo: When loading a snapshot, it'll now ask you to save your current condo as another snapshot before loading the snapshot
[*] Condo: Improved look of snapshot menu
[*] Condo: Added description of what snapshots are to the snapshot menu
[*] Condo: Snapshot date is now shown on the tooltip, so it's easier to find when a snapshot was made from the list
[*] Condo IO: Added video feed support to Camera IO items (connects to TVs) and added "Play" and "Stop" IO inputs to control its movement without having to enter the camera
[*] Condo: Media players now show "Play" when they have a playlist, otherwise it shows Turn On
[*] Condo: Added media player prompt override setting
[*] Trivia: Added new payout for getting a correct answer (single player or multiplayer supported) which will give you 100 units for each correct answer
[*] Workshop SDK: Added "skip updating description" option when uploading workshop player models/items[/list]

[h1]Game World Changes[/h1]
[list][*] Accelerate - Bedzoom: Reduced Laps from 4 to 3
[*] Accelerate - Wishy Washy Waterfall: Reduced Laps from 4 to 3
[*] Accelerate - Pine Valley: Reduced Laps from 4 to 3
[*] Accelerate - Holly Jolly Highway: Reduced Laps from 5 to 3
[*] Accelerate - Sunrise Isles: Reduced Laps from 5 to 3
[*] Accelerate: Improved handling/turning
[*] Accelerate: Added controller DPad turning support
[*] Accelerate: Reduced respawn/fallout respawn delay (2s > 1s) to keep players in the race faster
[*] Accelerate: Reduced speed of Moon Power powerup
[*] Accelerate: Reduced slowdown of water
[*] Accelerate: Adjusted boost priority so that boosting is preferred even when powered up because boosts are faster
[*] Accelerate: Dirt slows you down more
[*] Minigolf: Added voice volume setting to Minigolf scoreboard
[*] Ball Race: Improved customize menu
[*] Ball Race: Booster pads now have sound and visual effects
[*] Ball Race: Boost pipes and boost fans now have visual and audio wind effects
[*] Ball Race: Added various ambient audio effects throughout the maps
[*] Ball Race: Slightly shrunk the kill volumes on the toxic sludge in Woodlands so that slightly touching/getting near the edges is a bit more forgiving
[*] Ball Race: Increased the amount of melons in Oasis's bonus level
[*] Ball Race: Improved button's glow effects to better indicate when a button is turned on.
[*] Ball Race: Added on/off click sound effects when triggering a button
[*] Ball Race: Pop-up blockers now play a sound effect when they spawn and despawn.
[*] Ball Race: GLXY, Khromidro, and Midori's floor tiles now match the location of the booster pads, making it more clear where exactly the boosts are
[*] Ball Race- Paradise: Boost pipes in Paradise now play a "thunk" sucked-into-a-pipe sound effect when entering.
[*] Ball Race - Paradise: Paradise's boost pipes now have a wrong way indicator.
[*] Ball Race - Prism : Changed some of the blocks to have translucent glass in the easy/hard course in Prism so that players can better see what they are doing without having their view obstructed
[*] Ball Race - Midori: Midori's platforms have gotten an art pass
[*] Ball Race - GLXY: Reduced distance to death volumes on most levels
[*] Ball Race - GLXY: Added more melons to Bonus Level
[*] Ball Race - Midori: Added more melons to Bonus Level[/list]

[*] Plaza: Various LOD improvements throughout the Plaza
[*] Plaza: Reduced collision complexity of hanging signs in stores area
[*] Plaza: Vastly improved the way the monorail bridge is rendered for improved performance
[*] Plaza: Optimized and re-did the way the lazy river is rendered for performance
[*] Plaza: Removed an unnecessary shadow-casting spotlight from the boardwalk that was causing a 2ms FPS drop when in the area
[*] Plaza: Optimized store creation by a huge amount, which will help reduce the initial load in freeze
[*] ZM - Escape: Optimized Suburbs[/list]

[list][*] Fixed high quality shaders setting not applying
[*] Fixed rich presence not setting to main menu when you return to the main menu
[*] Fixed jetpack not turning off when you de-quip it while using it
[*] Fixed underwater effect happening in third person

[*] Accelerate: Fixed turning speed adjustments desyncing players
[*] Accelerate: Fixed respawn boost netlag
[*] Accelerate: Fixed drift boost net lag delay
[*] Accelerate: Fixed starting race boost having network delay
[*] Accelerate: Fixed dragon animations always turning left/right wrongly
[*] Accelerate: Fixed drift angle not networking to other players (players drifting would appear not drifting at the correct angle or at all)
[*] Accelerate: Fixed item cards not clearing after respawning, causing item cards that appear usable but are not
[*] Accelerate: Fixed Flux powerup sound/effects playing twice/at a delay for clients
[*] Accelerate: Fixed Moon Power powerup sound/effects playing twice/at a delay for clients
[*] SDNL - Container Ship: Fixed various visual issues
[*] SDNL - Decommission: Fixed glowing ceiling lamps
[*] SDNL - Frostbite: Fixed glowing floor lights

[*] LC: Fixed issues where players sometimes do not spawn in

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for March 10th, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

[h2]March 2025 Condo Contest - 80s[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/594ecc86739c4392fb227c71dd050c60dfa43add.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

The theme of this month’s contest is The 80s!

So, base your condo around 1980s culture and style, capture the feeling of life in the 80s, or make a general homage to something from that time period!

[i]Your submission can be a regular Condo or a Workshop Game World Map. The submission should be something that was made after the contest was announced.[/i]

The submission period ends on March 20th, 2024 at 11:59 PM CT.

Be sure to look at the prizes and follow the rules found on the forum post below!

[url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/march-2025-condo-contest-80s/52827]March 2025 Condo Contest - PixelTail Games Forums[/url]

[h2]Upcoming New Items[/h2]

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] continued working on a bunch of new items, including even more food and cooking related items.

[h3]Upcoming New Items: Cooking Items[/h3]

Honey and Maple Syrup Bottle, Frosted Cookie, Creme Sandwich Cookie, Oatmeal Cookie, and Gelatin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/80b9a019e530c80d1f820e1e3d6574f064329fce.png[/img]

[h2]Condo Rental Store[/h2]

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on the Condo Rental Store that we've mentioned in the past, where you can see and explore popular and new Workshop condos via the Condo Lobby. Last week, he worked on adding Game World Map support to the store.

[h3]Condo Rental Store WIP[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/452bb9dd43adbe985a91246fa47ff22527bad75d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/421029ec7b79315c4c795e37224bbd54136d4e16.png[/img]

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]

[b]Johanna[/b] worked on various polishing passes on Ball Race, getting it ready for 1.0.

[b]Lifeless[/b] continued working on the Condo tutorial.

[b]macdguy[/b] finished fixing various networking desyncs across the entire game, such as Sprinting, Crouching, Jetpack, Potions, sliding in SDNL, Knight Sprinting and Dragon Jumping in LC, among others. He also fixed lots of desyncs in Accelerate regarding boosting, powerups, and speed adjustments, making Accelerate way more playable for those who are not the host. These changes affect the entire game and lead to way better networking feel throughout the game.

[b]wheezwer[/b] finished the art contest, started a new condo contest, and continued working on the Player Sprays.

[h2]That’s a Wrap![/h2]
Thank you for reading and we’ll see you all next week for more!

notes.title: Escape Update (0.18.8.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/336a08249f0f25e5de1efbb70f8163ed8f7e7e99.png[/img]

[h1]Zombie Massacre: Escape[/h1]
This update includes the new Zombie Massacre map, Escape! Make your way to safety across 6 different locations as the horde comes after you. This is the first ZM map with alternate locations outside of the boss arena! It also is the first to incorporate sub-objectives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8c25eddd2b4bc4a1c6568ab898352dbb06a881a1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/44414553191ab44342dfd9221e234acfb076a6f3.jpg[/img]


[h1]Plaza: Arcade and Bowling[/h1]
Arcade physics have gotten some love in this update! The change improves the throwing responsiveness for Avalanche, Milk Jug Toss, Little Birde Feeders, Ring God, The Offering, Ice Cave, and Roll & Race.

Also, Pluck-a-Pal’s capsules have returned to help prevent prizes from getting stuck!

For bowling, thanks to your feedback and our testing, we’ve made even more major fixes to reduce desync issues and improve physics overall. We also did a sound pass and small art improvements to the bowling alley!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e8e2b49fc397b16823af0e1f8265d0b358d7fff4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Graphics Profiles[/h1]
We’ve implemented graphics profiles to quickly adjust your game graphics using our recommended graphic defaults. We also made versions of this for Steam Deck and VR.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c05b3e57544888fc0621e4a87be6fd286fb422f4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Condo I/O Networking Improvements[/h1]
We have decreased the amount of bandwidth required to load in a new player substantially, which will improve networking with other players while using Condo I/O.

[h1]New Store: Kalarry’s Wares[/h1]
A new store is open in the Plaza! Here you can purchase milestone items (if you have reached the milestone), Game World props, and a few other goodies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f4bc269aefb8b58ffe97f7ef2b1e556b9b930911.jpg[/img]


[h1]New "That New Condo" videos from community members[/h1]
We are filling out our catalog of “That New Condo” Condo previews with help from the TU community! These new previews showcase Courtyard and Resort, along with updated versions of Suite and House.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/20eeb4a2177ef883af993834ccdde9b7ee6a3be8.jpg[/img]


[h1]New Items![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/5a5ea53d9d13cd39045e212e25074a6c4428e107.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b7c327d9a2b192d902ff4083e5ea106bd82cb8b3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/faafa0b8761aab4fe6c68411d245a4e19e67109c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/37504bb13d8f731fde3bf958e751f6928a5a3249.png[/img]


[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list][*] New Zombie Massacre map - Escape!
[*] Added new Kalarry's Wares shop
[*] Added graphics profiles for easier quick settings adjustment and for settings to apply recommend graphic profiles (Low, Medium, High, Ultra, Steam Deck, VR)
[*] Revamped settings UI, fixed up the overall look, colors, and placement on various settings, updated setting descriptions
[*] Separated graphics settings into categories for easier organization of graphics settings
[*] Added inventory item list shortcut to your player profile so you can access a list of your inventory items from the main menu
[*] Revamped inventory item list UI
[*] Players who have blocked each other no longer show up on the player list
[*] Enhanced lots of the hats/wearable models[/list]

[h1]New Items[/h1][list][*] Seasons: Park Bench, Lattice Trash Bin, Gravelly Trash Bin
[*] Rob's Imports: Postbox (Legged), Postbox (Pillar), Pipe Wrench (Weapon), OEM Computer (Monitor, Tower, Keyboard, Mouse, Speakers)
[*] Central Circuit: Electric Stove, Mastobox CRT TV, Trioptitrinix CRT TV, AquaBook, Mel Laptop
[*] Toy Stop: OEM Computer Setup (Libretro)
[*] Fresh: Cooking Utensils, Utensil Rack
[*] Vendy: TU Private Reserve
[*] Tower Threads: Cowboy Hat (Classic), Flower Crown (Classic), Ethereal Flower Crown (Classic), Flower Wristband (Classic), Hula Skirt (Classic)
[*] Oasis: Screamin' Eagle Tube, Dragon Tube (Classic), Flamingo Tube (Classic)
[*] Kalarry's Wares: Turret, Trivia Podium, Old Theater Projector, Spin To Win, Drivable Helicopter, Recharge Station, Bullpup[/list]

[h1]Plaza Changes[/h1][list][*] Plaza: Added the ability to purchase items directly from store displays
[*] Plaza: Updated Jeff's model (no longer uses fuse models)
[*] Plaza: Horizon Condo videos now load from video files
[*] Plaza: New "That New Condo" videos for Resort and Courtyard
[*] Plaza: Added character visit signs
[*] Plaza - Chainsaw Battle: Added better visual / audio feedback to when the acid pit starts in the death arena, and made acid not instantly kill you
[*] New Plaza & Arcade Tutorials
[*] Arcade: Improved physics throw networking, eliminating the large delay when a throwing object is created. This improves throwing responsiveness for Avalanche, Milk Jug Toss, Little Birde Feeders, Ring God, The Offering, Ice Cave, and Roll & Race
[*] Arcade - Little Birde Feeders: Added improved sound effects for Little Birde Feeders and added sound feedback for when the ball has returned
[*] Arcade - Tornado: Bonus position no longer changes during gameplay
[*] Arcade - Pluck-a-pal: Plushies are now back inside capsules, making them easier to get, but also ensures they can be dropped in the prize section without getting stuck if they are a longer plushy[/list]

[h1]Condo Changes[/h1][list][*] Condo - Suite: Redid outer wall, preventing it from clipping inwards and allowing surface editing
[*] Condo - Suite: Alcove sofa can now be edited (color and hiding)
[*] Condo - Suite: Bathtub can now be edited (color and hiding, along with bathtub functionality)
[*] Condo - Suite: Shower curtains are now hideable
[*] Condo - Suite: Adjusted outer boundaries to let you interact and build through them (they still collide with you)
[*] Condo - Suite: You can now hide the rails on the patio
[*] Condo - Suite: Secret room lights now adjust to the light settings
[*] Condo - Suite: You can now hide the beams and ceiling lights in the secret room
[*] Added better fallback material for canvas failure for workshop maps. Reduced brightness of failure for normal condos
[*] Condo - Resort: Alcove Couch and Bathtubs have gotten the same replacements as Suite
[*] Condo - Resort: Replaced residential doors with Map Items
[*] Condo IO: Added "Eject" IO input to all instruments
[*] Condo IO: Added new Screenshake IO item, which will shake player's screen when activated
[*] Condo IO: Added new Day Night Events IO item, which has output events for when the time of day has changed
[*] Condo IO: Added "Toggle" IO input to Particle FX item
[*] Condo IO: Added "Play", "Stop", "Toggle" to Disco Duck item
[*] Improved dynamic lights for all media player items. Now dynamic lights fill the area better, use rectangular shapes, and are more accurate at emitting light[/list]

[h1]Game World Changes[/h1][list]
[*] ZM: Reduced pumpkin head explosion damage
[*] ZM: Reduced health of ghosts
[*] ZM: Reduced gun muzzle flash light amount, made it cast shadow for your own, reduced radius
[*] Accelerate: Improved boosting network desync issues
[*] Accelerate: Added key prompts for drifting and using items
[*] Accelerate: Added camera toggle button (C) which toggles camera positioning (zooms out camera in stages)
[*] Accelerate: Birb Shield shield effect is now blue[/list]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1][list][*] Plaza: Optimized occlusion queries in the plaza by merging objects and props together to reduce the object count that needs to be queried
[*] Plaza: Improved LODs throughout the plaza, and made the plaza less reliant on dithered LODs to reduce triangle counts and overdraw when moving throughout the Plaza
[*] Plaza: Properly set up HLOD system for the electronics store
[*] Plaza: Various render distance optimizations
[*] Condo IO: Massively reduced network overhead with connections, no longer networking various aspects of IO logic to players, only networks to those who are editing IO items now
[*] Condo IO: Reduced CPU cost with persistent connections[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*] Fixed ping being inaccurately displayed
[*] Fixed Discord rich presence not working
[*] Bowling: Fixed bowling ball teleporting backwards/forwards right before hitting the pins due to network desync
[*] Bowling: Fixed additional networking desyncs
[*] Bowling: Fixed pin hit camera taking too long to display due to networking desync
[*] Plaza: Fixed scoreboard not sorting players by ABC
[*] Plaza: Fixed treasure sometimes spawning underneath the ground
[*] Fixed equip button showing up on non-equippable items in stores sometimes
[*] Plaza: Fixed voice chat muting when going into certain areas (ex. the central plaza to outside)
[*] Plaza: Fixed various level loading doorways not streaming in the Plaza properly when exiting interior places (Casino, Arcade, etc.)
[*] Plaza: Fixed Laser Tag not loading in the Plaza properly after a match ended
[*] Plaza: Fixed media players in party beach houses not rendering videos properly
[*] Bingo: Fixed wearables (glasses, etc.) showing up in your view when in mouse mode
[*] Shooting Galleries: Fixed player scores disappearing at the end of the match immediately, now they persist so you can see how many points everyone had
[*] Boardwalk - Roll & Race: Fixed collision issues where the ball would often times fly through the backboard, or through the glass
[*] Arcade - Planetary Piano: Fixed notes not always being hearable
[*] Arcade - Ring God: Fixed ring detection not always working
[*] Fixed speed shoes not re-enabling after leaving a minigame
[*] Fixed first person leg mesh not being created properly when toggling on/off the first person legs mode and also when first starting, which would cause the VR mirror player model to not function, and your own player model not to show up in mirrors until respawning
[*] Fixed head disappearing after playing an Arcade game while in third person if you have first person legs enabled
[*] Plaza: Fixed collision issue with a bridge in the pool area[/list]

[h1]Condo Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*] Condo IO: Fixed security camera / media player persistent connections not showing the screen for clients
[*] Condo IO: Fixed Sphere shape volumes not working when you scale the sphere
[*] Condo: Fixed NPC use prompt being too short
[*] Condo: Fixed editing instruments soft-locking players, now it'll boot out the player in the instrument when it is being edited
[*] Condo: Fixed media URL on physical media showing up as red all the time
[*] Condo: Fixed transformer tool not applying canvas scale properly
[*] Condo - Resort: Fixed some exterior light leaking through the floors of the Suites
[*] Condo - Resort: Fixed that door in the Suites hallway that had a gap[/list]

[h1]Inventory Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*] Fixed being able to drop hot bar items into placeable inventory
[*] Fixed being able to drop placeable items into hot bar inventory
[*] Fixed alt-tabbing while having an item editor open causing the mouse to disappear
[*] Fixed not being able to equip a hot bar item if you swap it with another hot bar item while it is equipped to the hot bar
[*] Fixed Condo IO items not being usable/fading out when dragging them into another Condo IO item slot in the inventory[/list]

[h1]Item Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*] Fixed dynamic media lights not working properly
[*] Fixed Witchbroom passenger seat being rotated and offset
[*] Fixed Witchbroom HUD not showing passenger mode
[*] Fixed LC Ghost milestone flickering for other players
[*] Fixed LC Ghost milestone not having hats or being able to hold weapons[/list]

[h1]Game World Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*] Minigolf: Fixed scoreboard not sorting player scores properly
[*] Accelerate: Fixed coin pickup not resetting for clients
[*] Accelerate: Fixed birb shield not showing up for clients
[*] ZM: Fixed gibs not spawning properly when you explode zombies
[*] Virus: Fixed Gold 9MM Virus milestone not saving/loading properly[/list]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for February 24th, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

[h2]February 2025 Art Contest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/900f8d020f447de780c48bc4821eefe62517a0c5.png[/img]

Its time for another TU art contest!

This art contest’s theme is [b]The Arcade[/b]

So, make something related to the Warp Zone Arcade, its games, and/or prizes!

Entries are allowed until February 26th, 2025 at 11:59PM CT.

You can check out all the rules and prizes available at the link below:
[url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/february-2025-art-contest/52660/1]February 2025 Art Contest - PixelTail Games Forums[/url]

[h2]February 2025 Dev Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/5cd06fcf726a645a3fd01e1dc93e332421169312.png[/img]

Today, we released our dev update for February 2025, going over our next update and plans before our 1.0 release.

[url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/february-2025-dev-update/52760]February 2025 Dev Update[/url]

[h2]Upcoming New Items[/h2]

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] continued working on a bunch of new items, working on an art pass for the Cooking Pots and Pans, as well a some new utensils and utensil racks. He also worked on some new computer items.

[h3]Upcoming New Items: Cooking Items[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/37504bb13d8f731fde3bf958e751f6928a5a3249.png[/img]

[h3]Upcoming New Items: Computers[/h3]

AquaBook Laptop, OEM Computer (available as a full Libretro setup and individual pieces), Mel Laptop

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/5a5ea53d9d13cd39045e212e25074a6c4428e107.png[/img]

notes.title: SDNL Announcer / Bowling Physics Update (0.18.7.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1796f889aed54c09772917d9f29bb83f0373e359.png[/img]


We're super excited to bring you this packed update, which contains the new SDNL Announcer, Bowling Physics Rework, Accelerate Mirror Mode and Coin Paths, finished Arcade Milestones, Billiards fixes, and more!

[h1]SDNL Announcer![/h1]

It's been over a year since we got the SDNL Announcer lines recorded by voice actor [b]Gianni Matragrano[/b], and we're so excited to finally have them in the game! Testing them has been a blast, and we hope you guys have as much fun with them as we did making the announcer come to life.

The announcer has reactions for tons of different scenarios like:
[list][*] Introducing the gametype
[*] Getting a kill
[*] Dying
[*] Environmental Deaths
[*] Getting a special weapon kill
[*] Capture the Flag
[*] And intermission comments[/list]
The new announcer breathes a lot of life and joy into SDNL and helps push the TV theme of Slaughter Day Night Live! So hop on in there and get some frags!


[h1]Bowling Physics Rework!![/h1]

[b]We have redone the networking for Bowling from the ground up![/b] Previously Bowling would have slow-mo physics, or pins freezing in mid-air, etc. It wasn't great. With this rework, we have addressed these issues and Bowling's networking is more reliable and the issues have been drastically reduced. This has been a major bug for a long time, and was highly reported in our feedback survey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3e9aeaa5d9c94a075ac9d2e24f435e6b9f359ef5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Billiards Fixes[/h1]

We have fixed core networking issues with Billiards, fixing the game getting busted on second play and Billiard balls not scoring properly. [b]Billiards should be now be fully playable[/b] in this update, but we still have a few issues to work out with it.


[h1]Accelerate: Unit Routes & Mirror Mode[/h1]

[b]Accelerate Unit Routes[/b] are now active and you can collect units while driving into the Unit marked track sections. Collecting Unit coins gives you a Unit bonus at the end of an Accelerate round, but at the cost of potentially losing your placement in the race if you're not quick about it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ada5cb730b21eb09cf6a5964ccfb99dae596507e.jpg[/img]


We also added [b]Mirror Mode[/b], a game type that mirrors the track, so you can play your favorite tracks in a new way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/778cf1f2d2ebb86aea38eb53bc8a57347020492e.png[/img]


[h1]Arcade Milestone Items Finished![/h1]

We have finished all the [b]Arcade milestone items[/b] in this update. There is:
[list][*] Pluck-a-Pal crane - a new hookshot-like weapon milestone
[*] Ticket Spewer - a gun that fires a stream of tickets
[*] Shooting Gallery Rifle - a rifle taken from the shooting gallery[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/094c46bc1a7906592de8549f4781bc1422600737.png[/img]

Those of you who have already unlocked these milestone weapons will see these items usable immediately.


[h1]SDNL: Lookout + SDNL: Containership[/h1]

This update includes a new [b]SDNL map, Lookout[/b]! Get a whole new perspective on the verticality-focused Acrophobia map from Zombie Massacre as you fight to the death (and for the ratings) in first person. Watch your footing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/55c0b46c9f0682c39d6cf3dc0b1bf05eb13c58dd.jpg[/img]

We also took in feedback on [b]Containership[/b] and [b]reworked the layout[/b] in various ways to help improve gameplay, movement flow, and visibility, with a focus on the central area of the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/9a12a7568c367c517344f161ca79cd4e746a1548.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Condo Items[/h1]

A small batch of new items such as Watermelon, Cheese Wheel, Heavy-Duty Shelf, Milk Crate, and Metal Signs (Traffic, Road Condition, Informational, etc.) have been released. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/05cd9811f19d88f14fe273e2500abe7cdccf1764.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2d8ed0793d726d988798ff3d2666b1fe5a691daf.png[/img]


[b]Changes[/b][list][*] SDNL: Announcer!
[*] Bowling Physics Rework
[*] New SDNL Map: Lookout
[*] SDNL - Containership: Edited the layout of the map for improved gameplay flow
[*] SDNL: Reduced round time from 5 minutes to 3 minutes
[*] Accelerate: Unit coin routes now have coins! These coins give a unit bonus at the end of the race
[*] Accelerate: Added mirror mode
[*] Arcade: Finished Pluck-a-pal Crane Milestone weapon
[*] Arcade: Finished Ticket Gun Milestone weapon
[*] Arcade: Finished Shooting Gallery Milestone weapon (replaces Lonely Gun Bullet)
[*] Condo: Further reduced cooldown on Service Bell item (allowing quicker spamming)
[*] Condo: Item finder now locks inventory open when you first open it by clicking on the button
[*] Condo: Reduced grittiness on Vintage Filing Cabinet, Clawfoot Bathtub (clean), Basic Laundry Machines, and Utility Cabinet items
[*] Updated various store NPC models
[*] Improved look of payout history
[*] Condo: If ceiling fans or industrial fan is force is set to 0, it'll no longer waste CPU cycles[/list]

[b]New Items[/b][list][*] Fresh: Cheese Wheel (+ Physics), Watermelon (+ Destructible), Cucumber, Lettuce
[*] Rob's Imports: Milk Crate, Heavy-Duty Shelf, Metal Signs (Traffic, Road Condition, Informational, Blank, Text, Basic)[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list][*] Fixed Game Ports missing matchmaking screens and stores
[*] Fixed Game Ports active server panels not updating properly after optimization
[*] Fixed Return to Plaza / Plaza Quick Join from the Game Ports or Condo Hub not always connecting you to a proper Plaza
[*] Billiards: Resolved issues with every other game breaking
[*] Billiards: Fixed pocket events and scratch events not happening due to network changes
[*] Fixed workshop sound emitters always playing when a player joins if the sound emitter was activated with IO
[*] Arcade - Pluck-a-Pal: Disabled crane collision with the prize glass wall to help with collision issues
[*] SDNL: Fixed killcam not working for dinosaurs in Dino Battle
[*] SDNL: Fixed weapon shadows showing up at all times even if the weapon was holstered
[*] Condo: Fixed dragging bottom HUD staying on after closing the inventory
[*] Fixed Fairy Pet glow being missing
[*] Fixed Plasma Bowling Ball being way too bright, and improved Gold and Fire Bowling Balls lights
[*] Libretro: Fixed keyboard mode not working
[*] Libretro: Fixed cores not always downloading properly
[*] Condo: Fixed crash with typewriter IO input
[*] Condo: Fixed collision on Chrome Trash Can
[*] Condo: Added variants to Glowing Gem item
[*] Condo: Added Neon material to Canvas Materials
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1eefde06f4c36c1770ca41af50880ee112b60e61.png[/img]

[b]Join our Discord for development updates and community fun![/b]
[url=https://discord.gg/pixeltail style=button]Join Our Discord[/url]
We love awesome people like you!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for January 28th, 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

[h2]Birb Plush Campaign EXTENDED![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ff3846d65ce1b7061881727bb446875001f115fe.png[/img]

Birb's got it all: the power to stun dragons, an all-you-can-eat arcade game, a statue, the adoration of the people, and, now, a plushie! Bring home Birb and feel great safety if a dragon ever decides to try and start something. Birb has it handled. You just provide the birdseed. (And hugs.)

The campaign will be up for a limited time (6 more days), so check out the store page to see how it all works and get one for yourself! These limited time plushies go directly towards supporting our developers and the development of Tower Unite!

We hope you enjoy the Birb plushie! Any support you give us means so much, and we hope to keep bringing you more fun in the future!

Get yours at [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/birb-plushie]https://www.makeship.com/products/birb-plushie[/url]

[h2]Winter 2024-25 Condo Contest WINNERS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1d977ea1d811ffc13968422f43d855a269e768d2.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.18.6.1
notes.content:
This update addresses several issues.

[b]Changes[/b][list][*] Improved main menu loading time
[*] Inventory Hot Bar: Added right click > Equip and right click > Dequip

[*] Fixed additional hat offsets
[*] Fixed some issues with player idle animations
[*] Fixed Toy Robot not moving around properly
[*] Fixed player model slippers not being colorable in some cases
[*] Fixed Ceramic Table Lamp's body not being colorable
[*] Inventory Hot Bar: Fixed sell option showing up on non-sellable items

[*] Plaza: Fixed Daisy floating

Currently the Game World Ports do not have their matchmaking panels. You can join games through the Plaza or start them through the main menu for the time being.
