notes.title: Shooting Gallery Update (0.18.6.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8f3e4710935325b2bdfa70d1e6171dab7db3b1d7.png[/img]

[h1]The Shooting Gallery is here![/h1]
The Arcade Shooting Gallery and the Boardwalk Shooting Gallery are now open!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1923538bb15c3255831b7cc7b7c15f10be3dc73e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/812c3ee1879f31bb5001a1c49dcaa0c72ae1d344.jpg[/img]
A double feature of shooting galleries! 

Blast the evil corns that have taken over the garden in Corn of the Dead, the Arcade shooting gallery! This shooting gallery features multiple targets and 3 rounds.

Grab a rifle and precisely shoot the targets in the classic Western Shootout at the boardwalk! This shooting gallery is more simple and is more about precision than the other one.

Both shooting galleries feature their own achievements and leaderboards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a0f0e421590c08c4d6dc72edd36c622274e289e7.jpg[/img]


[h1]Various Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/h1]
On top of the new shooting galleries, we have been focused on bug fixes and optimizations in this update, tackling bugs that players have reported in our feedback survey for the road to 1.0. There are over 50 bug fixes in this update and several quality of life changes, along with additional optimizations to the Plaza and the game itself.

[h1]New Standard Player Models[/h1]
Previously shown on our dev logs, we have replaced the stock player models with our own custom made ones. These player models have more color customization and various outfits to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/fe18241cc207aa59706233927922e03436381e6b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8aee99f723f144896ab47c4d85d6b83926ae9b3e.jpg[/img]

[h1]New D.I.Y. Interior[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/46bdc016a7dd513b34f86aeb44289935fda42a18.jpg[/img]
D.I.Y.'s store interior was pretty lack-luster and something we didn't feel was up to the same standards of the other stores, so we redid its interior! Wonder what else will take up the real estate that opened up next door...?

[h1]Updated Appearance Editor[/h1]
The appearance editor has a couple of new quality of life improvements such as a search bar and categories, making it easier to find your accessories.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c0ff894c4893c11173674d4cbafc30278d300c60.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/74e93f4ac49833a0be82ee84feb811cd5ef74cc3.png[/img]

[h1]New Items[/h1]
We also added new items, such as new food items, new lamps, vintage items, and some new gardening tools.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2e5f96693cdc38e2dff70bc8f6a47a6a16598927.png[/img]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Arcade: Corn of the Dead Shooting Gallery now open!
[*] Boardwalk: Western Shootout Shooting Gallery now open!
[*] New Standard Player Models
[*] Plaza: New D.I.Y. store interior
[*] Added categories for player profile backgrounds in appearance menu for easier finding
[*] Appearance menu now shows your current wearing accessory on the each tab
[*] Appearance menu now has a search bar for easily finding your accessories
[*] Stores now have a "Wear" button on wearable items for quickly wearing wearable items you have unlocked
[*] Added sub-categories for hats and other wearables in appearance menu
[*] Improved inventory item tags to make it more clear to new players. Added holdable, weapon, and equippable pet tags. Made equippable, wearable, milestone, unlockable tags larger than the other tags as they are more important
[*] Plaza: Condo inventory is now hidden while in Plaza to avoid confusion for new players. You can access your inventory from the pause menu
[*] Plaza: Added item currencies to HUD when you open the hot bar to quickly see your status on Sea Dollars, Anniversary Coins, Ghoul Coins, Holiday Coins, and Gold Catsacks
[*] Plaza: Added info markers for Dark Voyage, Vroomspeed, Bumper Cars, and She
[*] Plaza: Art pass on nature store
[*] Plaza: Art pass on nature store's greenhouse
[*] Plaza: Art pass and optimization on tower's chamfered corners
[*] Plaza: Improved LODs for theater exterior
[/list]

[b]New Items[/b]
[list]
[*] Rob's Imports: Brass Table Lamp, Brass Floor Lamp, Brass Wall Lamp, Fancy Candelabra, Metal Bucket, Rake, Pitchfork, Wheelbarrow, Watering Can, Shovel, Typewriter, Service Bell, Vintage Floodlight (lamp from Catzek)
[*] Central Circuit: Ceramic Table Lamp, Poseable Desk Lamp, Industrial Fluorescent Ceiling Lamp, Industrial Spotlight, Hanging Kitchen Lamp, Metal Shaded Wall Light
[*] Toy Stop: Oversized Chess Piece
[*] Fresh: Rice Bag, Box of Pasta, Egg Carton, Can of Peas, Bread Loaf, Canvas Tin Can
[*] Snackbar: Soft Pretzel (and Holdable)
[/list]

[b]Game World Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Accelerate: Criss Cross Rapids laps reduced from 4 laps to 3
[*] Accelerate: Hallway Raceway laps reduced from 4 laps to 3
[*] Accelerate: Riptide Retreat laps reduced from 5 laps to 3
[*] Accelerate: Criss Cross Rapids, Hallway Raceway, Riptide Retreat are now separated in their own maps, improving load times for those maps
[*] Accelerate: Improved engine sounds to be more dynamic, now will adjust based on the speed of the kart, drifting, airborne
[*] SDNL: Adjusted gun game weapons (mixed some regular weapons with the super weapons) and removed camera from gun game
[*] SDNL: Increased payouts a bit (50>100 units per kill)
[*] ZM: Added new achievement for slaying the TRex boss
[/list]

[b]Libretro Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Libretro: Updated cores to 2025 versions, except for Citra and Stella due to compatibility issues with Tower. Downgraded Flycast to a version that does not crash Tower. Downgraded DOS Box to a version that has input that is compatible with Tower
[*] Libretro: Added support for latest MAME core, labeled as MAME 2025. MAME 2010 is still supported as it has better lightgun support than the mainline MAME core at the moment. You will have to change your machines to use the latest MAME core manually, otherwise it'll still continue to use the 2010 version
[*] Libretro: Added DOSZ, EXE, BAT, ISO, CUE, IMG, IMA file support to DOSBox
[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a common hitch in the game
[*] Plaza: Lots of various optimizations across the Plaza
[*] Optimized chat message system
[*] Optimizations to various game asset loading with a focus on improving load times
[*] Plaza: Translucency thread optimizations in Plaza
[*] Plaza: Numerous optimizations throughout plaza
[*] Plaza: DIY Store optimization
[*] Plaza: Optimization on nature store
[*] Plaza: Optimization on nature store's greenhouse
[*] Plaza: Optimized static mesh data in Toy Store, Arcade, Lighthouse, and Nightclub
[*] Enabled HZB Occlusion
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Plaza: Fixed various milestone weapons not reloading ammo properly after respawning/dying
[*] Plaza: Fixed hidden plushies not being interactable
[*] Plaza: Fixed hidden casino plushy being in the ground
[*] Plaza: Fixed Vroomspeed, Central Fountain, and new Casino Entrance missing location volumes
[*] Plaza: Fixed center fountain stairs not colliding with Ball Race Orb Milestone or physics properly
[*] Plaza: Fixed DIY store showing the wrong items in category view
[*] Plaza: Fixed an open hole in Dark Voyage stairway
[*] Plaza: Fixed collision holes in Vroomspeed, Monorail behind Bowling, Casino, and Tower Threads
[*] Arcade: Fixed issues with throwing games
[*] Arcade: Fixed coin pusher leaderboard screens placed in the reversed locations
[*] Arcade: Fixed pilot hat label
[*] Arcade: Fixed prince hat being missing from display
[*] Arcade: Fixed price of brain slug hat not matching label
[*] Plaza: Updated inventory refresh to help with appearance list not updating when buying new items sometimes
[*] Plaza: Fixed up info marker positions for boardwalk and new D.I.Y.
[*] Boardwalk: Fixed bumper car playtime not incrementing
[*] Boardwalk: Fixed bumper car bumps stats not incrementing
[*] Boardwalk: Fixed milk jug toss stats not incrementing
[*] Fixed scoreboard not updating properly after server traveling
[*] Fixed not being able to block workshop player models
[*] Fixed scoreboard server title and player join permission notice (the friends only tag) not updating properly
[*] Fixed selling appearance items not updating the list
[*] Workshop: Fixed several workshop wearable offsets not applying properly
[/list]

[b]Game World Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Minigolf: Fixed spectating camera oftentimes clipping into the ground or railings when it should not
[*] Accelerate: Fixed Criss Cross Rapids, Hallway Raceway, Riptide Retreat intro cameras and titles not working properly
[*] SDNL: Fixed dino attack making multiple hit noises when a player is dead or is spawn protected
[*] SDNL: Fixed gib chunks colliding with players
[*] SDNL: Fixed pixel death not hiding the player properly
[*] Zombie Massacre: Fixed several issues with pausing in singleplayer
[*] Zombie Massacre: Fixed Arachnophobia boss achievement happening for TRex boss

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.18.5.1
notes.content:
This update fixes several bugs from the last update, along with addressing disconnect issues.

[h1]Addressing Disconnects[/h1]
Last year we pushed a bug fix for issues with billiards, arcade, and other games where game objects would seemingly not spawn. We did this by correcting a race condition we found in Unreal's net driver. Due to the disconnects people are experiencing though we've decided to temporarily remove this fix, as it is possible the issues are related. 

If the disconnects continue, then we'll know it's not related to our net driver changes and we can re-apply the fix. If the disconnect issues stop, then we at least have some idea of where they're likely coming from. 

We appreciate everyone's patience while we get to the bottom of this issue, and will let everyone know as soon as we have a better understanding of what's happening. In the meantime this means that you may experience the previous bugs with billiards, arcade, and so on.

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/birb-plushie][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ff3846d65ce1b7061881727bb446875001f115fe.png[/img][/url]

Birb's got it all: the power to stun dragons, an all-you-can-eat arcade game, a statue, the adoration of the people, and, now, a plushie! Bring home Birb and feel great safety if a dragon ever decides to try and start something. Birb has it handled. You just provide the birdseed. (And hugs.)

The campaign will be up for a limited time (21 days), so check out the store page to see how it all works and get one for yourself! These limited time plushies go directly towards supporting our developers and the development of Tower Unite!

We hope you enjoy the Birb plushie! Any support you give us means so much, and we hope to keep bringing you more fun in the future!

Get yours at [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/birb-plushie]https://www.makeship.com/products/birb-plushie[/url]

The submission period ends on January 22nd, 2025 at 11:59 PM.

Welcome to Dino Drive, where dinosaurs* and golf balls can live together just as they did millions of years ago. Explore a highly themed, outdoors minigolf course before braving the blacklight depths of the monster golf course known as the Extinction Zone.

notes.title: Plaza Update & Winter Update Part 2 (0.18.4.0)
notes.content:
[h1]Plaza Optimizations & Bug Fixes[/h1]
This update is heavy on optimizations and bug fixes with a focus on the Plaza! We've fixed over a hundred Plaza related bugs in this update!


[h1]New Holiday Items![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f5357ad26d3152f1fafc585a889de6988b64c174.png[/img]

Holiday 2024 Items are here! These include new placeable items, pets, and weapons. They also include a variety of new holiday profile backgrounds.

[h1]New Casino Exterior & Entrance[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3fdc840a88798a9c4734f2927e04f3aaef28294b.jpg[/img]
The Casino Exterior and Entrance have gotten some love this update! The entrance has been updated to add a new social area to the Plaza, and make the Casino interior and exterior more consistent with one another.

We’ve also added a fountain area around the back exterior of the Casino which will add yet another area for hanging out in the Plaza, and improve the overall appearance of the Plaza.

With these changes, the Casino has also been greatly optimized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/36d99f3c6579cc86f7a57a35bab35cdc550d8080.jpg[/img]


[h1]Boardwalk Ice Cream Shop Now Open![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/9f41759caafb1bdb62ab90e9a8d385fa9cf6d64a.jpg[/img]
As part of our continued work to finish under construction sections of Plaza, the ice cream shop on the boardwalk is now open! 

This is another cozy area for players to hang out and buy items without entering the Arcade.

[h1]New Fishing Peninsula![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0e7eca2b68c64f60f8d505dc7155c9c7a668a60a.jpg[/img]
The Fishing Peninsula art pass is included in this update! This brings the Peninsula up to the quality of the rest of the Plaza.


[h1]Vroomspeed Is Now Open![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a3eab8825eca0651d915495ec2761d924e3cd0f2.png[/img]

Vroomspeed is open! You can now buy stationary vehicles. There are currently two types of vehicles - Stationary (open the doors and sit inside) & Props (static for decoration). The sedan item has been moved to Vroomspeed from Rob’s Imports.


[h1]New Items![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a39fe7c646d7e9fb49d2032ae3077440fda71e24.png[/img]

On the Road to 1.0, we’ve also been working on adding more basic items to increase the catalogue. These include common household appliances, tools, lights, and more! The full list of new items is below.

[h1]Inventory: Quick Action Toolbar[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/7744329d31d9380e40f66f76e6f6a1dddd7b22e7.png[/img]

New to condo builders is the Quick Action Toolbar, found at the bottom right of your inventory. This handy toolbar has various editing toggles such as showing/hiding volumes and surface editing. It's also the new location for the Item Finder.

tags.feature: Holiday 2024 Items are here! These include new placeable items, pets, and weapons. They also include a variety of new holiday profile backgrounds.

The Casino Exterior and Entrance have gotten some love this update! The entrance has been updated to add a new social area to the Plaza, and make the Casino interior and exterior more consistent with one another.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for December 16th, 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

[h2]Winter 2024-25 Condo Contest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1d977ea1d811ffc13968422f43d855a269e768d2.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

The 2024-25 Winter Condo Contest has started!

As usual, we’re doing a Winter / Festivity theme.

So, your build should be either: winter-related, themed after winter holidays / holiday activities (including New Years), or generally wintry and festive!

The submission period ends on January 22nd, 2025 at 11:59 PM.

[url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/winter-2024-25-condo-contest/52277/1]Click here for details![/url]

[h2]Next Update[/h2]

We're hard at work and very close to completion on our next update, which we're aiming for release this week.

The upcoming Plaza update is heavy on optimizations, bug fixes, and new additions! We’ve fixed over a hundred Plaza related bugs in this update!

It'll also bring with it new Holiday items, and a bunch of highly requested items.

You can read everything slated for this update on [url=https://trello.com/c/EcUpKO57/775-update-01840]our Trello page[/url].

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]

[b]Johanna[/b] worked on wrapping up the changes to the Plaza for the next update.

[b]Lifeless[/b] spent some time working on Accelerate, specifically with issues with rubber-banding when boosting. He also worked on separating the tracks, making them individual maps instead of one map with two different tracks.

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on bug fixes and Plaza changes for the next update. He also setup the Vroomspeed store, and worked on leaderboards, achievements, audio passes, and special Minigolf hazards for the Minigolf map, Dino Drive.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] worked on implementing food items for Cooking. He also continued working on the backlog of requested furinture items, this week working on Vintage Filing Cabinets, a Utility Cabinet, some Booth Sectional pieces, a Wood Four-post Bed, and a Brass Frame Bed.

[b]Sketchman[/b] continued working on optimizations and fixes for the next update, specifically focusing on optimizations with the Lobby Scoreboard, a reduction in hard references (which should help with loading times), and more.

[h3]Upcoming New Furniture Items[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e0285feb2887276ac9bf57c9e1532b81ff209719.png[/img]

[h2]That’s a Wrap![/h2]
Thank you for reading and we’ll see you all next week for more!

notes.title: Winter Holidays Events 2024 Started!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c3dc1db1c03088af4e790019bf26d10e61e0ba51.png[/img]

[h1]WINTER QUESTS AND HOLIDAY EVENTS HAVE STARTED!![/h1]

Winter Holiday Events are here! 

There are three exciting Holiday Quests to participate in! 

Spread holiday joy and help Santa Claws deliver gifts to the hardworking Plaza staff, share the joy of hats, and find the missing reindeer!

Find the quest-givers in the Central Fountain area!

In addition, the usual Holiday cheer has swept through Tower Unite! Enjoy beautiful holiday decorations in the Plaza, earn Holiday Coins from playing games, and deck yourself out with some festive gear at Santa Claws’ store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2f3d7dab381838ef6112b87c811b0c55886542f0.jpg[/img]


[h1]HOLIDAY PLAYER PROFILE BACKGROUNDS[/h1]

We have added 5 new holiday backgrounds to Santa's Workshop. We plan to have more in the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1021af8d875d489d150d052ac55b4034c93da1f5.png[/img]

[h1]MORE HOLIDAY FUN & ITEMS ARE ON THE WAY!!![/h1]

While the events have just started, we're still currently in the middle of a major Plaza update which we're working to get out very soon. The next Plaza update will have new Winter items and should be out within the next week or two.

As we've been saying, we've been working hard on bug fixes, which this new Plaza update addresses. This is all a part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/394690/view/4509884558770962491]Road to 1.0[/url].


[h1]DECEMBER EVENTS CALENDAR[/h1]

Just a reminder, here is the December Calendar for TU! We’ve got some special winter / holiday themed bonus events going on in the next few weeks so be sure to hop on for that if you’re interested!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0ba17176e8b75a84fc88ff6430949784e6128002.png[/img]


[h1]Happy Holidays from the TU Team![/h1]

This isn’t the last of our holiday fun this year, but we did want to wish you all a Happy Holiday season!

We hope you all have a great time in the game and out of it, and we thank you guys for your support this year! It’s meant the world to us! :]

notes.title: Bug Fixes Update (0.18.3.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/42b95f1d310071a499cf791049fc637f30a527cb.png[/img]

Hey everyone! Now that we’ve stated our plans for the “Road to 1.0”, we’re here with a first update to tackle reported bugs!

This update includes over 90 fixes to areas of the game that have had issues pop up in the recent updates, as well as long standing bugs.

[b]Feedback Survey[/b]
Before we get into the fixes, we wanted to mention our Feedback Survey once again!

[url=https://forms.gle/pUMYmGH1xDW19WJdA]Provide Feedback on our Feedback Survey[/url]

We’ve already been getting a ton of responses and have gotten to work on major bugs that have been reported there in addition to ones we already knew about!

If you want to fill out the feedback survey, we seriously appreciate it and it is of great help to us as a small team!

[h1]PLAZA FIXES[/h1]

We’ve tackled bugs and made gameplay tweaks in the Plaza.

These include fixes to [b]Arcade, Casino, Fishing, Minigames, Dark Voyage[/b], and more!

The [b]fishing ponds[/b] should now be functional (excluding the peninsula), and there have been fixes to general gameplay as well.

In the [b]Casino[/b], fixes were made to Aces and they are now calculated properly as high or low in all card games, soft locks were fixed, bingo cards no longer display on the wrong screens, and Silver Saddles now properly returns your bet if you win.

In the [b]Arcade, Coin River, Dragon’s Treasure, Coloracle, Cow Wheel, and Balloon Pop[/b] have all had major fixes, as well as fixes to LODs.

In [b]Dark Voyage[/b], player guns no longer block your view, allowing you to enjoy the game without your friends getting in the way.

Other fixes are detailed in the changelog below!

[h1]GAME WORLD FIXES[/h1]

This update includes many fixes for collision issues and spawn points in Virus: Subway. 

[b]Ball Race, Zombie Massacre, SDNL, and Virus[/b] all had fixes to visual issues, gameplay, and collision, respectively.

There were also fixes and improvements for Sub-Objectives in Zombie Massacre, and SDNL grav glove prediction improvements.

[h1]CONDO FIXES[/h1]

Several fixes have been made for item collision desyncs, visual issues, and other minor map issues in Highrise, Underwater, and Resort Condos! Also, hiding items now saves!

Further changes are detailed below! Again, we greatly appreciate any feedback in our feedback survey, forums, or other comments!

[h1]PLAZA FIXES COMING NEXT[/h1]

We are hard at work on the major Plaza changes which will include the new Casino entrance & outside area, new fishing peninsula, and various fixes and optimizations.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Virus: All weapons now automatically reload when their clip is empty (if they have ammo)
[*] You can now rotate your camera (without rotating yourself) while on the broom stick after pressing right click
[*] Player Profiles: Made friends only status a lot more noticeable. Removed the underline effect and added an icon
[*] Player Profiles: Made location status a lot more visible on bright backgrounds
[*] Added mature condo filter support to Condo Hub
[*] Typing Derby: Added an animation when you fail a word
[*] Condo: Fixed stashed item notifications duplicating multiple times (now it combines all the recent notifications into one)
[*] Arcade: Optimized leaderboards
[*] Casino - Bingo: Added mouse mode toggle (space key), which will keep the camera static on the board and enable mouse input allowing you to select without moving your view
[*] Added circular variant to Mirror Panel item, and support for future shapes
[/list]

[b]New Items[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Thanksgiving 2024 Player Profile Background to Celebrations
[*] Added Basic Garage Door to D.I.Y.
[*] Added Basic Windowed Garage Door to D.I.Y.
[*] Added Glass Garage Door to D.I.Y.
[*] Added Basic Door Frame (Half) (w/ 6 shapes) to D.I.Y.
[*] Added Basic Window Frame (Half) (w/ 6 shapes)  to D.I.Y.
[*] Added Basic Window Frame (w/ 6 shapes) to D.I.Y.
[*] Added Rope Fence (w/ 7 variations) to D.I.Y.
[*] Added Victorian Gate to D.I.Y.
[*] Added Shutter Door to D.I.Y.
[/list]

[b]Plaza Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Arcade: Fixed coin pushers
[*] Arcade: Fixed issues with Coloracle
[*] Arcade: Fixed issues with Cow Wheel
[*] Arcade: Fixed soft lock with Arcade and Boardwalk Games when first playing them (such as Milk Jug Toss leading to not being able to toss the ball)
[*] Arcade: Fixed Prismatic ending too early when there's still balls in the maze
[*] Arcade: Fixed LOD of Wheel of Fire sign
[*] Arcade - Pluck-a-Pal: Fixed sheep plush being too big in Pluck-a-Pal making it impossible to grab
[*] Arcade - Pluck-a-Pal: Fixed collisions with Obnoxious Citrus for Pluck-a-Pal
[*] Boardwalk - Balloon Pop: Fixed balloons not always making a pop sound and also improved the pop sound
[*] Boardwalk - Balloon Pop: Fixed top left balloon popping immediately preventing you from winning the game
[*] Boardwalk - Balloon Pop: Fixed balloons not popping for spectators
[*] Boardwalk - Milk Jug Toss: Added settle delay to ensure the milk jugs have settled before ending the game
[*] Dark Voyage: Fixed guns from other players blocking your view (now they fade out)
[*] Casino - Video Poker: Fixed ace pairs not counting as jacks or better
[*] Casino - Video Poker/Poker: Fixed ace not calculating as low or high properly

notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

[h2]Cosmic Catsack Makeship Plushie! - LAST CALL[/h2]

These limited time plushies go directly towards supporting our developers!

[b]Johanna[/b] continued working on finishing optimizations and art for the Plaza.

[b]macdguy[/b] continued going through long standing bugs in preparation for the 1.0 release. He fixed bugs in SDNL, Minigolf, Bingo, Trivia, the Arcade games in the boardwalk, as well as issues with the first person camera. He also worked on the Shooting Gallery in the Arcade, added a exterior to the Virus map, Hospital, and centered the VR Camera.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] continued working on the Minigolf map, Dino Drive, working on polish and lighting.

[b]Sketchman[/b] worked on optimizations and fixing bugs in preparation for the 1.0 release.

[b]Wheezwer[/b] worked with Makeship and wrote the changelog for the next update.

[h2]That’s a Wrap![/h2]
Thank you for reading and we’ll see you all next week for more!

notes.title: The Road to 1.0!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/32137f2cd4870be87b59c0a430424017b15355d1.png[/img]

[h1]:stars: 1.0 IS ON THE HORIZON![/h1]
It’s been a long time coming, but we’re finally at a point where our next goal is a [b]1.0 release for Tower Unite.[/b]

We’ve been itching to tell you guys about this exciting next step for Tower, and we can’t wait to have you all in the mix of making this dream a reality!


[h1]:stars: WHAT DOES THIS MEAN?![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/43489a567482a29a28127d18f4045f07c59168f6.jpg[/img]
Releasing to 1.0 is going to cover a lot of ground that has been long-awaited!

Updates will be [b]focused on getting the game to a more stable and functional position.[/b]

There will, of course, be [b]map releases and in-progress content updates[/b] coming up, but we mainly want to get the game to a place where we will be proud to call it version 1.0!


[h1]:stars: HOW YOU CAN HELP![/h1]
[url=https://forms.gle/BPkjgzrfRMvZvp9X9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ebbe7da64bb3c8c6f68d7e9aff6eede926153fe3.png[/img][/url]

We’ve set up a feedback survey to get some insights on the game!

You can fill out the survey to whatever extent you like, and feel free to come back and add to your submission later.

[url=https://www.patreon.com/pixeltailgames][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8583f8cf38d7f9833f8f87abc119be8329de66cc.png[/img][/url]

You all have been so great at helping us out this year, and we’re happy to still be around after all this time being carried by you guys.

[b]We’re still struggling financially[/b] and trying to stay afloat as best we can without breaking the team apart. If you want to support us financially while we push to get Tower in great shape, we’d be extremely grateful.

Your support is always appreciated. If you aren’t able to support us financially, please try to get the word out about Tower to friends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2792910/Tower_Unite__Supporter_Pack/

We also have [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/cosmic-catsack-plush]another plush campaign[/url] going on with Makeship, if you want to support that!


[h1]:stars: 1.0 IS NOT THE END![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b66a8521975c5af78c66dec3f358c494f074a72e.jpg[/img]
The 1.0 Release is focused on [b]game stability, performance,[/b] and [b]major bug fixes[/b]. We will be resolving long-standing issues that have been brought up throughout Tower’s existence.

Now that we have a huge percentage of the content that was intended for Tower Unite, we are ready to leave early access.

[b]We will still be providing further updates on Tower after 1.0.[/b] Leaving early access does not mean the game will stop having updates. Tower has always been a passion project and we have plenty of ideas and projects to improve the game. As many know, this game is constantly evolving.


[h1]:stars: WHAT WE’VE BEEN UP TO[/h1]
So far, on the Road to 1.0, [b]we’ve been handling major bugs![/b]

We’ve been already planning for 1.0 before this post, taking care of major bugs such as Workshop, Arcade optimizations, Plaza optimizations, Bowling, and other major areas of the game.

In previous updates, we’ve [b]resolved[/b] major issues with Billiards, Pluck-A-Pal, Little Crusaders, Condo I/O, and a lot more.

Expect to see more major issues resolved, long-standing issues first, then more general fixes and polish.

[h1]:question: DISCONTINUED & DELAYED PROJECTS[/h1]
During this transition, we’ll be re-organizing our Trello. Many features on Trello have been seemingly dormant publicly, but internally they’ve had progress. However, there’s a few projects that we need to discuss.

For the foreseeable future, we are uncertain that we’ll be able to complete the following:

[h2]Mac Support[/h2]
[b]Discontinued because:[/b] the requirements for the platform have changed drastically since we first announced support for this platform. It would be of great cost to us at this time due to hardware and developer costs.

[h2]Linux Client[/h2]
[b]Discontinued because:[/b] Linux client is no longer required thanks to Proton. The Proton port has been very stable. We have a developer who uses Linux daily and they play Tower through Proton exclusively. We are suggesting that Linux users use Proton to enjoy Tower.

[h2]Arcade 2D API[/h2]
[b]Discontinued because:[/b] Before we added Libretro support, we wanted to have our own Arcade 2D API for players to create games with. We ran into many issues and security concerns during its development. Knowing this, we worked on adding Libretro support to provide the same experience without the security concerns.

The below projects are delayed, but not discontinued.
Many are in different stages of development.

[list][*] [b]Game World: Horror Hill[/b] - This game world is still in development for a post 1.0 release. We plan to have more announcements on it in the future. We originally conceived a Game World for this that ended up being too large for Tower, so we are in the middle of redesigning it to better fit Tower.
[*] [b]Game World: Planet Panic[/b] - This game world has had various amounts of redesign. We have put this one on the backburner based on very low community votes and have prioritized other game worlds and projects. We intend to have a demo post 1.0 release.
[*] [b]Condo: Cooking[/b] - Cooking is nearly complete. We have been working on it in the background. We had to change a lot of the crafting code to handle Steam requests better as in the past Steam API’s have been a tad bit unreliable. This will be included in a post 1.0 update.
[*] [b]Condo: Condo Pets[/b] - This will be included in a post 1.0 update.
[*] [b]Plaza: Ocean Expansion[/b] - We will have more information about this feature post 1.0.
[*] [b]Plaza: Workshop Condo Rental Store[/b] - We have the backend code for this completed and we are just waiting on free development time to complete this feature. It’s a feature we added later on in the stages of Condo Hub and less priority than other features.
[*] [b]Plaza: Dueling[/b] - Due to concerns with Plaza performance and lower ranking on community polls, dueling has been on the back burner. We have been planning on redesigning our original idea and possibly moving the arena map into SDNL.[/list]

We understand that many players are waiting on these features exclusively, and that it is upsetting they aren’t finished yet. We also feel this way. We have been working on getting them moving again and hope to renew them and their designs so they can come out sooner than later.


[h1]:stars: OTHER THINGS TO KNOW![/h1]
Among all the development work we’ll be doing, [b]we’re gonna be doing a lot of clean-up and stuff behind the scenes![/b]

We will be updating our store pages, organizing our Trello, creating a more clear and concise roadmap, re-organizing our priorities, taking in feedback, and listening to your comments and helpful feedback on the surveys.


[h1]:stars: FINAL THOUGHTS & PERSPECTIVE[/h1]
Mac came up with the dream of GMod Tower in 2006 when he was in high school, and it’s been 18 years of work on this passion project. Everyone on the team and who has been on the team in the past has had passion for the game, gaming, or their part in the project.

We just want you guys to know that Tower is supposed to be a dream game. It’s a game we on the team want to play and have wanted to exist. It means a lot to us and is shaped by our experiences and love of gaming in general.

We have always been humbled by how much love and appreciation Tower has gotten and that Tower has found a place in many people’s hearts. Working on Tower for these years has been a dream come true. We’ve all gone through life changing events and formed memories that will last a lifetime thanks to Tower. We are so thankful for a supportive community and for those who have enjoyed Tower and shared with us their memories and happiness.

We just wanted to say thank you again to all of you once again, and for any feedback and support of Tower Unite throughout the years, and we can’t wait to keep working on this project with you all!

We want to discuss the history of Tower’s development in the future, and talk to you guys more informally about it when we have the time.

~ wheezwer
<3 PixelTail Games

notes.title: Halloween 2024! (0.18.2.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/6670ab432d4af266f7e6ff7f0419dede8751c274.png[/img]

[h1]HALLOWEEN 2024 EVENTS ARE HERE![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d9519ae815798fd22fd24b8c12c983173ce14486.png[/img]
Our Halloween events have begun!  Enjoy the Halloween festivities and fun as well as some new items that can be found at the Ghoulcery at the center fountain!

We have plans to dish out more Halloween fun in an upcoming update as well!

[b]Ghoul Coins[/b]

Earn ghoul coins to exchange for Halloween items! You can earn ghoul coins by playing Plaza minigames or Game Worlds, Prehistoric Remains, as well as in the Arcade and through Fishing!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d0be7bcd98b7f603cbee934da0327e43cd4f2402.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/7c4f0e4aa7d6234dfb768a46ab5f5fbd17b60474.png[/img][/url]

[b]Prehistoric Remains[/b]

Collect Prehistoric Remains and put them in the Cauldron. You can earn various items and some of the new items with the remains!



[h1]Cosmic Catsack Plush![/h1]
The Cosmic Catsack Plush Campaign with Makeship has started and will be up for a limited time!🎊 Check out the campaign and order one for yourself here: 

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/cosmic-catsack-plush][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/32a9704bae69f3875e292fad6b80964b49620393.png[/img][/url]
https://www.makeship.com/products/cosmic-catsack-plush



[h1]New Halloween Items[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f226363411a5505d443b98f2006aa9253bc739c2.png[/img]
[b]Ghoulcery Store[/b][list]
[*] Batmask
[*] Carnivorous Plant
[*] Spooky Pipe Organ
[*] Cocoadaemon
[*] Exoplanetary Hatcrab
[*] Hatcrab
[*] Flying Broomstick (Witchy)
[*] Flying Eyeball Pet
[*] Following Sigil
[*] Holdable Ragged Torch
[*] Melted Candle Hat
[*] Necronomicon
[*] Necronomicon (Canvas)
[*] Personal Blood Cloud
[*] Personal Storm Cloud
[*] Swarm of Witches
[*] Throwable Rotten Tomato
[*] Toadstool Cap
[*] Trail of Flames
[*] Plush Hatcrab
[*] Plush Exoplanetary Hatcrab
[*] The Galvanizer SR1031
[*] Player Profile Backgrounds
[*] Pumpkin Background
[*] Bone Background
[*] Cat Background
[*] Princess Cat Background
[*] Ghost Background
[*] Orange Background
[*] Purple Background
[*] Halloween 2024 Background
[/list][b]Celebrations[/b][list]
[*] Throwable Tomato
[*] Holdable Ornate Torch
[*] Holdable Candy Bucket[/list][b]Tower Threads[/b]
[list][*] The Galvanizer[/list][b]Songbirds[/b][list]
[*] Victorian Pipe Organ[/list][b]Fresh[/b][list][*] Pineapple[/list]

[h1]New: Player Profile Backgrounds[/h1]
New ways to customize yourself have been added - profile backgrounds!

These profile backgrounds decorate your scoreboard profile throughout the game. This Halloween, we have exclusive Halloween only profile backgrounds. We plan to add more non-Halloween profile backgrounds in the future!

To equip your profile backgrounds, go to Appearance > Profile > Scoreboard > Background.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/482ca0fccdcd18487ebd5b55d4cbfcdb8f6f711f.png[/img]

[h1]Hot Bar Improvements[/h1]
Hot bar had some improvements with a new feature that allows you to toggle weapons and potions. You can toggle holster your weapon by pressing the corresponding key on the hot bar for your equipped weapons, and you can toggle size potion effects on your potions as well!

[h1]Pluck-A-Pal Rework[/h1]
Pluck-a-Pal was completely redone. The game is now 100% physics driven and the plushies no longer are inside capsules, which brings a more authentic crane game experience. We also fixed many, many bugs with it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1df398d8b96d9c207d45fae2cd3d26dc14553c9f.png[/img]

[h1]Billiards Fixes[/h1]
Billiards now has improved physics for pocketing, and lots of fixes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/02eec3f42d9e81c2f688e00c5d75456fcbc06c77.png[/img]

[h1]Condo: Media Volumes[/h1]
A new Condo builder feature - one that has been requested many times is now available! Media Volume is a new IO Volume that builders can use to automatically toggle on Mediaplayers when players are within the volume. You can set these volumes up by connecting a Mediaplayer to the Media Volume with the Tower Glove.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/302ae4c1b760e67f69c8240318fce0797e4f74b9.png[/img]


[h1]Condo: Mature Only Filter[/h1]
In an effort to provide a safer environment for our players, we have added a Mature Only condo filter feature.

By default, condos that have certain words/tags in their title will be tagged as mature. They will be hidden by default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b83f18ad109276c510db4b253271546d07dc52b9.png[/img]


When enabled, they will have a Mature Tag assigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a4d939a44ff775e1df3bfde7bde4e4d742844327.png[/img]

When you go to host your condo, there's a new tag button to enable the Mature Content tag, which appends "18+" to the condo title.

Please be advised, if you host your Condo with mature content without applying the tag, you may be subject to moderation actions. Please use the mature content tags appropriately. Some keywords that will mark your condo as Mature Only are: 18+, NSFW, 21+, Mature. We also have a built-in list of keywords that will automatically mark your Condo, these keywords will be expanded in further updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/43dae511c2e7847a4c6e4d857b11cf30ed7b5812.png[/img]



[h1]Condo: Remove From Group[/h1]
We’ve added the ability to more easily remove objects from groups! This allows you to remove single items from your group without having to break the entire group apart.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1237824c1aefa16bef2249d9e66ef7b08ef0181e.png[/img]



[b]Changes[/b][list][*] Start of Halloween 2024!
[*] Added Halloween Player Profile Backgrounds
[*] Arcade: Pluck-a-Pal Redo
[*] Weapon items now can be holstered/unholstered by pressing the hot key they reside in
[*] Size Potions now can be toggled by pressing the hot bar key they reside in
[*] You can now leave equipped vehicles with Leave Drivable key bind (default Left CTRL)
[*] Added sound effects when equipping Size Potions (clientside only)
[*] Added new Media Volume to Condo IO. Connect a media player to this volume and it will automatically turn on the media player for players who are within this volume. Players can individually disable this feature in the settings
[*] Condo: Added new space skybox condo materials
[*] Condo/SDK: Added "Remove From Group" to right click item properties, allowing you to remove individual items from a group
[/list]

[b]Plaza Bug Fixes[/b][list][*] Plaza - Billiards: Fixed various major billiards issues such as: balls not spawning, camera getting stuck in the ground / origin, etc.
[*] Plaza - Billiards: Improved pocketing, the balls now properly fall into pockets instead of floating above them or bouncing back on to the table and disappearing
[*] Plaza: Fixed milestone weapons (such as flamethrower) not doing their shoot effects after respawning in Plaza
[*] Plaza: Fixed Toy Store planes not having a wire holding them up
[*] Pluck-a-Pal: Fixed pluck-a-pal dropping item lagging
[*] Pluck-a-Pal: Crane now has physics to it (sways and swings)
[*] Pluck-a-Pal: Improved physics and friction handling
[*] Pluck-a-Pal: Removed the need for plushies to be inside orbs
[*] Pluck-a-Pal: Rework of networking
[*] Pluck-a-Pal: Fixed game not clearing prizes within the prize area sometimes
[*] Pluck-a-Pal: Fixed prizes dropping into prize area then teleporting back
[*] Pluck-a-Pal: Fixed prizes spawning immediately after prize awarded
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2b0b915ea5f41973231ffe61f0d8e25943b9021b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/523be903444bffa62bf6fa753d2ad5b7b85d748f.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.18.1.1
notes.content:
This update addresses several issues such as Arcade, Ball Race and Zombie Massacre custom level issues, static item SDK importing, and several map issues.

[h1]Ball Race Custom Map Fixes[/h1]

In this update, we addressed several de-sync issues with custom maps in Ball Race multiplayer. The changes should resolve the majority of multiplayer related issues for custom maps.

There are still a few known mover de-syncs that are being worked on, but only affect a small number of custom maps.


[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Condos: House - Added IO functionality to windows and glass doors
[*] Ball Race SDK: Added more Game World Event IO outputs for Ball Race - BR OnAllFinished, BR OnAllDied, BR OnBonusPassed, BR OnBonusFailed
[*] ZM: The game now pauses while in singleplayer when you open the pause menu
[/list]

[b]Map Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Accelerate: Pine Valley - Fixed spots where you could leave the track but not be reset
[*] Ball Race: Woodlands - Fixed hole in geometry on Level 10
[*] Condos: Courtyard - Various lighting optimizations
[*] Condos: Smooth Autumn - Fixed spelling mistake in description
[*] Little Crusaders: Knightsend-by-sea - Fixed some visual issues and prevented dragons getting to places they shouldnt
[*] Little Crusaders: Throne Room - Fixed various issues including incorrect collisions and lighting issues
[*] Little Crusaders: Toyroom/Cardboard Castle - Fixed weird collision on building block pieces
[*] Little Crusaders: Toyroom - Adjusted push volumes on triangle camp spot
[*] Little Crusaders: Market - Fixed various holes, visual issues and collision/camping issues
[*] Minigolf: Cove - Fixed issue where you could get knocked out of bounds constantly on Hole 6
[*] Minigolf: Forest - Fixed an issue where you could get stuck on Hole 6
[*] Minigolf: Garden - Fixed OOB issue on Hole 5
[*] SDNL: Frostbite - Fixed various issues including incorrect collisions, missing materials, stretched materials and holes in the world
[*] Virus: Catzek - Fixed potential camping spot and broken spawn that resulted you falling through world
[*] Virus: Corrosion - Fixed spots where the virus could be trapped
[*] Zombie Massacre: Trainyard/Nightyard - Smoothed out getting on top of wooden boards
[*] Condos: House - Fixed weird split of wall between hallway and living room
[*] Condos: House - Fixed gap in driveway
[*] Condos: House - Fixed hole in siding
[*] Condos: House - Fixed basement ceiling material stretch
[*] Condos: House - Adjusted size of some doors so there isn't a massive gap at the bottom of them
[*] Condos: House - Fixed gap below stone wall
[*] Condos: House - Fixed small hole in grass next to basement door
[*] Condos: House - Fixed gap in fence around gate
[*] Condos: House - Fixed incorrect gutters
[*] Condos: House - Fixed a fence having a missing collision
[*] Condos: House - Fixed issue where you could see stuff in the bathroom mirror you're not supposed to
[*] Condos: House - Fixed misaligned windows
[*] Condos: House - Fixed small gap in wall in the hallway
[*] Condos: Resort - Fixed lighting issue on large aquarium in Lobby
[*] Condos: Resort - Fixed surface on the right hand side stores overlapping/not saving
[*] Condos: Resort - Fixed Bar Aquarium window not having proper collision
[*] Condos: Resort - Fixed several misaligned suite doors
[*] Condos: Resort - Smoothed out stairs in store area
[*] Condos: Resort - Fixed glass next to volleyball court/pool not having double sided collision
[*] Condos: Resort - Adjusted suite/lobby aquariums to prevent fish getting out of them

notes.title: Content Creator Update! (0.18.1.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ae9bbb02e6d1db37f1bf5928315eaa2a42ba9257.png[/img]


[h1]Ball Race Map Maker![/h1]
The Ball Race Map Maker is now available! Play with tons of tools and options to make your very own Ball Race maps! With tools for obstacles, course creation options, and a world of possibilities with the Editor system, you can make the map of your dreams!

The new map maker includes built-in Ball Race music support, leaderboard support (when unit approved), and more level design and editing features.

Ball Race itself also received various improvements.

You can get started making your own Ball Race maps by heading to the guide here: https://towerunite.com/guides/wk_ballrace.html


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3e3023b9c0262c2e4a89eb1394db0facef08b24c.jpg[/img]



[h1]Zombie Massacre Map Maker![/h1]
The Zombie Massacre Map Maker is also now available! This map maker includes features such as customizable escapes, sub-objectives, and plenty of options for making the ultimate standoff against the zombie hordes!

With this update, Zombie Massacre has new gameplay elements exclusively for Map Makers (and for official maps very soon): sub-objectives, keycards, and custom escapes.

Zombie Massacre itself also received various improvements, including a new boss!

You can get started making your own Zombie Massacre maps by heading to the guide here: https://towerunite.com/guides/wk_zombiemassacre.html


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/79e40266bdeb0fffe2897367e21e41503d83f4af.jpg[/img]


[h1]ZM: New Boss - T-Rex![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/37763a783bd38f42f491f8fe4477d30614444703.jpg[/img]

The king of Dinosaurs, resurrected! He’s locked and loaded with missiles and dual wielding miniguns. Field raptors are deployed to assist alongside. Face off against this intimidating boss as you fight to survive your final night!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/633b7586422ac27782dd8a1c98fd82d00092a869.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ac950d3187a13e981c31c16655fa5fe92df3e715.jpg[/img]


[h1]New Workshop Player Model Rig/SDK![/h1]
The 3.0 Workshop Player Model Rig is now implemented! This rig offers more fluid animations, IKs, and easier options for modifying proportions of a model, and massive improvements to the process of rigging player models. This has been a lot of work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/030e7037330507c01044335caad30dab7950c102.gif[/img]

We have made a new guide for workshop creators to get started here: https://towerunite.com/guides/wk_creatingcharacters_v3.html


We’ve retargeted the old rig to work with the new rig (and existing player models) without any changes needed. That means that legacy Workshop player models will be compatible immediately. The animations have all been overhauled and improved in many ways.

Workshop creators will be required to use this new SDK to create player models. Existing models can be updated by following the guide.



[h1]Co-op Condo Fixes[/h1]
Co-op Condos have received some much-needed love in this update! We’ve made fixes for Canvas editing issues, NPC/dialogue editing issues, IO timer and Damage Volume editing issues for those who try to edit the hosts Condo!

[h1]Fall 2024 Plaza Update[/h1]
This update includes some changes to the Plaza as well! The Bowling Alley and Laser Tag buildings have had an art pass that includes new entryway details and layout as well as a new “party room” for the Bowling alley, a little reminder of Lobby 2! There were also various fixes to holes and seams around the Plaza, quality of life tweaks, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f3280f6ffeb97752dc5da053037d75c5da38b18e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e7751a4bd2e8723b7752a3ecc2b46430965720cc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a7e0979bd2b1dd1317f21bcead898b1372cc7b30.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life Changes[/h1]
There have been many changes to improve the quality of gameplay in general, so here are those areas that included changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Plaza [/b]- various Plaza changes, optimizations, restart notification is more noticeable, removed a teleporter on the beach
[*] [b]Minigames [/b]- combo time adjustment, weapon changes
[*] [b]Game World Ports[/b] - fixes to scenery and collision, change to the height of screens for legibility
[*] [b]Virus: Horde Mode[/b] - non-collision item avoidance, push/damage heal volume fixes, horde mode flame effects fixes, players no longer infect on touch in horde mode
[/list]

[b]General Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Plaza [/b]- hole fixes, fixed duplicated media screens, z-fighting, lilypads, optimizations
[*] [b]Minigolf: Collision Mutator[/b] - Emission fix, collision is now disabled when you pocket, HUD now shows when its active
[*] [b]Minigolf Map Maker[/b] - fixes to water volume hazards, canvas images clearing on walls, par networking issues, cannon issues, 1x1-dipped missing textures, base height settings, non-global sky volumes, no OOB in tubes
[*] [b]Virus [/b]- Catzek exploit fixes, horde AI spawning, horde movement & interaction fixes
[/list]

[h1]VR Alpha[/h1]
VR has had a lot of development as well! VR is still in alpha, but this update includes massive improvements to the VR experience, including a working VR menu and more VR interactions. 

We're still heavily developing VR, so there will be issues such as the camera not positioning properly. You can fix the VR camera by pressing R on your keyboard, but this will not be a requirement in later updates.

[list]
[*] [b]VR Menus[/b] - the menu now draws through the 3D world and no longer gets blocked by objects, new floating HUD for VR to allow toggling voice, menu for Plazas now shows all active Plazas
[*] [b]VR Interactions[/b] - basic pickup support (you can pickup and throw items, but it’s currently just tap), basic weapon support, basic libretro lightgun support, improved use beam
[*] [b]VR Fixes[/b] - left hand trace no longer overrides right hand trace on menus, VR menu no longer displays a black screen, fixed loading menus not working well in VR
[*] [b]VR Animations[/b] - hand IK is now setup and starting development
[/list]


[h1]New Items[/h1]
Various new items are also now available! 

These include various [b]destructible scenery items[/b] like crates, pots, and explosive barrels; the [b]Physics-al Media Shelf[/b] to store media and Libretro cartridges; [b]mirrors[/b]; [b]new nature items[/b] like lily pads and variations of the Ceiba tree seen in Catzek; and the [b]3D text item[/b], to make more diverse floating signs and notes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0ab474ec18a815445c7c8dc020f5b160fd69af46.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mirrors[/h1]
Reflect on your reflection! The new mirror item reflects the world and players, and uses the mirror settings in graphics settings. You can toggle the mirror on/off by using it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/08a6cf4a9893e948213d87e2aa0b462c958615cf.jpg[/img]


[h1]Media Shelves[/h1]
These new media shelf items will let you organize and store Physical Media and Libretro cartridges on a shelf! Just toss a physical media at a shelf to shelf it! You can also place down a Media Shelf Volume from the IO section of the Condo Inventory to create your own custom shelves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/6b27bb87a0aebef917e63dff20c1381e566b2be2.gif[/img]


[h1]Tons of Bug Fixes and Improvements![/h1]
We've been addressing a lot of the reported bugs and there's a ton of fixes, optimizations in this update that range from Plaza, Game Worlds, Map Makers, VR, Condos, and Co-op Condos.

[h1]Upcoming Halloween Events[/h1]
Halloween is right around the corner, so keep an eye out for the usual events, ghoul coins, and some new items next month!


[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Ball Race Map Maker!
[*] Zombie Massacre Map Maker!
[*] New Workshop Player Model Rig 3.0!
[*] Fall 2024 Plaza Update!
[*] ZM: Added new boss - T-Rex!
[/list]

[b]New Items[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Physical Media Shelf to Sweet Suites Furnishings store. This new item will let you organize and store Physical Media and Libretro cartridges on a shelf
[*] Added Rental Shelf to Central Circuit store
[*] Added Mirror to Sweet Suites Furnishings store. The mirror item reflects the world and players, and uses the mirror settings in graphics settings. You can also toggle the mirror on/off by using it
[*] Added 3D Text to D.I.Y store. 3D text is an item, similar to Floating Text, that lets you type text and it'll generate 3D text!
[*] Added Explosive Barrel to Rob's Imports store. An exploding/destructible Condo item that has respawn features
[*] Added Lillypads, Ceiba Tree to Seasons nature store
[*] Added Destructible Crate, Destructible Crate Long, Destructible Pot, Military Crate, and Shipping Container to Rob's Imports store
[/list]

[b]Plaza Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Redesigned Plaza server list. Player counts are a lot more visible 
[*] Casino: Ace now can be low for Straights and Straight Flush
[*] Bowling Alley: Added the side "party room" back to the bowling alley (from lobby 2)
[*] Bowling Alley: Art pass on the exterior building
[*] Bowling Alley: Added fake interior for the bowling alley so you can "see" into the bowling alley before entering
[*] Casino: Swapped some of the tables around in the Casino, so there is now one of every type of table game in the main room (including Texas Hold 'Em and Five Card Draw). The other large room is now purely an overflow room
[*] Laser Tag: Removed the redundant queueing room and converted the first entry room into the new queueing room, so players wanting to play the game will be easily visible from the main plaza area and not hidden away
[*] Laser Tag: the entry/queue room has had an art pass
[*] Arcade: Art & Optimization pass on the arcade interior
[*] Vehicle Store: Vroomspeed now appears closed and the lights are turned off (in the meantime)
[*] Game Ports: Removed extra flags from entrance walls
[*] Minigames: Removed distracting reload animations from crossbow in Balloon Shoot
[*] Minigames: Improved teleporter visual effects
[*] Minigames: Adjusted combo time on minigames (1.25 > 1.45) to compensate for crossbow reload time
[*] Plaza restart notification is now more noticable
[*] Appearance Store: Reduced the volume and pitch of the electricity effects of the player character changing machines in the back room of Tower Threads
[*] Removed Minigame Teleporter on Beach to prevent it disrupting beach activities
[*] Game World Ports: Reduced height of the large Game World Port screens so it's easier to reach/read
[/list]

[b]Game World Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Minigolf[/b]
[list]
[*] Minigolf: Collision is now immediately disabled when you pocket (player collision mutator)
[*] Minigolf: Added camera collision to flag camera (will help with SDK maps where the camera would clip through walls)
[*] Minigolf: Added "Retry Mode" mutator which enables a new respawn feature (default off). Respawn has a 1 stroke penalty (hold K to respawn your ball back to the start pad)
[*] Minigolf: Added a "Collisions Enabled" HUD element when the server has collisions enabled
[/list]
[*] [b]Zombie Massacre[/b]
[list]
[*] ZM: Clearing all the zombies during "Kill All Zombies Before Helicopter Lands" will now award all players 500 points
[*] ZM: "Kill All Zombies Before Helicopter Lands" will now timeout after 30 seconds, to prevent the game from soft locking
[*] ZM: Readying up from upgrades game timer reduced from 10 seconds to 1 second in singleplayer mode, getting you into the action faster
[/list]

tags.feature: The Ball Race Map Maker is now available! Play with tons of tools and options to make your very own Ball Race maps! With tools for obstacles, course creation options, and a world of possibilities with the Editor system, you can make the map of your dreams!

The Zombie Massacre Map Maker is also now available! This map maker includes features such as customizable escapes, sub-objectives, and plenty of options for making the ultimate standoff against the zombie hordes!

The king of Dinosaurs, resurrected! He’s locked and loaded with missiles and dual wielding miniguns. Field raptors are deployed to assist alongside. Face off against this intimidating boss as you fight to survive your final night!

The 3.0 Workshop Player Model Rig is now implemented! This rig offers more fluid animations, IKs, and easier options for modifying proportions of a model, and massive improvements to the process of rigging player models. This has been a lot of work!

tags.bug: Co-op Condos have received some much-needed love in this update! We’ve made fixes for Canvas editing issues, NPC/dialogue editing issues, IO timer and Damage Volume editing issues for those who try to edit the hosts Condo!

tags.feature: This update includes some changes to the Plaza as well! The Bowling Alley and Laser Tag buildings have had an art pass that includes new entryway details and layout as well as a new “party room” for the Bowling alley, a little reminder of Lobby 2! There were also various fixes to holes and seams around the Plaza, quality of life tweaks, and more!
There have been many changes to improve the quality of gameplay in general, so here are those areas that included changes:

tags.bug: Plaza - various Plaza changes, optimizations, restart notification is more noticeable, removed a teleporter on the beach

tags.balance_change: Minigames - combo time adjustment, weapon changes

tags.bug: Game World Ports - fixes to scenery and collision, change to the height of screens for legibility
Virus: Horde Mode - non-collision item avoidance, push/damage heal volume fixes, horde mode flame effects fixes, players no longer infect on touch in horde mode
Plaza - hole fixes, fixed duplicated media screens, z-fighting, lilypads, optimizations
Minigolf: Collision Mutator - Emission fix, collision is now disabled when you pocket, HUD now shows when its active

Minigolf Map Maker - fixes to water volume hazards, canvas images clearing on walls, par networking issues, cannon issues, 1x1-dipped missing textures, base height settings, non-global sky volumes, no OOB in tubes
Virus - Catzek exploit fixes, horde AI spawning, horde movement & interaction fixes

tags.feature: VR has had a lot of development as well! VR is still in alpha, but this update includes massive improvements to the VR experience, including a working VR menu and more VR interactions.

tags.bug: We're still heavily developing VR, so there will be issues such as the camera not positioning properly. You can fix the VR camera by pressing R on your keyboard, but this will not be a requirement in later updates.

tags.feature: VR Menus - the menu now draws through the 3D world and no longer gets blocked by objects, new floating HUD for VR to allow toggling voice, menu for Plazas now shows all active Plazas
VR Interactions - basic pickup support (you can pickup and throw items, but it’s currently just tap), basic weapon support, basic libretro lightgun support, improved use beam

tags.bug: VR Fixes - left hand trace no longer overrides right hand trace on menus, VR menu no longer displays a black screen, fixed loading menus not working well in VR

tags.feature: VR Animations - hand IK is now setup and starting development
Various new items are also now available!

These include various destructible scenery items like crates, pots, and explosive barrels; the Physics-al Media Shelf to store media and Libretro cartridges; mirrors; new nature items like lily pads and variations of the Ceiba tree seen in Catzek; and the 3D text item, to make more diverse floating signs and notes.
Reflect on your reflection! The new mirror item reflects the world and players, and uses the mirror settings in graphics settings. You can toggle the mirror on/off by using it.

These new media shelf items will let you organize and store Physical Media and Libretro cartridges on a shelf! Just toss a physical media at a shelf to shelf it! You can also place down a Media Shelf Volume from the IO section of the Condo Inventory to create your own custom shelves.

tags.bug: We've been addressing a lot of the reported bugs and there's a ton of fixes, optimizations in this update that range from Plaza, Game Worlds, Map Makers, VR, Condos, and Co-op Condos.

notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to this week’s Tower Unite Dev Log!

[h2]Next Update - Update 0.18.1.0[/h2]

We’re very close to releasing the next update. We’re wrapping up some last minute bugs from our playtesting and we are getting everything ready for release.

This update features improvements and changes to Plaza, Workshop 3.0 Rig, Zombie Massacre Map Maker, Ball Race Map Maker, a new ZM boss, and new items, along with tons of fixes and improvements to the game.

You can follow our progress on the [url=https://trello.com/c/jjBeq6By/760-update-01810]update here[/url].

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]

Since we have been working on getting the update out, and focusing primarily on bug fixes, we don’t have any images to show this week.

[b]Johanna[/b] worked on optimizing the Plaza, while continuing to work on the Virus map, Theme Park.

[b]Joshua[/b] worked on upcoming Halloween items.

[b]Lifeless[/b] continued working on the Zombie Massacre map, Escape. He also fixed some map bugs in Frostbite, Corrosion, Throne Room, and Waterhole.

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on VR, specifically IK hands. He also worked on bug fixes for the Ball Race, Zombie Massacre, and Minigolf Map Makers, along with bug fixes in Zombie Massacre and Virus’s horde mode. He also worked on fixing some long standing bugs, such as the player models not saving upon first launch of the game and Ace always being high in poker.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] continued working on the Minigolf map, Dino Drive.

[b]Sketchman[/b] finished work on the new workshop skeleton, as well as fixing major bugs and crashes.

[h2]That’s a Wrap![/h2]
Thank you for reading and we’ll see you all next week for more!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for September 3rd, 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for September 3rd, 2024, detailing all the changes that have happened since August 26th, 2024. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]Zombie Massacre: Map Maker[/h2]

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on some new features for the Zombie Massacre Map Maker.

[h3]ZM Map Maker: Keycards[/h3]

Keycards are new Zombie Massacre pickups that come in 4 different types (red, blue, green, yellow). You can place these in your levels to use as a form of door currency to unlock specific doors with the specific keycard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/1e5bbb778303386840e4582d04f9e84d60167449.png[/img]

The new keycard system comes with two items, the keycard pickup and the redeem volume that accepts the matching keycard. The keycards and the redeem volume can be use once only and come with a reset IO function as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e7c859863e281a163f7c688b9182040ee7d14d0f.jpg[/img]

When a player picks up a keycard, the entire team can use the keycard for matching doors.

[previewyoutube=zl8ZR1LFAMo;full][/previewyoutube]

It's very easy to setup the redeem volume.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/4c7453da0152ee5b459921e28294100bdf1e7203.jpg[/img]

A player can hold as many keycards as desired.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/96cac152c25d665cc41b456386e0a775cc83cc7f.png[/img]

[h3]ZM Map Maker: Game Controller Module[/h3]

This IO module will let you control certain ZM game elements such as the day timer and zombie spawners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/bea5406e9d75f6f02feb46f39ae5aef2b0b34945.png[/img]

[h3]ZM Map Maker: Boss Selection[/h3]

You can now select which boss you want to spawn for your map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ac3871f5c6732ce1c2892ccfa9210001735c7775.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b54ad163fc9ecf3303bd190ab260de9615b41000.png[/img]

[h2]Minigolf: Map Maker[/h2]

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on some improvements to the Minigolf Map Maker.

The Loop Piece now has base height / flat base support. Custom textures applied will no longer stretch when the base height is adjusted, like the built in surfaces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/904def00a070a66ba5175942c5a7120364857387.jpg[/img]

[h2]Pluck-a-Pal Rewrite[/h2]

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on a overall rewrite of Pluck-a-Pal. 

The crane and prongs are all now physics based which will help fix the majority of the issues with the game. The previous version was half physics which led to the crane clipping into physics and causing weird issues.

[previewyoutube=6NIbRFF7K9g;full][/previewyoutube]

This also means that the pals no longer need to be inside of orbs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c1337e65383e512ccd29e376f2198961b51ee900.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/45be4d5dd9b624fb57e8e272917395233e0fadba.png[/img]

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]

[b]Johanna[/b] finished working on art needed for the next Arcade update.

[b]Lifeless[/b] continued working on the Zombie Massacre map, Escape.

[b]macdguy[/b] fixed some issues with the Virus Horde mode, worked a bit on VR, fixed some bugs related to the Co-op condos, and fixed an issue in Condos relating to spawns.

[b]Sketchman[/b] worked on setting up the new workshop skeleton.

[b]Will[/b] worked on music for SDNL.

[h2]Wrap It Up[/h2]
That about covers everything that happened since August 26th, 2024 at PixelTail Games.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for August 26th, 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for August 26th, 2024, detailing all the changes that have happened since August 19th, 2024. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]August 2024 Condo Contest (Sci-Fi)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f3e56b3ae64f060d5be199c42f9db6cf45aa94a2.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

The theme of this month's contest is [b]Sci-Fi[/b]!

So, think alien invaders, spaceships, laboratories, robots, high-tech cities, or anything else like that that reasonably fits the theme! 

Your submission can be a regular Condo or a Workshop Game World Map. The submission should be something that was made after the contest was announced.

Winner will take home 2,000,000 units!

[b]The submission period ends on September 2nd, 2024 at 11:59 PM CT.[/b]

Be sure to look at the prizes and follow the rules [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/august-2024-condo-contest-sci-fi/51083]here[/url].

[h2]Zombie Massacre[/h2]

[b]macdguy[/b] added an Arachnophobia Mode which turns spiders into blobs, and added a new boss, a machine gun wielding T-Rex!

[h3]Zombie Massacre: New Boss (T-Rex)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f1ec2bc5698501e4e28b98cb2b291fc26a44911d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/5b23fdbd608d1c1eadfb92b2833c016c205562dc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/34d919a8b726d43308c9aa880fa1dc63c3839262.jpg[/img]

[h3]Zombie Massacre: Arachnophobia Mode[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e25738f30c2357e204405514646bf466416923ed.png[/img]

[h2]Zombie Massacre: Map Maker[/h2]

Work continues on finishing up the Zombie Massacre Map Maker.

[h3]ZM Map Maker: I/O Support[/h3]

You can now customize the sub-objectives. You can also manually start sub-objectives or use the auto start feature. There are also IO outputs when an objective passed or failed. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/15bcab964d3240e738190312b1ea25b3faf1eb97.png[/img]

The Zombie Spawner now supports Activate and Deactivate, along with an IO input for manually spawning a zombie class of your choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c8df64e15fbfc2c5d71ab2beb81a2aac1a05a7d5.png[/img]

[h3]ZM Map Maker: Helicopter-less Escape[/h3]

You can make maps that don't require a Helicopter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f04553162cf9b1b6c25dabd052338605386149ff.jpg[/img]

[h3]ZM Map Maker: Sub-Objectives[/h3]

[b]macdguy[/b] made some basic stock sub-objectives for use in maps. 

You can use these for your ZM maps, and they come with sound effects and all that setup for you. You can of course still make your own sub-objectives. 

He also added IO events to sub-objectives when players are progressing the objective and when they are not.

Completing a sub-objective will give your team 600 points, and players who are inside a sub-objective will get 25 points every so often while in it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8cbf9ec415a4d24ac63be57d08429f47f33d1fef.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c36e3e8a7b189d2feb576b0b435ebaa6b07a38ed.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a90c45afa9f415bef9b507e432751d8063abbd95.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c5b4e8666fdab82ebac8d9810fab929002c45030.png[/img]

[h3]ZM Map Maker: Better Tools for Testing[/h3]

[b]macdguy[/b] added more editor controls for ZM. Now you can toggle zombie spawns so you aren't getting mauled to death while you walk around your map. You can also easily switch the days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/db6d98582580a6307ba546b645306f2bf7747cdd.png[/img]

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]

[b]Johanna[/b] continued working on the Arcade, finishing the Air Hockey table and shooting gallery room.

[b]Lifeless[/b] worked on fixes for Minigolf: Kingdom.

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on the Zombie Massacre map maker, and added weapon and lightgun support to VR.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] continued working on the Minigolf map, "Dino Drive".

[b]Sketchman[/b] worked on setting up the new workshop skeleton.

[b]wheezwer[/b] worked on art for the virus map, "Theme Park".

[b]Will[/b] worked on music for SDNL.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/99d7956e5d2fce8b07a18965fd2038cfbeff8b92.png[/img]

That about covers everything that happened since August 19th, 2024 at PixelTail Games.

notes.title: August 2024 Dev Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/725044c7b2d20b8d06a6343eefc298aa8d28f5c5.png[/img]

Hey everyone! We’re back again for the August Dev Update!

[h1]Upcoming Developments Survey[/h1]
With the Minigolf Map Maker out, we’re moving on to the other projects we’ve discussed with you in previous dev updates!

We’re currently looking for some feedback on the direction for development!

[h2]TU Future Interest Survey:[/h2]
[url=https://forms.gle/KHE2EeM8ojs1UiCH9]Give your feedback in this survey![/url]

[h1]Dev Livestream[/h1]
We are planning on doing a livestream soon to show a little bit more about how you can use the Map Makers and to show off some VR development!

It’ll be a casual stream, and we’ve been talking about doing more of these as we haven’t done any in some time.

Please let us know anything specific you all would be interested in seeing shown off on stream!

[h1]Future Plush Interest Form[/h1]
We’re holding a survey to gauge peoples’ interest in our next campaign with Makeship! You can give feedback [url=https://forms.gle/PA6d4FGRsqPRrRH3A]here[/url].

[h1]VR Support[/h1]
Since the last dev update, progress was made on loading screens, error popups, Condo Hosting Menu, Condo Workshop Browser Menu, Plaza join, and Condo join in VR!

[h1]Ball Race Map Maker[/h1]
Ball Race map maker development is complete, has a guide, and will be ready for the next update! All of the pieces necessary for creating Ball Race maps are complete and we’re excited to see what you all make when it comes out!

[h1]Zombie Massacre Map Maker[/h1]
The Zombie Massacre map maker is near complete as well, it just needs to be tested! AI navigation, helipads, spawn points, camera tools, and more were all completed!

[h1]Game Types & Mutators[/h1]
The mutator system is finished as of the last update, so we are planning on implementing more mutators in future updates! We have a forum thread if you have a suggestion for a new Mutator or Game Type here: [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/game-type-suggestion-thread/50960]Game Type Suggestion Thread[/url]

[h1]SDNL Announcer[/h1]
More SDNL voice lines have been hooked up in game and attached to events! We just need to make a new intro sequence for SDNL to complete the announcer.

[h1]Community / Dedicated Condos[/h1]
We have been hosting our own dedicated Condo for a while and are working on getting dedicated condos to be part of the server lister!

The next step is ensuring Workshop will function properly.

[h1]Workshop Rig 3.0[/h1]
We made a lot of progress with the new Workshop rig. We’re getting the rig to import right now. The import process is nearly done, and we’re resolving a few small issues. It’s intended to come out with the next update.

[h1]Virus: Theme Park[/h1]
Lots of progress was made with Theme Park! We’ve made the sign for the candy area, finished art for teacups ride and the candy seating area. There was progress with the ice cream truck model, an art pass on jungle area, bathroom and souvenir buildings and paths, an art pass of curbs and floor details, an art pass on the arcade building, a large art pass on the carnival area, which added more stalls and games. We added more playable space in the bumper cars arena, started on the circus area, and, finally, did an art pass on the castle area.

[h1]Minigolf: Dino Drive[/h1]
In the world of Dino Drive, preliminary designs have been made for every hole, laid out in their positions, and the art phase has begun (including the new tiki items)! Dino Drive is meant to be reminiscent of a Minigolf course one would see at a small theme park, and has a tacky dinosaur theme with painted cardboard cutouts and mechanical moving parts. The first half and second half of the holes are divided in theme, the second half will be interior and the first half will be exterior.

[h1]New Arcade Phase: Early Stages[/h1]
For the upcoming Arcade update, we wanted to mention once again that Air Hockey and the indoor shooting gallery are confirmed as new additions with this phase! Art work has not begun but will start soon.

[h1]August Calendar![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/5d4f197f95b68637f3cfc65787ff1f3c4f246ab4.png[/img]

Here is the Tower Unite calendar for August! If you’d like to give feedback on bonus events, please do so [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/bonus-event-suggestions-megathread/50459]here[/url]!
That’s all for this dev update! Thanks so much for reading.
