notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for December 18th, 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for December 18th, 2023, detailing all the changes that have happened since December 11th, 2023. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]Tower Unite End of 2023 Survey[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/85e4f80ddb928950f73df1c6757b8833caa07472.png[/img]

It's time for another gameplay survey! 

Give feedback on Tower Unite's development. 

The survey will be open until December 21st.

Fill out the survey [url=https://forms.gle/PqoEfG77kQgXcJNp7]here[/url]!

[h2]Winter 2023 Condo Contest (Winter/Festivity)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2523e444441eb2fb334c9aae930dd65e01e036ce.jpg[/img]

The submission period for the winter Condo Contest has begun!

The theme this year is Winter / Festivity again!

So, your build should be either: winter-related, themed after winter holidays / holiday activities (including New Years), or generally wintry and festive!

The submission period ends on January 7th, 2024 at 11:59 PM.

Be sure to look at the prizes and follow the rules on the thread [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/winter-2023-condo-contest-winter-festivity/49113/1]here[/url]!

[h2]November 2023 Art Contest - Results[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/531c61f9d9056982a6c23e037e43ff22d165f6af.png[/img]

The results are in! Thanks to everyone who voted and participated! There were 111 responses this time.

The winners are:

[url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/november-2023-art-contest/49027/6]1st Place[/url] - 1,000,000 Units - Wishbo_ne
[url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/november-2023-art-contest/49027/13]2nd Place[/url] - 250,000 Units each - Studio_Mercy_Music, Vito Skeletino, han, The Lich, Alexer Zoderia, pissweed, HuskyInABasket
[url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/november-2023-art-contest/49027/14]3rd Place[/url] - 500,000 Units - nephco
[url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/november-2023-art-contest/49027/8]4th Place[/url] - 250,000 Units - Herobrine
[url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/november-2023-art-contest/49027/5]5th Place[/url] - 150,000 Units - Mrs.Insomniac

Thank you to everyone who participated and congratulations to everyone who won.

You can view all the submissions [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/november-2023-art-contest/49027/1]here[/url].

[h2]Winter Holidays Update 2023 (0.17.5.0)[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e1d072d2b158f9095196507d672d6c00f9652cb7.png[/img]

Last week, we released the Winter Holiday update, bringing back the winter plaza, winter themed events, the new boardwalk, and more.

You can read the release notes [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/394690/announcements/detail/3907499744269059280]here[/url].

We're also working hard on a Part 2 update, with a few more items and the teased winter Accelerate map, "Holly Jolly Highway". We're aiming to release that update this week, so keep your eyes peeled.

[b]Johanna[/b] worked on getting the Winter Plaza ready for release, and also worked on "Holly Jolly Highway".

[b]Lifeless[/b] worked on "Holly Jolly Highway", as well as fixed some issues with SDNL maps.

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on releasing the update, and worked on fixing issues that came up with the initial release.

[b]Madmijk[/b] worked on getting MIDI ready for release, as well as making the MIDI announcement.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] worked on holiday items.

[b]Sketchman[/b] worked on optimizations and bug fixes, and worked on achievement icons.

[b]Wheezwer[/b] worked on dialouge for the holiday characters.

[h3]Holiday Achievement Icons[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a4e1df4225bdc31b3093fade977a7bb4fa7b6581.png[/img]

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]

[b]Joshua[/b] continued working on the new skeleton for the Workshop models, working on the IK system.

[b]Wheezwer[/b] worked on getting new screenshots for the Steam store page.

[b]Will[/b] worked on music for Eruption and Containership.

[h2]Wrap It Up[/h2]
That about covers everything that happened since December 11th, 2023 at PixelTail Games. See you all next year!

---

[h2]Condo[/h2]

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on two new volumes, a Sky Volume, which allows condo owners to adjust fog values, sky colors, etc, and a Post Processing Volume, allowing condo owners to adjust post processing effects.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] worked on a Canvas torus.

[h3]Condo: Post Process Volume[/h3]

This volume will allow you to customize various visual effects such as saturation, contrast, chromatic, vignette, grain, bloom, tint, pixelate, etc. within a volume or globally throughout the entire condo. A pixelate option will also be added as well as some presets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3ad7ebdc3d8d071b6dd522a553e01d036045b79b.png[/img]

[h3]Condo: Post Process Volume - Pixelate Filter (with Posterizing)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8ffd9411867693e81959d62af62207f044be74ec.png[/img]

[h3]Condo: Sky Volume[/h3]

This volume will allow you to customize the sky effects, including fog, sun, sun tint, horizon/zenith colors, star colors, and time of day settings within a volume or globally throughout the entire condo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/dfce945dbfe866a212463cdcfbeafbd515a052c4.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ca453376a57ace1b09e4b49b9804b78d66f71f04.png[/img]

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on fixing some issues with the optimization update.

notes.title: Boardwalk Carnival Expansion / Halloween Part 2 (0.17.3.0)
notes.content:
[h1]THE BOARDWALK CARNIVAL IS HERE![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d5861dcd1fc436172a8431eec6156b0909d6e008.png[/img]

We have some surprises for you to kick off this Halloween! This update introduces the Boardwalk Carnival Expansion, which comes with 4 new mini-games that you can play directly in the Plaza!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8c1898f29a63f524a81803ee36e688f886f4884d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Boardwalk Games[/h1]
The boardwalk has been renovated to accommodate 4 new mini-games! Play these games to earn Boardwalk tickets! You can spend these at the prize counter in the Arcade. The new games are:

[b]Roll and Race[/b]
Roll the balls into the holes and score points to move your racing-seahorse along the track faster! Aim for the blue holes for extra speed, and beat the other rollers to the finish line! It has space for 8 players to compete against one another. 

[b]Milk Jug Toss[/b]
It’s the one game where you won’t cry over spilled milk! Try to knock as many jugs off the platform as you can with the balls given to you. You get 2 throws, so make them count! It has space for 5 players to play at the same time.

[b]Balloon Pop[/b]
It’s the most poppin’ game on the boardwalk! Pop all the balloons before the time runs out. With support for up to 2 players, grab a friend to make it easier! 

[b]Splash Blasterz [/b]
Grab a cannon and fill the water tank up as fast as possible! Stay on target to fill the tank faster! It has space for 8 players to compete against one another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/4046f8f2523ee72f17d4c9ce3063fa79d67830f1.jpg[/img]

Along with the new boardwalk games, you can play Super Hoopers and Pluck-A-Pal right on the boardwalk now!

Franky’s Grill also has a nice new location with seating right next to the action!


[h1]New Items [/h1]
More new items have been added to several stores! Check out where you can find them below.

[b]New Ghoulcery Items:[/b][list][*] Autumn Antlers
[*] Mr. Bones Pet
[*] Mr. Bones Plush
[*] Following Brain Pet
[*] Ethereal Dragon Pet[/list]

[b]New Arcade Plushies:[/b]
A series of sixteen “Emogie” plushies have been introduced to coincide with the new selection of Boardwalk games.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c963bde2632dc337ec24c1b1b911345ac10007ba.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c87fddfe154b9f111091ce8621af2ba81cf94734.png[/img][/url]

[b]New Rob’s Imports Items:[/b][list][*] Handcrafted Seat
[*] Handcrafted Table
[*] Handcrafted Shelf[/list]

[b]New D.I.Y. Item:[/b][list][*] Bunker Door[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8c6055d456575b904c17210996918ed757b04111.png[/img]


[b]New Dragon Egg [/b]
A new item available from The Stray, bring it to your Condo and hatch it for a random color of dragon! Which of the seventeen mysterious breeds will you get?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/01fa20f91777890be6dd50abf297627908ad27f2.png[/img]


[b]New Condo Materials[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/cbe552fc66557a890f2e8211511b206cce783287.png[/img]
New materials can easily be found in the “New!” tab of Canvas materials, which also includes Autumn Leaves that were added in a previous Hotfix.
[list][*] [Concrete] Polished Concrete Slabs
[*] [Brick] Alternating Pavement
[*] [Natural] Crystal Ore
[*] [Brick] Fieldstone Wall
[*] [Brick] Cobblestone Wall
[*] [Marble] Terrazzo Slabs
[*] [Misc] Wafer
[*] [Brick] Cobblestone Pattern
[*] [Brick] Cobblestone Path
[*] [Natural] Rubble (Brick)
[*] [Brick] Chunky Blocks
[*] [Glass] Reinforced Glass[/list]


[h1]Halloween Events Ongoing![/h1]

We'll be running our Halloween events until November 13th this year. You can read about what our Halloween events are here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/394690/view/7280690076122707111?l=english

[h1]Dark Co-Op Weekend: This Weekend![/h1]

This Halloween weekend we are also hosting the Dark Co-Op events. During this event, Dark Voyage and Zombie Massacre has a 1.5x Unit and EXP boost.



[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*] Added Autumn Antlers, Following Brain, Flying Mr.Bones, Mr.Bones Plush, Dark Dragon, Ethereal Dragon to Ghoulcery store
[*] Added Dragon Egg to The Stray store
[*] Added Bunker Door to D.I.Y store

[*] Improved "waiting for players" Plaza UI element

notes.content:
[h1]HALLOWEEN 2023 EVENTS ARE HERE![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3e426404144c24994b6104e7e33924c573fca9bf.png[/img]

[h1]Halloween Plaza 2023[/h1]
Our Halloween events have begun!  Enjoy the Halloween festivities and fun as well as some new items that can be found at the Ghoulcery at the center fountain and the long-awaited Haunted Catsack! 

We have plans to dish out more Halloween fun in an upcoming update as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d9519ae815798fd22fd24b8c12c983173ce14486.png[/img]

[h1]NEW: Haunted Catsack[/h1]
A new kind of Catsack has appeared! Unravel the mysteries of the Haunted Catsack and discover exclusive, spooky items!

Earn them by redeeming Sacrificial Remains or Ghoul Coins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/57d56ef12992f096b4b55cbb68d69f554d2838eb.png[/img]

[h1]Dark Voyage[/h1]
We've updated Dark Voyage gameplay a bit, adding rapid fire to the guns and various fixes to the ride. We also have upcoming Dark Voyage weekend events!

[h1]Ghoul Coins[/h1]
Earn ghoul coins to exchange for Halloween items! You can earn ghoul coins by playing Plaza minigames or Game Worlds, Sacrificial Remains, as well as in the Arcade and through Fishing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d0be7bcd98b7f603cbee934da0327e43cd4f2402.png[/img]

[h1]Sacrificial Remains[/h1]
Collect Sacrificial Remains and put them in the Cauldron. You can earn various items and some of the new items with the remains!

[h1]This Is Just The Beginning![/h1]
We have plans to dish out more Halloween fun in an upcoming update as well!

notes.title: Decommission Update (0.17.1.0)
notes.content:
This update adds a new map for SDNL and a bunch of updates for Condos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b30b69e2ec8a23287d8b5a989791a65e35388afc.png[/img]

[h1]New SDNL Map - Decommission![/h1]
Our first crossover map for SDNL is now available! Decommission is a version of the map Virus: Corrosion updated for SDNL. It’s a close quarters indoor map that is frantic fun and an excellent location to appease our blood thirsty audience members. We recommend trying Gun Game on it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/33fcd77e34ac3cf05fb60813e60cb153b2668b81.jpg[/img]

[h1]Condo Sounds and Lasers[/h1]
We've added tons of new Condo sounds that are designed for IO usage in this update. A new SFX category was added with over 50 new sounds.

On top of that, we now have LASERS. Laser Beam is a new IO item that lets you design puzzles (or place deadly lasers) into your Condos. Laser Beams can be set to damage players or trigger events. Laser Beams also come with a Laser Receiver item that will power on/off when a laser intersects with it. Laser Beams can also be set to be blocked by doors, blocking volumes, physics objects, and players, giving you the freedom to create laser based puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c216ad76824ef59fa3dcfd05d725782bdd68435f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Vote Skip now available to all Media Player Items[/h1]
Media Players now have a vote skip option added to them that will allow Condo hosts to enable the vote skip features that the Plaza theater has.

[h1]Libretro Keybinding[/h1]
You can now adjust your keybinds for Libretro in the keyboard settings in the controls settings.

[h1]Halloween On The Way![/h1]
We're busy getting Halloween events started, so stay tuned for more information on when that launches!


[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*] New SDNL map: Decommission!
[*] Condo: Added search bar to the Sound Emitter picker UI, so you can easily find sounds
[*] Condo: Added "Allow Voteskip" option to Media Players, which enables vote skip and vote queue support to an individual media player
[*] Condo: Added new sound category SFX (unlocked by default) with over 50 sounds designed for IO usage
[*] Condo: Added 40+ new sounds to Spooky sound category
[*] Condo: Added new sounds to Ambient and Nature categories
[*] Condo: Updated Security Door sounds
[*] Condo IO: Added Laser Beam, a placeable laser beam that can be triggered by players or deal damage, and can be optionally blocked by objects or players for puzzles
[*] Condo IO: Added Laser Beam Receiver, a placeable module that only powers on when a Laser Beam intersects with it
[*] Condo IO: Added Reveal input for all canvas revealers (ex. Haunted TV)
[*] Condo IO: Added FadeIn IO event to Sound Emitters
[*] Condo: Sound Emitters can now have a range up to 10,000
[*] Condo: Water Volume sides now hide on hidden setting
[*] Virus: Improved weapon prediction for Sonic Shotgun airblast
[*] LC: Removed Dragon bite delay
[*] Libretro: Added key binds for Libretro keyboard controls in Controls settings
[*] Libretro: Added L2 and R2 key binds (default F and G)
[*] Mouse sensitivity setting now allows for decimal values[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Reverted coloring changes on cosmic material, fixing Planetary Piano and several particle effects in the game
[*] SDNL - Meadows: Fixed some landscape issues
[*] SDNL - Meadows: Improved seam in-between cave and main landscape
[*] SDNL - Hinderance: Fixed some collision issues
[*] SDNL - Hinderance: Made an attempt to fix the issues with explosions crashing AMD cards
[*] Condo: Fixed Battery Slot not aligning the battery properly

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.17.0.1
notes.content:
This update improves SDNL and adds water volumes for Condo Creators!

[h1]Water Volume![/h1]
Water volumes are here! Players can now place water volumes in their Condos with the Condo IO tab. These volumes simulate water physics and have swimming animations. 

There are several water types for visual differences, and you can color the water and adjust its friction as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/25ba389f3367e34aff39dbf1e72f9a6680f662a1.jpg[/img]

[h1]SDNL Improvements/Balancing[/h1]
Changes have also been made to improve and balance SDNL! 

Workshop models are now adjusted to better reflect the size of hitboxes in SDNL. 

You can also disable workshop models in Content > Workshop settings > Workshop Player Models In Game Worlds and the players will stay at normal scale.

Dino Battle has gotten some balancing changes. Dinos now have less health and can no longer grab armor or ammo. The win condition for Dino Battle is now based on the amount of kills a team has (30), rather than a time limit.

Players in 1st through 3rd/4th place in any game mode now have higher payouts! There is also an increase to the “Player Killed Bonus”. 

[h1]Workshop Uploading Fixes[/h1]
We have fixed several issues regarding uploading Workshop Condos to the Workshop. One of the major bugs was an issue with Condos not uploading when there were too many tags set. Another issue was that Condos that were large in file size (over 30mb) would not upload, which we fixed. And lastly, the screenshot tool now takes pictures properly again and at the right brightness.


[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Condo: More material improvements
[*] Plaza - Dark Voyage: The time chamber transition effects now happen more quickly
[*] Plaza - Dark Voyage: Ride gun is now a machine gun
[*] Plaza - Dark Voyage: Ride gun now has improved hit FX, laser tracer, and is colored per player to make it easier to see what each player is shooting at
[*] SDNL: Adjusted workshop scales to more accurately match hit boxes
[*] SDNL: Increased Payouts
[list]
[*] SDNL: Increased 1st Place Payout from 1,000 to 1,500 units
[*] SDNL: Increased 2nd Place Payout from 800 to 1,200 units
[*] SDNL: Increased 3rd Place Payout from 600 to 900 units
[*] SDNL: Increased 4th Place Payout from 400 to 600 units
[*] SDNL: Increased Gun Game 1st Place Payout from 1,200 to 1,500 units
[*] SDNL: Increased Gun Game 2nd Place Payout from 800 to 1,000 units
[*] SDNL: Increased Gun Game 3rd Place Payout from 400 to 750 units
[*] SDNL: Increased Player Killed Bonus from 10 units to 50 units[/list]
[*] SDNL: Dinos no longer can grab armor or ammo
[*] SDNL: Dinos have a little less health
[*] SDNL: Dino Battle is now first to 30 kills
[*] SDNL: Changed Cash to Rating
[*] SDNL: Egon Cannon damage increased (12 > 18)
[*] SDNL: Flag held now shows up in view model
[*] SDNL: CTF weapon loadout now spawns you with 1 machine gun (Dual UZI or Bullpup)
[*] SDNL: Hinderance: Adjusted one of the ramped areas to become a spiral staircase to clean up the geometry in the area and make pathing more clear
[*] SDNL: Hinderance: Widened up the blue side room to make it less cramped
[*] SDNL: Hinderance: Improved the art for the cavernous entrance to lava area to look better and be slightly bigger
[*] SDNL: Hinderance: Widened up the side passageway that goes to the lava area to be less cramped and flows better
[*] SDNL: Hinderance: Replaced dirt pile that goes up to winding staircase with stacked blocks to look better and make more sense
[*] SDNL: Hinderance: Widened and expanded various doorways
[*] Condo IO: Added Water Volume. This volume lets you place swimmable water anywhere in your Condo. You can change the water type, color the water, and adjust the water friction
[*] Condo IO: Added Ladder Volume. This volume lets you place invisible ladders anywhere in your Condo, allowing players to climb up how you'd like
[*] Condo IO: Added Hit Target Volume item, an invisible box that has health and takes damage and outputs when it is dead. Comes with hit FX and damage notes and optional blood effects. Has OnDeath, OnHurt outputs and AddHealth, ResetHealth, and TakeHealth inputs, along with DefaultHealth and BloodType settings
[*] Condo IO: Added Test Fire Relay button on the relay settings panel to easily test Relays
[*] Condo IO: Added lock icon on relays when FiredOnce has been set
[*] Condo IO: Added glow effect when a relay was just fired (only when Inventory or Tool is opened up)

tags.feature: Water volumes are here! Players can now place water volumes in their Condos with the Condo IO tab. These volumes simulate water physics and have swimming animations.
There are several water types for visual differences, and you can color the water and adjust its friction as well.

tags.balance_change: Workshop models are now adjusted to better reflect the size of hitboxes in SDNL.

Dino Battle has gotten some balancing changes. Dinos now have less health and can no longer grab armor or ammo. The win condition for Dino Battle is now based on the amount of kills a team has (30), rather than a time limit.
Players in 1st through 3rd/4th place in any game mode now have higher payouts! There is also an increase to the “Player Killed Bonus”.

tags.bug: We have fixed several issues regarding uploading Workshop Condos to the Workshop. One of the major bugs was an issue with Condos not uploading when there were too many tags set. Another issue was that Condos that were large in file size (over 30mb) would not upload, which we fixed. And lastly, the screenshot tool now takes pictures properly again and at the right brightness.

notes.title: New Game World: SDNL Beta Release! (0.17.0.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e9a912ed50c2ddb94bf4f5de0bd0591320848a8c.png[/img]

[h1]Slaughterday Night Live: Beta Release[/h1]

[previewyoutube=f2AUx3LrNfY;full][/previewyoutube]

Murder. Mayhem. It’s what the audience craves! Slaughterday Night Live (SDNL) is Tower Unite’s latest gameworld, a fast paced arena shooter that’ll get your heart pumpin’ in your seats. We’ve packed your TV guide to the brim with 12 different gametypes, because who needs 500 channels when you’ve got classics like Deathmatch, Arena, Capture-The-Flag, InstaGib, Dino Battle, and more! This release comes with 3 new maps to play on, with more on the way, as well as many new weapons to broadcast havoc with. What better to watch on a Slaughterday Night?

Battle across multiple locations such as...

[b]Frostbite[/b] - Battles rage at an isolated research base among strange ice formations that shouldn't exist in nature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/04bd66481fba1d406d8a17546f8b7b062482c37a.png[/img]

[b]Hinderance[/b] - A close quarters frag-fest in old, mysterious ancient ruins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/66a4cbabbdc88c0d592ea4017817b512ce6b9fd2.jpg[/img]

[b]Meadows [/b] - Bring mindless, violent chaos to this tiny, pleasant meadow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2ebfa3594726468db77748d2b6a1ae300364deb7.png[/img]


This release also comes with new items, balance changes for Little Crusaders, as well as various fixes, optimizations, and tweaks throughout the game. 

Read the full list of changes below!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]SDNL has been added to the game!
[*]SDNL Game Types Available on Launch:
[list]
[*] Arcade
[*] Arena
[*] Gun Game
[*] Team Deathmatch
[*] Capture-The-Flag
[*] Dino Battle
[*] Slasher
[*] Team Oddball
[*] Team Gun Game
[*] Insta-Gib
[*] Grav Glove
[*] Space Snipers
[/list]
[*]SDNL Launch Maps:
[list]
[*] Meadows
[*] Hinderance
[*] Frostbite
[/list]
[*]SDNL Achievements:
[list]
[*] Fan Favorite - Get 5 kills in a row without dying.
[*] Plot Armor - Get 3 kills in a row without dying.
[*] Freezerburn - Get 10 environmental kills on Frostbite.
[*] Consider Them Hindered! - Get 10 environmental kills on Hinderance.
[*] Prop Masters Hate You! - Get 50 environmental kills in total.
[*] Set Destroyer - Get 100 environmental kills in total.
[*] Look Ma! No Wires! - Get 50 kills mid-air.
[*] Stuntman - Get 20 kills while sliding.
[*] Improv Master - Get a kill within 1.5 seconds of switching weapons.
[*] Tight Shot - Get 100 melee kills.
[*] Wide Shot - Get 100 ranged kills.
[*] Hit Your Mark - Get 100 kills in Frostbite.
[*] Chewing the Scenery - Get 100 kills in Meadows.
[*] Rising Star - Get 100 kills in Hinderance.

[list]
[*] Added Swivel Chair, Colorful Office Desk to Sweet Suites store

[/list]

[b]Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Directional Damage Indicator
[*] New assets for several weapons and items:
[list][*] TNT (re-model)
[*] Hula Doll (re-model)
[*] Crossbow (re-model and firing sounds)
[*] Minigun (updated textures and model)[/list][*] Other tweaks to existing weapons:
[list][*] Clamped upward sway on weapon view models
[*] Adjust the charge bar on the Plasma Autorifle[/list][*] Weapon swapping is now predicted on clients, making swapping and shooting feel more responsive
[*] Zombie Massacre - Pumpkin Heads now pop off their pumpkin head upon death[/list]

[b]Achievement Changes[/b]
[list][*] “I’m Having a Key Stroke” - difficulty decreased. Requirement to unlock is now play a perfect game within 10 seconds (was 8 seconds)
[*] “A Worthy Offering to the Gods” - difficulty decreased. Requirement to unlock is now to sink 20 balls (was 25 balls).[/list]

[b]Arcade Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now pick up and throw with just left click instead of pressing ‘Use’ to pick up the ball in certain throwing games such as Starfield Lanes
[*] Planetary Piano - 8-key solo game duration increased to 30 seconds (was 15 seconds)
[*] Ice Cave - now allows 50 throws (was 40)
[*] Made Newton’s Apples a bit easier
[*] Lonely Gun - Removed “current ranking”
[*] Lonely Gun - Reduced intermission time between rounds
[*] Whirl-A-Fish jackpot can now be up to 9999 (was 999) and increased default jackpot values to 800-1200 (was 100-200)
[*] Starfield Lanes - Doubled the amount of balls
[*] Avalanche - Doubled the amount of snowballs[/list]

[b]Little Crusaders Changes[/b]
[list][*] Little Crusader Balance Changes - Dragon:
[list]
[*] Added delay between bites (0.5 seconds)
[*] Increased bite duration to 0.96 seconds (was 0.7 seconds)
[*] Improved bite animation (larger bite)
[*] You can now tail-whip while biting or in mid-air
[*] Can no longer bite while stunned
[*] Added delay when flapping
[*] Slightly increased ground speed
[/list]
[*] Little Crusaders Balance Changes - Knight:
[list]
[*] Slightly less jump gravity
[*] Birb now throws farther
[/list]
[*] Little Crusaders - Added Dragon tutorial text
[/list]

[b]Plaza Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Plaza - Doubled the number of targets for Balloon Burst and Target Practice

[*] Game World Ports menu tweaks
[*] Laser Tag health bar HUD changed
[*] Tweaked combat icons such as hit indicators and death icons
[*] Marker no longer covers the numbers in Bingo
[*] Workshop menu UI tweaks
[*] Condo - Removed save button while in workshop mode
[/list]

[list]

[*] Condo - Placeable Lights now have max draw distances (150m or approx. 500ft)
[*] Media Players - Now updates at 30fps (was 100fps)
[*] Condo - Optimized Physical Media items
[*] New gib system hides body parts attached to bones instead of setting their scale to 0, telling the engine their transforms don’t need to be calculated each frame

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for August 28th, 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for August 28th, 2023, detailing all the changes that have happened since August 23rd, 2023. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]August 2023 Condo Contest - Now Voting[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/727b135aa2578432663a1674531edabe92b639b3.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

It's time to vote on the August 2023 Condo Contest!

Voting ends on Monday, August 28th, 2023, at 11:59 PM PDT. You can vote [url=https://forms.gle/SrucNxw8QBGhG6KJ7]here[/url].

See all the entries [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/august-2023-condo-contest/48128]here[/url].

[h2]SDNL: New Game World[/h2]

We're wrapping production up on Slaughterday Night Live (SDNL), our new PVP Game World. SDNL features over 31 weapons, and classic Arena gamemodes such as Team Deathmatch, Capture-The-Flag, Team Oddball, Dino Battle, Slasher (a melee only gametype), Insta-gib, Low Grav Snipers, and the standard Arena gameplay with weapon pickups. SDNL beta will launch with 3 unique maps of various sizes and themes. Meadows, Frostbite, and Hinderance are the launch maps. We're very excited to soon show you what we've been hard at work on.

[b]Johanna[/b] worked on models for the trophies.

[b]Josh[/b] continued working on weapons.

[b]Lifeless[/b] continued working on "Containership", while also touching up SDNL's Game World Port's panel, and fixing various issues in the maps.

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on fixing bugs that were found during internal playtesting. He also worked the Workshop SDK, and finished the SDNL trailer.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] continued working on "Skyline".

[b]Sketchman[/b] continued working on improved weapon prediction.

[b]Will[/b] continued working on music for the SDNL maps.

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] worked on fixing issues with condo materials.

[h2]Wrap It Up[/h2]
That about covers everything that happened since August 23rd, 2023 at PixelTail Games.

---

We love awesome people like you!

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for August 23rd, 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for August 23rd, 2023, detailing all the changes that have happened since August 8th, 2023. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]August 2023 Condo Contest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/727b135aa2578432663a1674531edabe92b639b3.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

For August's contest just submit a Condo build that you want to show off!

[b]This time there is no theme and no restriction on when the build was made![/b]

The submission period ends on August 23rd, 2023 at 11:59 PM.

Be sure to look at the prizes and follow the rules in the thread, which you can find [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/august-2023-condo-contest/48128]here[/url].

[h2]SDNL: New Game World[/h2]

We're wrapping production up on Slaughterday Night Live (SDNL), our new PVP Game World. SDNL features over 31 weapons, and classic Arena gamemodes such as Team Deathmatch, Capture-The-Flag, Team Oddball, Dino Battle, Slasher (a melee only gametype), Insta-gib, Low Grav Snipers, and the standard Arena gameplay with weapon pickups. SDNL beta will launch with 3 unique maps of various sizes and themes. Meadows, Frostbite, and Hinderance are the launch maps. We're very excited to soon show you what we've been hard at work on.

[b]Johanna[/b] continued working on the maps, props, and FPS optimizations with the maps.

[b]Josh[/b] continued working on weapons.

[b]Lifeless[/b] continued working on "Containership".

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on fixing bugs that were found during internal playtesting. He worked on icons for kills and weapons, as well as implementing adjustment ideas from playtesting, setting up stats and achievements, and the Workshop editor.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] continued working on "Skyline", a roof-top acrobatic map, as well as various props for SDNL.

[b]Sketchman[/b] worked on making weapon switching predicted (meaning network ping should have no effect on how quickly you can swap weapons), as well as weapon prediction for some other weapons.

[b]Will[/b] continued working on music for the SDNL maps.

[h3]SDNL: Frostbite (Launch Map)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/4de3fbb72efff94b1614777f661307e9ba23e239.png[/img]

[h3]SDNL: Meadows (Launch Map)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2ebfa3594726468db77748d2b6a1ae300364deb7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/316d15b8a6765450fd38b812db498e285e840123.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

For June and July the theme for the Condo Contest will be Aquarium!

Your goal will be to build an aquarium (or any other sort of fish habitat), and you can use whatever you would like to do so. Remember that Aquarium Volumes can be purchased at D.I.Y.!

The submission period ends on July 10th, 2023 at 11:59 PM.

notes.title: Summer Cleanup (0.16.11.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3755f7d243605a0d2cb46fb8b17e837ccb697d4a.png[/img]

[h1]Improved Netcode and Prediction & Animation Optimizations[/h1]

In this update, our focus was on improving the netcode for various movement actions that occur in the game. This includes better networking for jetpacks, rocket jumps, ramps, teleporters, push volumes, player launchers, trampolines, and dashing throughout various aspects of the game. There is way less network related ping delay regarding these types of actions.

[h1]Improved Accelerate: Kart Racing[/h1]

We've improved the turning, drifting, and camera for Accelerate.

[h1]Media Players Now Can Be Connected To Each Other & Have Multiple Items Connected Into Them[/h1]

Media Players now can have multiple cameras connected to them and multiple game consoles as well. This is done by a channel system. You can switch channels on the Media Player using the Remote item or by using Condo IO buttons.

You can now connect media players with other media players, allowing you to duplicate video displays to other media players at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/cbf9a5b6d72f6b204a3eea7324e43f812aa6da21.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/32d73ae61019ed2d0ab41b9e0f6cafa0fad5fe01.png[/img]

[h1]Custom Spawn Points for Condos[/h1]

We've also added a long time desired feature: custom spawn points. Condo owners now can place their own custom spawn points (goodbye teleporters), and adjust where players can spawn by using the Custom Spawn Point Tag Volume. You can also create checkpoints using the Custom Spawn Point and enabling checkpoint mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/26fbc1563a992c46ce6a529bfead1a76901b9783.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/9e606274cface65d3a297e11e583fa0483eb6490.jpg[/img]


[h1]Plaza Server List Fix (Intel CPU issue)[/h1]

We have fixed the Plaza servers not being able to join for multiple players, this was due to an Intel CPU issue and now should no longer be a problem.

[h1]Rotating Canvas/Surfaces[/h1]
You can now rotate canvas surfaces and some normal surfaces while building your condo!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/65c2b699f797aa6e3f841193a8307c5c805fd868.png[/img]

Read the full list of changes below!

[b]Changes[/b][list][*] Significantly optimized player animations
[*] Added Sheeted Mattress, Simpla Entertainment Stand, Simpla Framed Dresser, Simpla Sideboard Cabinet, Simpla Wooden Nightstand, Simpla Colorful Drawers, Simpla Colorful Dresser, Simpla Accent Table, Glass Table to Sweet Suites store
[*] Added Supermarket Single Door, Supermarket Double Door, Supermarket Glass Panel, Closet Door, Closet Double Doors, Pantry Doors to D.I.Y. store
[*] Added Canvas Hemisphere item to D.I.Y. store
[*] Improved rocket jump movement - no longer has network lag issues and is fully predicted
[*] Accelerate: Improved turning, fixed sliding, improved camera when turning, and better drift visuals
[*] Condo IO: Added Custom Spawn Point item. Now you can add custom spawn points to your Condo. If you have multiple of these, players will randomly spawn at each of them. Comes with Activate/Deactivate IO input and OnPlayerSpawned IO output events
[*] Condo IO: Added Spawn Point Tag Volume. Sets a spawn point tag on a player which makes them only spawn at spawn points with the same tag
[*] Condo IO: Added Checkpoint Mode to Custom Spawn Point item. This will make the Custom Spawn Point into a checkpoint and set players who overlap with the spawn point box to respawn at that spawn point
[*] Condo: You can now connect multiple cameras and consoles to the same media player. There is a new channel system that every TV has built in, once you IO connect other video sources into the media player. You can switch between channels using the Media Player Remote item's right click (if you have media player admin permission) or by using IO buttons with the SetChannel or NextChannel inputs
[*] Condo: You can now connect multiple media players to other media players and have a single media player duplicate its image to other media player screens
[*] Condo: Added Texture Rotation option to Canvas primitives. Currently does not work on World Align materials

[*] Improved Chainsaw milestone (added moving chain and smoke)
[*] Improved Flamethrower milestone (added better impact FX and pilot light, increased polygons)
[*] Improved Firework RPG milestone. Added hit decals when they explode[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list][*] Fixed Plaza servers not loading for certain Intel CPUs
[*] Fixed weekend events not working for certain Intel CPUs

[*] Condo - House: Fixed light build issues

[b]joshua[/b] continued working on weapon models and animations.

[b]Lifeless[/b] continued working on "Hinderance", finishing the level layout and the initial art pass.

[b]macdguy[/b] finished working on some weapons, setup a explosion and projectile base for other weapons to use, and worked some more on iron sights. He also worked on the grenade launcher, the crossbow, retro gun, minigun, and Egon cannon. 

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] continued working on maps.

[b]Sketchman[/b] continued working on weapon prediction.

[b]Wheezwer[/b] worked on fake company logos for "Frostbite".

[b]Will[/b] continued working on music.

[h3]SDNL: Egon Cannon WIP[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ad1aa94aa7f65335b918a4a161d63be51d0a02c9.png[/img]

[h2]Condo: Media Players[/h2]

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on improving the Media Players.

[h3]Media Players now have Multiple Channels[/h3]

You can now connect multiple cameras and consoles to the same media player. There is now a new channel system that every TV has built in, once you IO connect other video sources into the media player.

You can switch between channels using the Media Player Remote item (if you have media player admin permission) or by using IO buttons with the SetChannel or NextChannel inputs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/32d73ae61019ed2d0ab41b9e0f6cafa0fad5fe01.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=MOOCfL23uy0;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=kMvmf8J4YEY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Media Players can now be connected to other Media Players[/h3]

You can now also connect multiple media players to other media players. Media players can be connected and will have a media repeater channel and will repeat the same video as the connected TV and be in sync with what is being displayed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/cbf9a5b6d72f6b204a3eea7324e43f812aa6da21.png[/img]

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]

[b]macdguy[/b] fixed third person animations.

[b]madmijk[/b] continued working on MIDI support.

[h3]Third Person Animation Bug Fix (Before/After)[/h3]

[previewyoutube=FuC0KJkhuC8;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=oe_rmg0W1p0;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a18fc8bdac9241ef70da504027158b00b3475fa3.jpg[/img]

[b]Extra Bonus Winners:[/b]

Thank you all again for participating in the vote and the contest itself, and we hope to see you again in the next contest.

You can check out all the entries for this contest [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/may-2023-art-contest/47634/1]here[/url].

[h2]SDNL: New Game World[/h2]

[b]Johanna[/b] continued adding the finishing touches to "Frostbite". She also continued working on the art pass for "Meadows", while also re-texturing a bunch of the weapons, along with adding destructables in the maps.

[b]joshua[/b] worked on weapon models, namely the UZI and MAC-10.

[b]Lifeless[/b] continued working on "Hinderance". 

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on touchups to the flamethrower weapon, while also tweaking all of the other weapons. He improved the recoil system, added a bullet spread system, and improved the scope systems for the magnum and bullpup.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] continued working on "Disposal".

[b]Sketchman[/b] worked on weapon prediction for some of the weapons.

[b]Wheezwer[/b] worked on some art for "Hinderance".

[b]Will[/b] continued working on music for SDNL maps.

[h3]SDNL: Hinderance WIP[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/ac2902bccf7d9fe54a8afedb3779b29b7883a6e0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a5591fd40d46fbd535c64a066393016e93a17fb6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/6c37c196c4a32e281ef80e29eeb2a21f9545411d.png[/img]

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]

[b]Lifeless[/b] worked on fixes for issues found with "Heavenscape".

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on a massive networking overhaul for movement based features.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] worked on updating the "bedroom door" model, allowing for the number of inset panels to be configured. The door has also been renamed to "Paneled Door".

[b]madmijk[/b] continued working on MIDI support.

[h3]Network Improvements[/h3]

Movement based features have had a massive networking overhaul. Prediction was added to Jetpacks, Jump Pads, Teleporters, Rocket Jumps, Trampolines, Push Volumes, Fans, Survivor's Shield (in Zombie Massacre), ramps in Accelerate, Air Dash, etc. Basically anything that moved players around was tweaked and predicted with improved networking and huge reduction in netlag issues throughout. We tested with 250-300ms ping and found these types of interactions are much smoother now.

[h3]Condo: Paneled Door[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8cf486f5cac8202936035b3640349bc4f66cc100.png[/img]

[h3]Condo: Canvas Texture Rotation Setting[/h3]

Also works with most regular surface materials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/6c7c984845b1b9b601d4cb41191b1e3c89fca5de.png[/img]

[h2]Wrap It Up[/h2]
That about covers everything that happened since May 30th, 2023 at PixelTail Games.

notes.title: Heavenscape Update (0.16.10.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/eca01c492d602c8b2bd13aa735d2a00636b1a316.png[/img]

Ball Race has a new map! Race against the clock on abandoned structures that snake through floating islands. Your speed will be key to traversing the slopes and grassy clearings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d3e736d30cfe64c8b6763d80e0552aa275c7b749.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c9446dfa1ee4054d7d1835f127507feea2476e33.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/bbd52f5732e7fe88238f61e12aecba06d98c79da.jpg[/img]

This update also includes new items, a new server browser and improved rendering quality, bug fixes, and more!

Read the full list of changes below!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*] New Ball Race map - Heavenscape!
[*] New Game World & Condo server browser - now shows your friend's servers (if they have it set to friends only)
[*] Improved font and UI rendering quality in higher resolutions (such as 1080p and 4K)
[*] Improved server list visuals and removed the collapsible element of servers on the server list, making it easier to find and join servers with less clicks
[*] Condo IO: Improved Hide/Unhide feature. Items that are hidden no longer can be used or block use traces. Hide/Unhide also no longer will change an items no collision setting as well
[*]Condo: Added quick save button (owners only) to quickly save your condo as-is from the condo scoreboard
[*] Added Folding Chair and Closed Folding Chair to Rob's Imports store
[*] Added Round Coffee Table to Sweet Suites store
[*]Improved Catsack opening system, allowing for queued catsack opening[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed Catsacks causing a crash when trying to open them, along with other issues regarding opening Catsacks
[*]Fixed player voice volume setting slider not applying voice setting properly after setting it once
[*] Minigolf - Waterhole: Fixed hole 18 collision issues with minecarts
[*] Fixed Dumpster item making a noise on spawn
[*] Fixed Canvas Decal shine not working properly
[*] Fixed light build issues with Condo Hub
[*] Fixed Cafe Table not being colorable
[*] Optimization: Improved server list rendering times
[*] Condo: Fixed Workshop physics items moving on load in
[*] Condo IO: Fixed Teleport Volume use trace not working properly (wasn't using the full volume as the collision size)
[*] Condo IO: Fixed Hide/Unhide causing collisions to be disabled when a item that was hidden is saved as hidden
[*] Condo IO: Fixed Toggle calling OnToggled even if it didn't change state
[*] Condo IO: Fixed looping Timers not stopping if you stop them right as they are about to loop again
[*] Condo - Smooth Dirt: Fixed navigation volume not being large enough
[*] Condo - Smooth Dirt: Added ability to completely disable the ENTIRE dirt floor
[*]Fixed webM playback issues due to 4.21 changes[/list]

[b]Additional Hot Fix (build 11311902)[/b]
[list]
[*]Condo IO: Fixed Toggler toggle state not happening properly
[*]Condo IO: Fixed Hide/Unhide feature not restoring collision overlaps properly (causing triggers and floating chat to not unhide properly)
[*]Fixed Private Theater UI showing "unlocked" always
[*]Virus: Improved Tommy Gun and Double Barrel materials/textures
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Fix & Updated Engine (0.16.9.1)
notes.content:
This update addresses several bugs from the new update including new items and features.

[h1]Engine Upgrade From 4.20 to 4.21[/h1]
As part of our ongoing commitment to improve the game and offer the best experience to our player base we have upgraded the version of Unreal the game runs on from 4.20 to 4.21. Just like previous engine upgrades, effects may not be immediately visible to players, as many of the changes are fixes for engine bugs (which we frequently have to work around), improvements for build times (which lets us test changes faster), new features and tools for us to use when developing new portions of the game, and engine optimizations which may be more impactful for some users than others. Essentially, expect engine upgrades to pay dividends over time rather than up front, especially as this is a step to later engine versions which have other features and fixes which may be more immediately impactful for everyone.

This engine update required us to rebuild lighting on the majority of our maps, which will cause this update to be a larger download than usual updates. We apologize for the inconvenience, but there was no way around it (unless you wanted to see broken lighting in the game).

[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*] Engine Upgraded from 4.20 to 4.21
[*] Added Readable Book, Sandbag Wall, Sandbag, Ancient Brick Wall, Ancient Brick, Restroom Stall Door, Restroom Stall Panel, Restroom Stall Divide to D.I.Y. store
[*] Added Decorative Dumpster, Dumpster, MCD Keyboard, Industrial Barrel, Toolbox, Rolling Toolchest, Hammer, Handsaw, Paintbrush, Sledgehammer, Paint Can, Paint Tray, Paint Roller to Rob's Imports store
[*] Added Basic Wall-Mounted Urinal, Plastic Cubby, Retro Stool, Small Grid Bookcase, Toilet Paper, Toilet Paper Holder to Sweet Suites store
[*] Added Tennis Ball, Windball to Toy Stop store
[*] Condo IO: Added new Random module with up to 32 random outputs
[*] Condo IO: Added Hidden Button/Volume
[*] Condo IO: Added Comment Volume
[*] Condo: Added a search bar to the material surface browser
[*] Condo: Added Advanced Edit Mode top bar notification to make it more noticeable when advanced edit mode is enabled
[*] Condo: Added "Disable Collision" button on main edit item property UI next to the lock button
[*] Condo: Setting for toggling surface edit mode is now always visible, regardless of being in advanced edit mode or not
[*] Condo: Custom item names now show on item tooltips, allowing you to quickly see your custom set item labels just by highlighting an item
[*] Condo: Added "Prompt Label" setting to IO levers and light switches
[*] Condo: Manipulate/gizmo UI now shows the title of the item you are manipulating, along with the ability to quickly rename the item
[*] Condo: Added "Relative Teleport" mode setting (keeps objects relative offset from the teleport when moving them to a new teleporter) to Teleporter items
[*] Condo: Added "Keep Velocity" setting (allows you to disable velocity transfer when teleporting objects) to Teleporter items
[*] Condo: Added "Play Once" setting to Sound Emitter item
[*] Condo IO: IO connections now copy over to the newly duplicated item when you duplicate an item
[*] Condo IO: Added "Start" and "Stop" debug buttons to Timer in the settings panel
[*] Condo IO: Added "Start On Spawn" setting to Timer
[*] Condo: Sound emitters display the sound that is being played instead of just "looping"
[*] Condo IO: Optimized internal calls
[*] Condo IO: Improved connection organization, now sorts by delay then alphabetically based on custom & item names
[*] Added IO Events - Buttons: SetPrompt
[*] Added IO Events - Levers: SetPrompt
[*] Added IO Events - Buttons: Activate/Deactivate
[*] Added IO Events - Levers: Activate/Deactivate[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Virus - Subway: Fixed hula doll clipping into snack machine
[*] Little Crusaders - Cardboard Castle: Fixed an issue with some models being inconsistent to walk along
[*] Little Crusaders - Cardboard Castle: Fixed some camping spots
[*] Little Crusaders - Cardboard Castle: Fixed some visual issues
[*] Little Crusaders - Cardboard Castle: Fixed some collision issues
[*] Plaza: Fixed "Stuff Discovery" turtle plushy being missing in the Transit Station
[*] Condo: Fixed clients not being able to scale workshop items in co-op condos
[*] Condo: Fixed color palettes not applying when selected (co-op condos)
[*] Condo: Fixed color UI header showing when there is only 1 color
[*] Condo: Fixed Copycat duplicate feature (and various other tools) not working in co-op condos
[*] Condo: Fixed Teleporter Square having a seam in the model effects
[*] Fixed "Longest Putt" stat not displaying anything in the stat book
[*] Condo IO: Fixed hide/unhide toggling collision wrongly
[*] Fixed upgrades in stores showing as unlocked when they have not yet been unlocked/bought
[*] Minigolf: Fixed Alpine Mastered achievement not unlocking properly
[*] Minigolf: Fixed Alpine course par stat not updating properly in stats book
[*] Minigolf: Fixed Mushroom Wood Playthroughs stat not displaying properly in stats book
[*] Condo: Fixed Teleporters teleporting players who are noclipping (now it'll fully ignore noclipping players)[/list]

notes.title: Catzek Temple Update (0.16.9.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f7ddd9c3d0ee62b657704811d0b16825a1c44efe.png[/img]

A new Virus map is here!

Tucked away in mysterious jungle-covered mountains, ancient ruins lay dormant… waiting.
Catzek Temple is designed as the largest Virus map yet, featuring multiple routes sprawling from a rugged jungle to ancient obsidian mines. While the temple-top may seem like an easy sniper’s nest for Survivors, multiple geyser-powered launchpads allow Infected to quickly bombard you from all directions.

The ancient Catzeks lived in a world secluded from humanity for centuries before vanishing, leaving only their cities and possessions as proof of their rich history. While archaeologists stumbled upon this location in the past, some unknown fate befell them before they could complete further studies. Now with your arrival, an ancient game of Virus begins anew.

notes.title: Tower Unite Anniversary Events! (0.16.8.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/46a0bc099295d31e57d1797e4d3e5af31ee8f8b1.png[/img]
To celebrate Tower Unite's debut to Early Access, we're starting our Anniversary Event celebrations!

Kalleira, wanting to celebrate with everyone, caused mayhem by bringing in all the characters and minigames from all the holiday events. Due to her magic, this event features minigames from Halloween events and Winter Holiday events all at the same time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/9da5e2799d67c7df741036d9d2f8a5d20b394254.png[/img]

You can also earn Anniversary Coins from playing any of the game worlds or minigames in Tower and unlock anniversary themed items, Halloween items, and Winter Holiday items!

[b]This event will last for the entire month of April[/b], so you'll be able to take your time getting coins!


[h1]New Anniversary Items![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/670e891fb6ca54b0fab71fdf9da13a768055b2f9.png[/img]
[h1]Head to Kalleira near the Plaza fountain![/h1]

Easter Events will continue until the 10th!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f5c164ae18a2defdf95e667fa1bada2503cb4ccd.png[/img]

Also...
[h1]Double Ticket Weekend[/h1]
To kick celebrations off, this weekend we're also having a Double Ticket Arcade Weekend!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/76b7e612b7e744825615426f74f8cd602816f7de.png[/img]

Quite a busy weekend!

[h2]Little Crusaders and Accelerate Payouts have increased![/h2]
We've more or less doubled the payouts for both Little Crusaders and Accelerate to encourage more multiplayer variety. Little Crusaders in particular earns you more when you have more players in the game.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for April 3rd, 2023
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for April 3rd, 2023, detailing all the changes that have happened since March 27th, 2023. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]March / April 2023 Condo Contest - Tree House - ONGOING[/h2]

Hey everyone!

The theme for the March/April contest is Tree House!

So, build a house in a tree! You can build your own tree or use one of the existing ones, and feel free to make your tree house in any style.

Also, remember that you can disable collision on items (such as trees) by right clicking and selecting Disable Collision.

The submission period ends on April 10th, 2023 at 11:59 PM.

Read all about the rules and prizes [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/march-april-2023-condo-contest-tree-house/47233/1]here[/url]!

[h2]Update 0.16.8.0 - 2023 Anniversary Events[/h2]
We're working to get Update 0.16.8.0 ready for release, which marks the return of the Anniversary events (with some new items), as well as a Plaza Update and Optimization pass.

You can read everything planned for this update, [url=https://trello.com/c/3ImH3Z6J/689-update-01680-anniversary-2023]here[/url].

[h3]2023 Anniversary Items[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/68abc60c554a43f053016302fdfbf534ad4f4fe6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0be419a810e0483a748fc4d72e73168860464e65.png[/img]

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]

[b]Johanna[/b] worked on fixing Plaza Lighting and getting it ready for release.

[b]Joshua[/b] continued working on Anniversary items.

[b]Lifeless[/b] continued working the Ball Race map, "Heavenscape". 

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on fixing Plaza issues. He fixed bugs with the Rollercoaster, fixing the lights and guardrails, removing the double station stop, and fixing the achievements. He also added a mouth offset for Workshop models. Adjusted various things in Virus, such as being able to pickup TNT after it has been thrown, adjusted the akimbo pistols, adding/updating sounds, and updated the physics on the Crossbow bolts (so they physics now when breaking glass instead of just hovering in midair).

[b]madmijk[/b] continued working on MIDI support. He also rebaked movement for the Monorail in the Plaza.

[b]Nuclearxpotato[/b] continued working on Anniversary items and other items.

[b]Sketchman[/b] continued working on backend improvements. He also made new achievements for Virus: Catzek Temple.

[b]Will[/b] started working on music for Ball Race: Heavenscape.

[h3]New Piano UI with Pitch + Modulation Wheels and Color Support[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d26b972f58db3585f472aae27c65b48c4bdb0018.png[/img]

[h3]Virus: Catzek Temple Achievements[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/dc6972b743ea73e541007637fc927cf090e5a459.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/4db13414c77f401779a942b34755d8d81b456836.png[/img]

[h3]Virus: You can now pick up thrown TNT[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d19573c382e57b02625e271e75789912bc51b687.png[/img]

[h2]Wrap It Up[/h2]

notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for March 27th, 2023, detailing all the changes that have happened since March 20th, 2023. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]Accessibility Suggestions[/h2]
We've created a forum post asking the community for suggestions on how we can improve gameplay for players with certain conditions such as colorblindness, dyslexia, or anything else that might affect a players ability to use the standard presentation and controls of the game. 

If you have any ideas or suggestions, and possible solutions on how to solve a particular issue, please check out the forum post [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/accessibility-related-suggestions-megathread/40333]here[/url].

notes.title: Mushroom Wood Update (0.16.7.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/fe1d2dff793d4c80804b4bfc33f90dc06138c7c4.png[/img]

[h1]Mushroom Wood[/h1]
A new Minigolf map is here! Previously known as Dark, Mushroom Woods features 18 holes.

Jump between mushrooms in a colorful fantasy world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/0c4f20e0b0e74e14751a42755524aced92d3c154.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e85fd99d64c0264c1a2ddb0ad513cc85d5d5cdc7.jpg[/img]


[h1]VR Menu: Start of VR Alpha![/h1]
In this update, we've added the very first VR menu. We've also started implementing SteamVR Input support and the beginnings of the VR alpha.

VR is still in development, so expect various features to not work at this time. We'll be continuing to add support for each Plaza game & Condo activity in future updates. You can keep track of our VR progress on our Trello here: https://trello.com/c/TJ4FbpZ1/620-vr-support

notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for March 20th, 2023, detailing all the changes that have happened since March 13th, 2023. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]Accessibility Suggestions[/h2]
We've created a forum post asking the community for suggestions on how we can improve gameplay for players with certain conditions such as colorblindness, dyslexia, or anything else that might affect a players ability to use the standard presentation and controls of the game.

notes.title: Libretro Lightgun & Touchscreens Update (0.16.6.1)
notes.content:
Libretro emulation has been taken to another level in this update with Lightgun support, Touchscreen support, Dual-Screen support, and Keyboard support!

[h1]Libretro Lightgun Support![/h1]

Lightgun support is now here! Works with new lightgun-enabled cabinets. A virtual lightgun will allow you to shoot in lightgun-enabled games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/58c5440df6ba61bb2557e86d2f6bd14269b32f1a.jpg[/img]

We added support for 8 emulators for lightgun games: Final Burn Neo, MAME 2010, NEStopia, SNES9x, Genesis Plus GX, Mednafen PSX, Flycast, and Opera

Our lightgun system will also automatically switch to the correct lightgun device for each game for you. No need to hassle with swapping devices.

We have 4 lightgun cabinets available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/c6808e69bc1a564b33ceb6ca7b88522713ca2d18.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/57d9cf588bc90ac853e6fb5d54816d74878b4f04.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2d49653856e2a78961abb786e9e9cf31e8078959.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/24dfcf5434c8a6fa1872a91b0bc1d03e250573c0.png[/img]


[h1]Touchscreen Support![/h1]

Touchscreen support is here and works with the two new dual-screen handhelds. Touchscreen support also comes with a virtual stylus and it is easy to toggle on and off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/83f6fd9b72f7f631337a7d406365178a410ecdd8.png[/img]

Touchscreen support only works for DeSmume and Citra emulators.



[h1]Dual-Screen Consoles Support![/h1]

We've created 2 portable dual-screen consoles for use with dual-screen emulators.

The Partycon 2S and the Partycon S3D!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e79c27617975630d2fe286f42d34246f1a0d0e6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b3a17fd6a5713511070dcb980db4bc55e6a7ee49.png[/img]

[h1]Keyboard Support![/h1]

DOSBox and Flycast now have full keyboard support. You can enable keyboard mode by going into Libretro Settings (Left Shift) and turning on Keyboard mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/03b861cc1909c0f6389f1eba1264736a2e28c0a7.png[/img]



[h1]TIC-80 and LowRes NX support![/h1]

Fantasy consoles TIC-80 and LowRes NX are now supported as additional Libretro cores.
TIC-80 games can be found at [url=https://tic80.com/play]https://tic80.com/play[/url]
LowResNX games can be found at: [url=https://lowresnx.inutilis.com/programs.php]https://lowresnx.inutilis.com/programs.php[/url]

You can also create your own TIC-80 and LowRes NX games to load into Tower Unite!


[h1]More Arcade Cabinet Customizations - Trackball, Flightsticks, coloring Joysticks, etc.[/h1]

Customize your digital arcade more with trackball, flightsticks and more coloring options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2cc2c8a70d205040cb8ff4d29fffc033ce7229bf.jpg[/img]



[h1]Groups Now Save[/h1]
For condo builders, groups now persistently save with your condo data! We also added group stashing support.

Groups allow you to combine items together so you can duplicate them or move them in one group.

How to group items: You can group items by selecting multiple items by holding Q, then click on an item. While holding Shift, you then click on additional items to multi-select them. Once you have all the items you want to group, press G to group them. You can ungroup by pressing U on a selected group.



[h1]Projector Bounce Lighting[/h1]

Projectors now have a more dynamic and advanced bounce lighting system that fills the room with lighting ambience from the screen's projection. The projector also now supports Libretro emulators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/55615ff0a7eaadf72c3e3f24c9e11df63c4e9e1e.gif[/img]




[h1]Libretro Core Changes[/h1]
[list][*] Citra now enables New mode
[*] Mednafen Super Grafx now supports CD images (.chd, .cue)
[*] MAME 2010[list][*] Added bind for MAME 2010 settings menu (F1), useful for getting into lightgun calibration settings[/list][*] DOSBox[list][*] Added full Keyboard support to DOSBox (enable using Settings > Keyboard Mode)[/list][*] Flycast[list][*] Added 30 FPS toggle for Flycast games that are running too fast. You can toggle this with Left Alt or Left Stick Down (L3)
[*] Added Keyboard support to Flycast (enable using Settings > Keyboard Mode)[/list][/list]


[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*] Libretro: Lightgun support! Works with new lightgun-enabled cabinets. A virtual light gun will allow you to shoot in lightgun-enabled games. Supports 8 consoles
[*] Libretro: Added full touchscreen support to Citra and DeSmuME on the new PartyCon 2S. Press Space to enable your mouse cursor for touch enabled games (comes with a virtual stylus!)
[*] Libretro: Added brightness setting to the settings menu and adjusted default brightness value
[*] Libretro: Added TIC-80 and LowRes NX core support
[*] Libretro: Added colorable support to portable handhelds
[*] Added PartyCon 2S to the Toy Stop, a portable dual screen console
[*] Added PartyCon S3D to the Toy Stop, a portable dual screen console
[*] Added Wireless Controller to Toy Stop, now you can control your game consoles from a distance or while in a seat
[*] Libretro: You can rotate the PartyCon 2S sideways with number keys, 1 (no rotation), 2 (rotate right), 3 (rotate left)
[*] Added -The Cowl- Lightgun Cabinet, Firing Range Lightgun Cabinet, Safety Glass Lightgun Cabinet to Toy Stop store
[*] Condo: Grouping items now saves to your condo save data
[*] Plaza: Added new Calendar to the Transit Station
[*] Added Shootout Saloon Lightgun Cabinet to Arcade store
[*] Added Toasty Cartridge Warmer console to Toy Stop store
[*] Added 3.5in Floppy Diskette, Disc Jewelcase to Rob's Imports
[*] Libretro: Added directory support to the rom lister, now you can organize games into subfolders for easier organization (and to have certain games work without colliding with other games)
[*] Libretro: Added 4:3 mode setting on Platformer Arcade Cabinet
[*] Libretro: You can now color the joysticks, buttons, and guns on Arcade Cabinets
[*] Libretro: Added 4 joysticks to the Bruiser Arcade Cabinet
[*] Libretro: Added Control Styles - Trackball, Flightstick, Dual Sticks to the Arcade Cabinets which allow you to visually adjust the controls of a cabinet
[*] Libretro: Added better zoom in handling. Now you can toggle zoom mode with the mouse wheel (or space bar) on arcade cabinets. Console cameras now can be zoomed in much more as well (using mouse wheel)
[*] Libretro: Projectors now work with game consoles
[*] Libretro: Various BIOs files will now be hidden from the game list
[*] Libretro: Lightgun devices are now automatically mapped based on the games that support them
[*] Libretro: Added lightgun support for Final Burn Neo
[*] Libretro: Added lightgun support for MAME 2010
[*] Libretro: Added lightgun support for NEStopia
[*] Libretro: Added lightgun support for SNES9x
[*] Libretro: Added lightgun support for Genesis Plus GX
[*] Libretro: Added lightgun support for Mednafen PSX
[*] Libretro: Added lightgun support for Flycast
[*] Libretro: Added lightgun support for Opera
[*] Bowling: Media players now clear their queue after the game is over
[*] Libretro: Slight improvements to cabinet materials
[*] Moved Notebook item to D.I.Y., moved Old TV to Rob's Imports and added an Electronics section to Rob's Imports
[*] Condo: Gizmo rotation snap setting now defaults to snapping at 15 degrees instead of just 1
[*] Projector now has more realistic dynamic bounce lighting that fills the room[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Plaza: Fixed Chainsaw Battle spawn points being wrong
[*] Bowling: Fixed media players showing media as "Unknown"
[*] Fixed Fishing Rod item not showing up in the Fishing Rod section in Gone Fishing Bait Shop
[*] Minigolf: Fixed the ocean in Cove from being overly dark and improved performance

tags.feature: Libretro emulation has been taken to another level in this update with Lightgun support, Touchscreen support, Dual-Screen support, and Keyboard support!
Lightgun support is now here! Works with new lightgun-enabled cabinets. A virtual lightgun will allow you to shoot in lightgun-enabled games.
We added support for 8 emulators for lightgun games: Final Burn Neo, MAME 2010, NEStopia, SNES9x, Genesis Plus GX, Mednafen PSX, Flycast, and Opera
Our lightgun system will also automatically switch to the correct lightgun device for each game for you. No need to hassle with swapping devices.
We have 4 lightgun cabinets available.
Touchscreen support is here and works with the two new dual-screen handhelds. Touchscreen support also comes with a virtual stylus and it is easy to toggle on and off.
Touchscreen support only works for DeSmume and Citra emulators.
We've created 2 portable dual-screen consoles for use with dual-screen emulators.
The Partycon 2S and the Partycon S3D!
DOSBox and Flycast now have full keyboard support. You can enable keyboard mode by going into Libretro Settings (Left Shift) and turning on Keyboard mode.
Fantasy consoles TIC-80 and LowRes NX are now supported as additional Libretro cores.
You can also create your own TIC-80 and LowRes NX games to load into Tower Unite!
Customize your digital arcade more with trackball, flightsticks and more coloring options.
For condo builders, groups now persistently save with your condo data! We also added group stashing support.
Groups allow you to combine items together so you can duplicate them or move them in one group.

How to group items: You can group items by selecting multiple items by holding Q, then click on an item. While holding Shift, you then click on additional items to multi-select them. Once you have all the items you want to group, press G to group them. You can ungroup by pressing U on a selected group.
Projectors now have a more dynamic and advanced bounce lighting system that fills the room with lighting ambience from the screen's projection. The projector also now supports Libretro emulators.
Citra now enables New mode
Mednafen Super Grafx now supports CD images (.chd, .cue)
Added bind for MAME 2010 settings menu (F1), useful for getting into lightgun calibration settings
Added full Keyboard support to DOSBox (enable using Settings > Keyboard Mode)
Added 30 FPS toggle for Flycast games that are running too fast. You can toggle this with Left Alt or Left Stick Down (L3)
Added Keyboard support to Flycast (enable using Settings > Keyboard Mode)

Added -The Cowl- Lightgun Cabinet, Firing Range Lightgun Cabinet, Safety Glass Lightgun Cabinet to Toy Stop store
Condo: Grouping items now saves to your condo save data
Plaza: Added new Calendar to the Transit Station
Added Shootout Saloon Lightgun Cabinet to Arcade store
Added Toasty Cartridge Warmer console to Toy Stop store
Added 3.5in Floppy Diskette, Disc Jewelcase to Rob's Imports

Libretro: Added 4:3 mode setting on Platformer Arcade Cabinet
Libretro: You can now color the joysticks, buttons, and guns on Arcade Cabinets
Libretro: Added 4 joysticks to the Bruiser Arcade Cabinet
Libretro: Added Control Styles - Trackball, Flightstick, Dual Sticks to the Arcade Cabinets which allow you to visually adjust the controls of a cabinet

Libretro: Added better zoom in handling. Now you can toggle zoom mode with the mouse wheel (or space bar) on arcade cabinets. Console cameras now can be zoomed in much more as well (using mouse wheel)

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.16.6.0
notes.content:
This update addresses various issues that came up from Update 0.16.6.0.

[h1]Libretro Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed save games not saving properly[/b]
[*] [b]Mednafen PSX & Yabause games longer cut off and display properly on the screens now[/b]
[*] [b]MAME 2010 emulator added[/b]

This adds a lot more compatibility and support for most 3D MAME games and CHD-based games!
Note: Final Burn Neo will still be chosen as the preferred emulator, if the game is supported, otherwise it’ll fall back to MAME 2010.

[*] [b]Citra updated to latest[/b]

With this update, it's added lots of compatibility updates, performance improvements, and C-Stick support!
Left Joystick is now functioning properly in Citra, allowing for games that use both the Joystick and D-Pad to function properly.

[*] [b]DeSmume now has a simulated touchscreen with the Right Stick[/b]
[*] [b]PPSSPP speed fixes have been made, fixing the emulator running 2X speed[/b]
[*] PPSSPP save data now functions
[*] Flycast now supports WinCE games, at least with the ones that are compatible with the emulator
[*] Virtual Jaguar will now automatically apply resolution fixes for certain games
[*] mGBA is now the preferred emulator, replacing VB Advance. This will help with performance with many demanding games
[/list]


[b]Changes/Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Libretro: Fixed save games not saving before resetting or switching games (SRAM now saves properly on emulation shutdown)
[*] Libretro: Added MAME 2010 core support (removed mame2003_plus core)
[*] Libretro: Added Citra core support (removed citra2018 core)
[*] Libretro: Added mGBA core support (removed vbam core)
[*] Libretro: Set core option for DeSmume to simulate touchscreen input with right stick (desmume_pointer_device_r = "emulated")
[*] Libretro: Fixed timing issues (rendering 2x speed) with 3D rendering in PPSSPP
[*] Libretro: Fixed save file issues with PPSSPP
[*] Libretro: Flycast now supports WinCE games
[*] Libretro: Added Keyboard Mode option to settings to enable full keyboard support for DOSBox
[*] Libretro: Fixed consoles that were not connected to media players connecting to media players on condo load
[*] Libretro: Consoles will no longer connect to a media player automatically if there is a console already plugged in
[*] Libretro: Fixed idlescreen artwork being placed on the glass material on the glass arcade cabinet
[*] Libretro: Fixed idlescreen artwork not being populated properly on arcade cabinets
[*] Libretro: Fixed non-host players not being able to access the settings menu
[*] Libretro: Fixed desaturation setting not applying to the dynamic light effects
[*] Libretro: Flycast rom searcher now supports GDI
[*] Libretro: Cartridges no longer respawn if respawn delay is set, if they are slotted into a console. The respawn delay timer will begin after ejected[/list]
