notes.title: November Quality of Life & Cove Update (0.14.6.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/dd996c0a6070edf138b9cd1fdeea3137697da1e1.png[/img]

[h1]Minigolf: Treasure Cove Revisited[/h1]
YARRRRRR! Treasure Cove has received a polishing update! This includes changes to course walls, updated art for the pirate ships, updated textures, and new lighting. And a skull! Head on over to Minigolf to check out all of the changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/4ed4132aae010d72bfab934f7dcd5d43dd57a8b9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Steam Migration[/h1]
This update will begin the process of moving all of your Tower Unite progress from Steam to our own systems. Your EXP and achievement progress will be transferred upon starting up the game. You will have a couple of prompts that will ask you to confirm your data migration. 

Note: Achievements will still be synced with Steam and will continue to appear on your profile, but they will also be backed up on our systems. Inventory will be migrated at a later date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2ae80ef2248d67fc097eb0bd5153ad13295ec639.png[/img]

[h1]Upcoming Thanksgiving Events!![/h1]
This week, we'll be doing a couple of double EXP and double ticket events. Wednesday & Thursday will be a double Fishing EXP event and Friday through Sunday will be a double Arcade ticket event. We'll announce both of these events on Wednesday!

[h1]Thanksgiving Items![/h1]
To celebrate turkey day, we have added a few turkey items to Celebrations and the Appearance store! Grab a Turkey Pet, Turkey Dinner, Turkey Hat, Turkey On Shoulder, and Flying Turkey Pet to join in on the festivities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/38d5ff870014dfc06d120f82c7f6f0e7fc069769.png[/img]

[h1]Workshop Browser: Trending, New, and Popular[/h1]
In this update, we've made navigating the Workshop items a little easier. We have now added buttons to quickly browse Trending, New, and Popular Workshop addons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/4c22b2f58793f4547fde75db38460119a6784ff5.png[/img]

[h1]Canvas Masked Mode[/h1]
Canvases now have a new mode: masked mode. Masked mode will allow you to have transparent canvas images that have lighting, shadows, and window support. We posted a couple examples of these in our latest developer log.

[h1]Canvas Improvements: Colorable Frames and Comments[/h1]
In this update, you can now color the canvas frames and set comments on your canvases. These comments will display in the center of the screen when a player looks at the canvas, allowing you to tell stories or detail what the canvas is to players.


[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*] Minigolf: Treasure Cove Art/Polishing Pass
[*] EXP and Achievement migration from Steam to our own backend. EXP will only be on our systems now (and backed up hourly). Achievements will sync with Steam, but our systems will keep track of them (and back them up hourly).
[*] Added new Thanksgiving items to Celebrations and Appearance: Turkey Pet, Turkey Dinner, Turkey Hat, Turkey On Shoulder, Flying Turkey Pet
[*] Added new items to the Toy Store: Flying Toy Robot Pet, Toy Robot Wings
[*] New EXP system that no longer relies on Steam's API services
[*] Improved light flicker setting on light items. Added Flicker 2, Flicker 3, Caustic, Dots, and Spots to light functions
[*] Added a "hide unlocked achievements" button in the collection book that lets you focus on achievements you have yet to unlock
[*] You can now use the camera item in any location of the Plaza, but sounds and effects will be muted indoors
[*] Arcade - Ice Cave: Added new feedback effects and a better trail to keep track of where the balls are going
[*] Workshop browser now has quick filter buttons for Trending, New, and Popular to help navigate all the workshop items quicker
[*] Minigolf golfball milestone: Added stroke HUD to keep track of your putts. Stroke count resets when you teleport as well
[*] Minigolf golfball milestone: Added reset button that will put your ball back to where you originally spawned it[/list]

[b]Misc Changes[/b]
[list][*] Workshop Editor: Improved overall lighting in the editor
[*] Workshop Editor: When re-importing a model, it will no longer clear existing metadata
[*] Workshop Editor: Added a button to reset all metadata on an item
[*] Workshop Editor: Added preview lighting settings such as day/night controls and front spot light adjustments so you can preview materials
[*] Added new mud footstep sounds
[*] Added new glass footstep sounds
[*] Added mud and water bullet impact sounds
[*] Improved Canvas Statue wood material
[*] Condo: Leaving seats is now done the same as the Plaza - with Left CTRL
[*] Ferris Wheel/Rollercoaster: Leaving seats is now done the same as other seats - with Left CTRL
[*] ZM: Improved flamethrower damage
[*] ZM: Increased Double Barrel damage to from 22 to 30 damage
[*] ZM: Double Barrel bullets now spread out a bit more
[*] ZM: Increased fire rate of Sawed Off (max starting weapon) from 0.8 seconds to 0.5 seconds[/list]

[b]Condo Changes[/b]
[list][*] Added Masked canvas type which allows you to have transparent images that still take in surrounding lighting. Also available for Canvas Statues
[*] Added comment option for canvas that allows you to add comments to the default canvas item. Comments will show up when a player hovers over the canvas. This can be useful to label canvas images or tell a story
[*] You can now increase the brightness of any light by 10 times
[*] You can now color the canvas frame
[*] You can now set transparency mode on any canvas primitive
[*] Added new Condo Materials: Wood Parquet Chevron, Wood Parquet Squares, Wood Parquet Straight, Metal Plates Riveted, Dirt 2, Tile Marble, Tower Threads Brick, Hard Wood Floor, Rough Rock, Flesh, Flesh Moving, Igneous rock
[*] Added reset button to light intensity setting
[*] Improved tool weapon selection outline
[*] Workshop item loading circles no longer draw through the entire world
[*] Added Workshop download progress bar that shows what Workshop addons are currently being downloaded while you are in a Condo[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list][*] Ball Race: CPU usage optimizations in Memories and GLXY
[*] Optimized the following items due to horrendous performance degradation coming from them: Diamond Trophies, Bowling Ball Rack, Fireplaces, Gem, Hot Chocolate, Tea, Toy Train, Water Bottle, Pile of Gold, Spin to Win
[*] Optimized teleporter items
[*] Optimized teleporter effects when the color is set to 0
[*] Optimized more items: Lightning in a Bottle, Pufferfish, Time Fish
[*] Various Plaza optimizations[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed anti-aliasing settings not saving/applying properly
[*] Fixed collection book not restoring to the page you currently were on after closing it
[*] Fixed getting up out of your current seat when pressing Use on another seat (you no longer get up)
[*] Ball Race - GLXY: Moving platforms will now be correctly synced between players, even when late joining
[*] Ball Race - Paradise: Moving platforms will now be correctly synced between players, even when late joining
[*] Ball Race - Memories: Moving platforms will now be correctly synced between players, even when late joining
[*] Ball Race: Fixed finish arrow colliding with the camera
[*] Ball Race: Fixed Anime Ball upgrade not being customizable (colors, material, glass should now work)
[*] Ball Race: Fixed team player (pressing a button) payout having a duplicated and unused payout. Also increased Team Player from 150 units to 500 units
[*] Little Crusaders: Fixed a bug where stamina wouldn't recharge at the faster rate when crouched while being scared
[*] Minigolf - Kingdom: Prop weapon racks no longer simulate physics
[*] Virus: Fixed crossbow shadow drawing even when holstered
[*] Virus: Fixed death indicator animation not playing (now will show who you killed when you kill an infected player)
[*] Virus: Fixed collision issues with Overtime
[*] ZM: Fixed start and end of Egon cannon effects being missing
[*] ZM: Fixed Kimber missing its laser beam
[*] ZM: Fixed flamethrower often times not dealing damage
[*] ZM: Fixed flamethrower effects not being full flames
[*] Fixed Baby Dragon Hat offset on skeleton player model
[*] Fixed Sword and Shield milestone not attaching properly to the Knight milestone
[*] Fixed some payouts missing descriptions
[*] Fixed FPS counter and notifications not showing up while in the main menu
[*] Fixed item setting number input slider not setting correctly when sliding it
[*] Workshop Editor: Fixed normal maps clearing when changing any metadata[/list]

[b]Condo/Item Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Condo - Highrise: Fixed pool water from extending below the pool floor and into the room below
[*] Condo - Highrise: Fixed not being able to toggle back on the waterfall
[*] Fixed right click view mode not working while a gizmo is active
[*] Fixed middle mouse click while having an active gizmo open causing issues with the view mode as well
[*] Fixed camera view mode (right click) not working while in gizmo mode
[*] Fixed multi-select clearing when clicking on a locked item (now it completely ignores locked items)
[*] Fixed light settings on String Lights not saving properly
[*] Fixed Rope items not toggling collision when using the disable collision feature
[*] Fixed Stingray and Sunfish not being pickupable
[*] Fixed physics items simulating physics when first placed
[*] Fixed physics items not simulating physics when the condo is reloaded or loaded from workshop (unless it is locked)
[*] Fixed Helicopter and Drivable Boat not having engine sounds
[*] Fixed Helicopter engine sounds not turning off properly
[*] Fixed Helicopter and Drivable Boat bug where if a player gets in the driver's seat while another player is already driving, it would break a lot of stuff
[*] Fixed Helicopter milestone not having collision
[*] Fixed Speed Boat milestone driving issues
[*] Fixed Inflatable Boat not keeping upright while in the water
[*] Fixed a major bug with the Speed Boat and Helicopter items that occurred when exiting them, it wouldn't actually exit you from driving and would cause all sorts of input issues
[*] Fixed Speed Boat milestone seat issues (now easier to sit in seats and the prompts are fixed)
[*] Fixed Speed Boat milestone not floating in water
[*] Fixed an issue with Speed Boat and Helicopter milestones where they would not respawn at their spawn location when moving the spawn points
[*] Fixed Spin To Win Home Edition not supporting canvas feature
[*] Fixed Hot Tub items not being placeable
[*] Fixed physics items floating always in the Underwater condo
[*] Fixed Stairs not saving canvas data that was set on it
[*] Fixed tool weapon selection outline clearing when hovering over an item that is currently selected by a tool
[*] Minigolf golfball milestone: Fixed zoom being horrendous (now it's not horrendous)
[*] Minigolf golfball milestone: Added keyboard/controller support that's exactly the same as normal minigolf
[*] Minigolf golfball milestone: Fixed the player not facing towards the golf ball as it moves through the world
[*] Minigolf golfball milestone: Fixed camera clipping too much
[*] Minigolf golfball milestone: Fixed adjusting camera rotation not hiding the cursor or aimer (and it doesn't update the power bar while you are adjusting your camera angle)
[*] Minigolf golfball milestone: Fixed putting sometimes not occurring, now it's just like minigolf
[*] Minigolf golfball milestone: TLDR the entire milestone is just like minigolf now
[*] Fixed orange tube item not being listed properly in the store and appearance menu
[*] Fixed Canvas Pile 2 and 3 not tiling properly
[*] Fixed canvases having a duplicate world align setting
[*] Fixed Canvas Wall not updating world align setting properly
[*] Fixed canvas animation settings sometimes not applying when changing world align settings
[*] Fixed Dead Bush variants not being colorable
[*] Fixed Heart Stool and Dining Chair not being colorable properly
[*] Fixed canvas applied to built in condo surfaces not updating properly in the selection UI
[*] Fixed surface editor applying the same surface again when opening the selection popup
[*] Fixed several condo surface materials not having footstep sounds or the correct type
[*] Fixed workshop condo upload screenshot camera sometimes capturing player models[/list]

[b]Hot Fix Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now manually input values into setting sliders
[*] Fixed certain EXP being incorrectly migrated
[*] Ball Race - Memories: Fixed moving platform speeds
[*] Fixed workshop pending download UI not updating immediately when pending downloads are completed
[*] Fixed item snapping not working
[*] Fixed Halloween 2021 remains not being exchangeable with King Arthritis
[/list]

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for October 18th, 2021
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for October 18th, 2021, detailing all the changes that have happened since October 11th, 2021. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]Steam Issues[/h2]

As you probably are aware by now, Tower Unite is currently experiencing issues with EXP, Item Transactions, and Achievements due to Steam's backend systems being unstable and unreliable.

We are currently working on migrating away from using Steam Inventory for items, as well as tracking EXP and Achievement unlocks on our own systems, instead of relying on the Steam Stats and Steam Achievements systems. 

As you can probably imagine, this is going to take some time, and we're unable to offer an ETA of when we'll be finished, but working on it is our top priority.

[h3]Background[/h3]

Steam offers developers various tools to use for developing their games: Achievements, Stats, Inventory, Networking, Workshop, and so much more. These tools are great to have for many developers, as they free up the developer from having to spend time to make these backend systems themselves, and instead allow the developer to focus on making the game they want to make.

When Tower Unite began development, we decided to use Steam Inventory for storing users' items, Steam Stats for storing users' EXP and other stats, along with utilizing Steam Achievements. Steam provides these tools to developers in the form of an API, and using this API we can tell Steam to do things and Steam will do them. We have our own backend system called the AGC that interfaces with these Steam APIs.

As many gamers who use Steam are aware, on Tuesdays, Valve performs maintenance on Steam's backend servers. These maintenances can last anywhere from two minutes to several hours, and when they are happening most of Steam is often unavailable for users. 

On Tuesday, October 12th, 2021, upon the completion of Steam's maintenance, we got a couple reports from users stating that they were having issues obtaining items. As we typically get some of these reports on a Tuesday, we didn't think much of it. 

The next day, Wednesday, October 13th, 2021, we released the Halloween update, and with the influx of users that our holiday events bring, we immediately began observing issues across the board. It is important to note that, for the Halloween update, none of our backend code that interfaced with Steam was changed at all. Code that worked fine for months suddenly stopped functioning correctly.

[h3]What's happening?[/h3]

Steam's API, like many APIs, uses HTTP Status Codes to denote if a particular action was successful or not. An HTTP Status Code of 200 indicates to our backend system that the action we asked Steam to take has occurred successfully, while an HTTP status code of 500 indicates to us that Steam is having issues with their servers. 

Our backend system, the AGC, handles these errors. However, since the Steam maintenance on October 12th, our AGC is telling Steam to do actions, and Steam responds that it has performed those actions, along with a HTTP status code of 200, but, in actuality, it either hasn't done the action, or the action ends up being delayed by hours.

Our systems cannot function properly when the API we trust to perform actions for us is not being truthful about what it is actually doing. Due to this, anytime we ask Steam to give a user an item, or take an item away, give a user EXP, or grant an achievement, Steam isn't cooperating with us.

It's not only our backend systems that are being affected by this. When a user boots up Tower Unite and looks at their inventory, their game client is using the Steam API directly to get their Steam Inventory information. Steam is only sending some users part of their inventory, or none of it at all, leading the user to believe that they have lost all their items.

[h3]What are we doing about it?[/h3]

Last Friday, October 15th, 2021, at around noon, we sent a support ticket to Valve using their dedicated developer panel. As of the time of this posting, we have not received any response.

Since the API is currently unreliable and unstable, and given the fact that it has a tendency to go down without any developer support, we have no choice but to move all Tower Unite users' inventories off of Steam Inventory, and onto our own systems. In addition, we can no longer rely on Steam accurately updating user's EXP or granting a user's achievements, so we're going to have to start tracking that on our end as well. If it sounds like a lot of work, it is, but it's now our top priority. 

We're just as frustrated as you are about the current situation, and this will probably lead to a delay to what we were planning for the second phase of the Halloween Events, but it's work that we have to do for the stability of Tower Unite.

So, to reiterate, our current plan is as follows:

[list]
[*] Migrate user stats off of Steam Stats to our own stat system.
[*] Migrate tracking of achievements onto our own systems.
[*] Migrate user inventories off of Steam Inventory to our own inventory system.
[/list]

There is an upside to doing all of this on our own: it should hopefully make transactions and item purchases faster, while also making it easier for us to work on the Community Condos feature, which would require shared inventories.

We're hopeful that sometime this week, Valve will issue a fix for this issue, allowing for smoother sailing while we create the new backend systems required for handling this data. 

We'll continue to keep you all posted on our status page, which can be found [url=https://towerunite.statuspage.io/]here[/url].

[h2]August / September 2021 Survey Results![/h2]
Thank you again to everyone who participated in our survey. We had a whopping 6,700+ responses!

You can view the results of this survey [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/august-september-2021-survey-results/43460]here[/url].

notes.title: Halloween 2021 Events! (0.14.5.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/22b3f8ce309c736575467a2daa3512d0580a6a43.png[/img]

[h1]HALLOWEEN 2021 EVENTS ARE HERE![/h1]

[h1]Halloween Plaza 2021[/h1]
The plaza is decked out for another spooky Halloween event! 
Enjoy the haunted festivities by collecting remains, finding bones, and unlocking various Halloween exclusive items. Be sure to check out the Ghoulcery, because it is back again with new items for you to spend your Ghoul Coins on. And, if you search the coast line, you’ll see that a maze has once again surfaced to be explored!

[h1]Halloween Achievements, EXP & Milestones are back[/h1]
Last year we added various Halloween-exclusive achievements, EXP, and milestones, and they're back again this year. Participate in new quests and scavenger hunts throughout the plaza to earn them, and be sure to check them out in your collection book, too! You can earn Halloween EXP for participating in Halloween events such as Halloween minigames, collecting candy or remains, completing Halloween achievements, and completing Halloween quests!

As you increase your Halloween EXP, you can unlock Halloween milestones such as throwable blood wine and a drivable Minecart!

[h1]Return of the Ghoul Coins[/h1]
While playing games in Tower Unite during this year's Halloween event, you'll earn Ghoul Coins. These coins can be redeemed in the Plaza for Halloween items. You can earn them by playing Plaza minigames or Game Worlds. This year you can earn Ghoul Coins at the Arcade and through Fishing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/d0be7bcd98b7f603cbee934da0327e43cd4f2402.png[/img]

[h1]Halloween Minigames[/h1]
The Plaza minigames have not been left out of the Halloween fun. Participate in the Ghost Hunting and Pumpkin Smash minigames on the Event platform, and you uncover a lot of pumpkins along the way!

[h1]Lots of New Items[/h1][list][*] [b]Added to the Ghoulcery store[/b]: Throwable Test Tube, Alien Backpack, Test Tube Hat, Candy Backpack, SombrerUFO, The Experiment's Head, Bones Hat, Tinfoil Hat, Bubble Helmet, Gelatin Cube, Candy Particles, Blood-stained Hockey Mask, Alien Glasses, Scarecrow Hat, Ballerina Tutu, Scifi Filter Visor, Detective Hat, Moustache, Crow on Shoulder, Crow Plush, Abduction, Candy Bucket Hat, Angel Plush, Devil Plush, Angel Pet, Devil Pet, Eternal Questioning Angel and Devil, and the Spooky Wowozela!
[*] [b]Available only from Halloween events[/b]: Candy Cane, Candy Bar, Candy Corn, Blue Cake Pop, Pink Cake Pop, Mint Cake Pop, Chocolate Milk, Cinnamon Stick, Gummie, Hot Chocolate, Ice Cream, Pumpkin Pie, Blue Rock Candy, Green Rock Candy, Pink Rock Candy, Waffle Cone, Peppermint Lollipop, Gem Pop, Round Lollipop, Flat Lollipop, Aesthetic Chips
[*] [b]Added to the Appearance store[/b]: Hockey Mask
[*] [b]Added to the Celebrations store[/b]: Wooden Test Tube Rack, Plastic Test Tube Rack, Chains, Eyeball Stalk, Fire, Gravestone Sign, Tooth
[*] [b]Added to the Ball Race Upgrades store[/b]: Anime Ball Race Ball[/list]

[h1]Multi-select is here![/h1]
We've been hard at work adding improvements to the condo building system and this update includes a powerful new tool - multi-select! Now you can hold down shift and select multiple items at once with the gizmo system, and drag, rotate, and even copy items all at once with the alt-drag feature! Got a desk with 15 screens on it? With multi-select you can select your desk, all 15 screens and move it into another room all without ruining their positions.



Be on the look out for more Halloween updates coming later towards the end of this month!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/a9ebe9acff60b61ac7c281512a307cea576091aa.png[/img]

[b]Changes[/b][list][*] New Halloween 2021 items available at the Ghoulcery Store
[*] Multi-select! Select multiple items and move them with the gizmos! You can also copy the selection with the drag copy feature
[*] Laser Projector optimizations
[*] Condo: While gizmos are open, surface editing will be disabled to avoid confusion
[*] Condo: Moved drag copy to the alt key (was shift key) to prevent accidental copying with the new multi-select
[*] Condo: Gizmos no longer lose input when dragging over other UI elements (such as the inventory UI)
[*] Condo: While dragging a gizmo, the mouse will now infinitely loop around the screen, allowing you to keep dragging for as long as you need to
[*] Condo: Gizmos now scale up/down based on camera position, keeping them a steady constant size on the screen at all times
[*] Condo: You no longer can open edit menu (with middle click) on locked items[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list][*] Fixed bonfire items not having customizable light colors and settings
[*] Fixed bonfire showing use prompt even when you didn't have permission
[*] Fixed issues with Planetary Piano inputs getting dropped
[*] Fixed the Book Pile 2 item not being available in Rob's imports
[*] Ball Race: Fixed moving platform desyncs between players in Nimbus
[*] Ball Race: Fixed moving platform desyncs between players in Oasis
[*] Fixed workshop player models sometimes assigning to workshop condo items
[*] Fixed NPC models defaulting to workshop mode when setting as a non-workshop model
[*] Fixed several weapon items not being disabled by the no weapon milestone condo permission
[*] Fixed the floating items not being synced with other clients (now float the same for everyone)
[*] Fixed Kitchen Tiles world align material
[*] Fixed candle draw distance being incredibly small[/list]

notes.title: Private Theaters and Laser Tag Arena Update (0.14.4.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2d0a734f88600c87aac3355a1bf67f57f891aa9b.png[/img]

[h1]Laser Tag Revamp[/h1]
Laser Tag has a new look! Maneuver your way around the new sea and space themed arena, fending off the opposing teams around new terrain, including more ramps, barriers, and vantage points! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/63e67129983f52916559cea8ccf6913434ae2a8e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b7900ddf20df97fc99f0b9820d2a588f5efdbdfe.png[/img]

The teams and their respective hubs have also been given a color update, to make them more visible. Charging stations should be clearer as well. 

More updates to Laser Tag gameplay will come in a future update!

[h1]Private Theaters[/h1]
The long awaited private theater system is now here! Just like the Volt Nightclub’s karaoke rooms, you can now rent out a theater space for you and your friends to enjoy videos in the Plaza together privately. You can also invite others in by answering their knocking at the door!

Enjoy the full theatre experience by grabbing a drink at the in-theater bar and selecting light options at the settings panel by the door to set the mood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/794afefcfb57e21175083afacc02f835aa781a21.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/8b4291174b6ed586bfbafb57cc96b0f628cc2fa5.png[/img]

[h1]New Condo Surface Editor[/h1]
The surface editor now displays all the materials in a larger way, making it easier to find materials. It also keeps track of the currently selected surface, along with automatically highlighting the current surface. It supports canvases and displays canvases for fast access to already used canvases. Several bugs have been ironed out as well, along with many surfaces having world align variants that they previously did not have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/021804bd44b6608673cc89f12d62acd1d80b628c.png[/img]

[h1]Various Bug Fixes[/h1]
One of our main focuses for this update was bug fixes, and it sports quite a few. We've gone through and resolved several collision bugs, voice chat issues, workshop load-in issues for condos, and much more.


[b]Changes[/b][list][*] Private Theaters!
[*] New Laser Tag Arena!
[*] Plaza: Added hot tubs to the rooftop
[*] Plaza: Improved minigame plane physics and turning (as well as the RC plane)
[*] Plaza: One of the bowling alley NPCs, Darien, has gotten a new unique character model
[*] Plaza: Moved pool tubes into the beach store
[*] Casino: High Roller room now has its own media player
[*] Theater: Improved theater seats, made it easier to get out of them (now can use CTRL like all other seats), and you can use the media queue and your inventory while in the seat
[*] Theater: Moved down the handrails so they don't block the seat view
[*] Updated water FX: Transition between above/below water states is more seamless
[*] Reduced amount of things blocked players can emit noise from while blocked
[*] Water splash effects now scale volume and splash effects based on how fast the player/object enters the water. Also physics items now properly do splash effects
[*] RC cars and vehicles now support ramps (instead of just falling down to the ground instantly)[/list]

[b]Condo Changes[/b][list][*] Condo: New & improved surface editor
[*] Condo: Surface editor now has a new section for canvases. It will now list all active canvases that you can select as a surface for easier selection
[*] Condo: Added these new condo surfaces: Pool Tile, Grass Condo, Concrete Condo, Concrete Dirty, Smooth Metal, Plaza Glass, Highrise Column, Marble, Marble Beige, Plain, Wood Tile, Fireplace, Garage Floor, Marble Tile, Tile Floor, Chrome, Deck, Roof, Trim (wood), Pool Floor Tile, Pool Tile 3, Pool Tile Wall, Parquet Wood, Marble Floor, Tile Floor 2, Lobby Wall Tile, Fine Wood, Wood Basic, Kitchen Tiles, Smooth Dirt Concrete, White, Tile, Planks, Theater Tiles, Theater Tiles Striped, Theater Ceiling Tiles, Theater Wall Tiles, Building Plaster, Gasoline Tile, Glass Cracked, Old House Walls 1-5, Dirty Floor, Dirty Plaster, Dirt, Forest Floor, Moss 2, Torn Floor, Rotten Floor, Rotten Carpet, Rubble, Noise, Metal Wall, Metal Floor, Fire, Reflection, Dock Wood, Old Brick, Cabin Roof, Cobblestone, Vaporwave Tile, Arcade Carpet 2, Rainbow Light, Rainbow Gradient, Stripe Wallpaper, Star Ceiling, Fake Interior, Fake Interior 2, Fake Interior No Glass, Fake Interior Blinds, Building Windows, Building Windows 2, Grass & Stone, Grass & Stone 2, Burnt, LC Brick Wall, Sandy Rock, Sandy Rock 2, Forest Greens, Nightclub Tile, Nightclub Fabric, Diamond, Light Gradient, Conveyor, Rope, Rope 2, Rope Fence, Resort Roof, Dock Planks, Light Row, Town Carpet, Hay, Metal Grating, Metal Wall Grate, Warning Stripes, Lighthouse Glass, Mansion Wallpaper, Mansion Foyer Wallpaper, Peeling Wallpaper, Concrete Wall Stripe, Sparkles, Old Plaster
[*] Condo: Teleporter items no longer make a noise
[*] Condo: You can now toggle off the platform of Smooth Dirt
[*] Condo: Added new shadow setting: Placeable Dynamic Shadows, which toggles on dynamic shadows for placeable light items in Condos
[*] Condo: Underwater condo's visuals and water transition effects have been improved and optimized
[*] Condo: Added setting to disable/enable shadows per light (placeable point lights will have shadows disabled by default)
[*] Condo: Middle clicking on items will now immediately open the edit menu for the item
[*] Condo: Item Finder now groups items by default
[*] Condo: Reorganized the editor buttons such as undo/redo and advanced edit mode to be all in one line, reducing the vertical space the condo inventory takes up
[*] Condo: By holding the right mouse button, you can now rotate the camera while the inventory or an edit item menu is open. 
[*] Condo: Improved outline effects for editing surfaces and items
[*] Condo: Edit surface tooltip no longer displays while you are in gizmo state[/list]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b][list][*] Accelerate: Vastly improved ramps and fixed desyncs relating to ramps, ensuring karts will always get properly launched off ramps
[*] Little Crusaders: While scared, Knights will continue to run the same speed as they sprint, regardless if their stamina is out
[*] Little Crusaders: Dragon roar no longer scares Knights who are behind walls or crouched behind objects
[*] Virus - Subway: Updated lighting and atmosphere
[*] Virus: Improved outline effects
[*] ZM: Reduced Electrician's turret upgrade range by about 40-50%
[*] ZM: Increased zombie spawn rates for games that have more than 3 players
[*] Laser Tag: Improved outline effect for recharge stations
[*] Laser Tag: Team Aqua is now Team Solar to keep the teams equal visibility wise
[*] Laser Tag: When a player is tagged out they will now go completely invisible until they recharge[/list]

[b]Major Bug Fixes[/b][list][*] Fixed other player's head up/down movements, flashlight angles, and laser pointers not animating for the condo host
[*] Fixed head rotation being very broken while in a seat
[*] Fixed players sometimes having frozen animations
[*] Zombie Massacre: Fixed players sometimes not spawning at the boss spawns
[*] Condo: Fixed NPC workshop models not loading sometimes and defaulting to a t-pose character
[*] Condo: Fixed workshop items being applied to a different item when editing a workshop model
[*] Fixed voice chat repeating when voice is muted, or voice switches between 2D/3D modes, or if the player is far
[*] Fixed an issue where the waiting for players menu wouldn't show up after level traveling[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list][*] Plaza: Fixed rooftop elevator door being smaller than it should be
[*] Plaza: Removed cabinet models that were spawning behind a wall of the furniture store
[*] Plaza: Fixed an arcade high score screen that had a light bisecting it
[*] Bowling: Fixed ceiling lights drawing on the floor which made the floor very distracting
[*] Plaza: Fixed minigames not respawning players above the ground sometimes after a game ended
[*] Condo: Fixed teleporter visual arrow representation blocking item traces
[*] Fixed RC tank materials being missing
[*] Plaza: Fixed not being able to drive up the central fountain stairs using RC vehicles
[*] Condo: Fixed Canvas Cubes not having world align setting on by default
[*] Condo: Fixed disabling collision option only working for hosts
[*] Bowling: Fixed missing wall in Bowling lane #8
[*] Item: Fixed Holdable Balloon not attaching properly for the knight milestone
[*] The Stray: Fixed Magic Trampoline not being listed properly when selecting magic tools at The Stray
[*] Milestone: Fixed Ghost milestone using the old ghost model
[*] Condo: Fixed Teleport absolute rotation setting not being copied properly by Copycat
[*] Condo - Suite: Removed weird floating support beams where the patio roof is
[*] Condo - Suite: Fixed staircase corner being overly bright/not the same texture as the rest of the staircase wall
[*] Condo - Suite: Fixed z clipping in upstairs area
[*] Condo - House: Fixed doors sometimes being desynced and open for clients (but closed for the host)
[*] Condo: Fixed some color issues with the search bar and item finder inventory UI
[*] Condo: Fixed Sand material not being in the nature category
[*] Condo: Fixed Arcade carpet material not tiling or world aligning
[*] Condo: Removed duplicate Plaza brick materials and added a wet variation
[*] Condo: Fixed several materials missing icons
[*] Condo: Fixed Limestone Dark Tile material not being as reflective as it should be
[*] Condo: Fixed sliding roof not saving if it's closed or not in the condo save data
[*] Condo: Fixed some items not having the ability to toggle their collision
[*] Condo: Fixed various condo surface materials not having tiling or colorable support. Specifically these: Fence, Grey Carpet, Metal Trim, Casino Wall, Cosmic, Lava 1 & 2, all the grass, Mud, Moss, Sand, Acid, Boost, Nightclub screens, Celebrations Rug, Slime, Swift Field, Oasis Tile, Paradise Wood Wall, probably a few others. Note: You may have to reapply a few of these surfaces to see the changes take place (such as grass 1, grass 2, metal trim)
[*] Plaza: Fixed not being able to interact with media players while in a seat 
[*] Plaza: Fixed an issue with seats where you could be stuck in seat mode, but not actually in the seat (requiring you to press leave seat again)
[*] UI: Fixed key prompts not hiding when in HUD hide mode
[*] Items: Fixed hot tub items allowing you to toggle lights off/on with use (now only does the seat aspects). You can still toggle lights off/on using the item settings menu
[*] Game Worlds: Fixed voice chat in game worlds not adjusting volume properly with the volume slider
[*] Condo: Fixed tiny potion item spawning in the condo
[*] Item: Fixed Wowozela effects not coming out of player faces and also having different positions when switching between first person and third person
[*] Item: Fixed outdoor wood bench item not having seats
[*] Appearance: Fixed feminine summer outfit not being selectable
[*] Milestone: Fixed turret milestone not firing for clients (and players not sitting down correctly)
[*] Milestone: Fixed turret milestone seat causing players to get put outside of the map in certain scenarios
[*] Milestone: Fixed turret milestone lacking muzzle flash effects
[*] Condo: Fixed canvas animations not working for canvas flags and canvas screen types
[*] Condo: Fixed Transdimensional Painting being different for client and host while in absolute rotation mode
[*] Milestone: Fixed minigolf milestone item camera being really slow
[*] Arcade: Fixed not being able to play arcade games properly while having the ghost, knight, or monster potion milestones equipped
[*] Plaza only: Fixed leaving Plaza seats resetting your camera/position to a weird location. Now it will put you back where you were before you sat down[/list]

[b]Game World Bug Fixes[/b][list][*] Accelerate - Sunrise Isles: Fixed ramp just before the finish line not always launching karts properly
[*] Accelerate - Pine Valley Track 2: Fixed ramp across the main bridge not always launching karts properly
[*] Accelerate - Pine Valley: Improved rock collisions on track 1
[*] Accelerate - Pine Valley: Fixed a few areas where you wouldn't go out of bounds on track 2
[*] Accelerate: Fixed golf hole eating items that weren't thrown (for example if you drove over a golf hole while holding a bowling ball that you haven't used yet, it would eat the bowling ball)
[*] Minigolf - Garden: Fixed railings not having their original bounciness (before the art pass), causing many HIOs being hard or impossible to get
[*] Ball Race - Prism: Fixed getting stuck on a railing segment on level 11
[*] Ball Race: Improved camera fade out system to work more reliably and with multiple platforms blocking the camera
[*] Ball Race - Oasis: Fixed level 1 brides fading out incorrectly
[*] Ball Race - Oasis: Fixed level 7 rotating segments incorrectly fading out too early/not reliably
[*] Ball Race - Oasis: Improved collisions for level 2 to ensure you can't get stuck inside of the tube cage part
[*] Ball Race - Prism: Fixed an issue where you could get stuck between the railings and platforms on level 14
[*] Ball Race - Oasis: Fixed getting stuck on an exit tube in level 2
[*] Little Crusaders - Market: Fixed a collision issue where you can get stuck in the corner above the stairs leading down to the sewers
[*] Little Crusaders - Market: Fixed ivy having collision
[*] Little Crusaders - Market: Fixed rock floor trim collisions bouncing the camera up and down
[*] Little Crusaders - Throne Room: Fixed various collision issues
[*] Little Crusaders - Throne Room: Fixed a hole in the level on the stairs
[*] Little Crusaders - Amphitheatre: Fixed missing rock collision for some small rocks hanging off the bridge edges
[*] Little Crusaders - Amphitheatre: Fixed several small visual holes and z fighting
[*] Little Crusaders - Amphitheatre: Optimization pass
[*] Little Crusaders - Amphitheatre: Improved collision for stairs to avoid getting players stuck in corners while going up the stairs
[*] Little Crusaders - Knightsend-by-sea: Fixed a couple dragon camping spots
[*] Little Crusaders - Toy Room: Fixed several collisions regarding cards and tracks, along with some optimizations
[*] Little Crusaders - Mystic Grove: Fixed several collision issues with rocks and wheelbarrows
[*] Little Crusaders - Mystic Grove: Rocks that players slip on now have a more distinct texture compared to rocks you don't slip off of, also reduced some rocks that you slip off of that got a bit confusing
[*] Little Crusaders - Mystic Grove: Fixed the fire pit burning you when you weren't near the fire pit
[*] Little Crusaders - Mystic Grove: Fixed various parts of the ground being too steep to walk up
[*] Little Crusaders - Mystic Grove: Fixed bad collision in cave rocks
[*] Little Crusaders: Fixed dragon not regaining stamina if out of stamina when in air and sprint key is still held down
[*] Virus - Overtime: Fixed a few graphical bugs
[*] Zombie Massacre: Fixed controller rumble occurring when another player fires their weapons
[*] Zombie Massacre: Fixed placeable equipment sometimes not scaling in for clients[/list]

If you have any ideas or suggestions, and possible solutions on how to solve a particular issue, please check out the forum post [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/accessibility-related-suggestions-megathread/40333]here[/url].

[h2]Update 0.14.4.0[/h2]
Work continues on the next update to Tower Unite, Update 0.14.4.0, which will introduce the Private Theaters, rent-able private screens for you and your friends complete with a bar, along with the new Laser Tag arena!

In addition, this update will include TONS of quality of life changes and bug fixes.

You can view our current progress on this update [url=https://trello.com/c/Z73Abvu5/619-update-01440]here[/url].

[h2]Condo Improvements[/h2]

[h3]New Condo Surface Editor![/h3]

[b]macdguy[/b] worked on a new and improved condo surface editor. This new editor boosts many new features and improvements.

The surface editor now displays all the materials in a larger way, making it easier to find materials.
It also keeps track of the currently selected surface, along with automatically highlighting the current surface. It supports canvases and displays canvases for fast access to already used canvases. Several bugs have been ironed out as well, along with many surfaces having world align variants that they previously did not have.

[b]Madmijk[/b] has been working on optimizing the Laser Projectors, as well as giving users the ability to optimize their own Laser Projectors. 

[previewyoutube=ozVlJ8VNdTE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Hot Fix 0.14.3.2
notes.content:
This update addresses several bugs from the new update.

[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*] RC and vehicle cameras no longer follow directly behind the vehicle and also handle hills a lot better, like Accelerate does
[*] RC and ground based vehicles now have drifting! Just press shift to drift while turning
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list][*] Virus - Hospital: Fixed stairs collision
[*] Arcade: Completely reworked Coloracle's networking
[*] Arcade: Fixed a race condition with Candy Slam sometimes causing erroneous point deductions
[*] Arcade: Fixed Coloracle "Pink Season" achievements not firing off
[*] Arcade: Fixed the Dragon's Treasure and Meteoroid Mania bonus wheels sometimes landing on the wrong item
[*] Arcade - Salmon Says: Fixed the blue button not lighting up properly

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for August 23rd, 2021
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for August 23rd, 2021, detailing all the changes that have happened since August 16th, 2021. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]Summer Characters are Back![/h2]
Summer is here and the summer characters are back and visiting the Plaza once again! Talk with them to get free items and units.

[h2]Arcade: Phase 2 OUT NOW![/h2]

[previewyoutube=hFwTB_D3E6g;full][/previewyoutube]

Last week, we released Arcade: Phase 2, complete with 8 new games, along with various other improvements! You can read all about that update [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/394690/view/4150616678123695659]here[/url]!

We also released a few hot fixes to fix issues that came up from the initial update.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/394690/view/2968422316513130272]Hot Fix 0.14.3.1 Changelog[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/394690/view/2968422316515342266]Hot Fix 0.14.3.1.1 Changelog[/url]

We're also working on a new hot fix to address even more issues, you can check the progress on this hot fix [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/update-0-14-3-2/42960]here[/url].

[h2]August / September 2021 Survey![/h2]
We want to hear from YOU! We want to get your opinions on Tower Unite as we discuss Tower's future!

Let your voice be heard on our survey, which can be found [url=https://forms.gle/vNLL3URyfAeVWH8f7]here[/url].

This survey will be closed on September 15th, 2021!

[h2]August / September 2021 Art Contest![/h2]
We're running another art contest this month!

Try your hand at creating Tower Unite related art, paintings, pixel art, and more!

All participants may be awarded participation prizes, with the winner netting 1,000,000 units!

You can read all of the rules and requirements [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/august-september-2021-art-contest/42940]here[/url]!

[h2]Accessibility Suggestions[/h2]
We've created a forum post asking the community for suggestions on how we can improve gameplay for players with certain conditions such as colorblindness, dyslexia, or anything else that might affect a players ability to use the standard presentation and controls of the game. 

If you have any ideas or suggestions, and possible solutions on how to solve a particular issue, please check out the forum post [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/accessibility-related-suggestions-megathread/40333]here[/url].

[h2]Arcade - Phase 2[/h2]
[b]macdguy[/b] worked on getting Arcade: Phase 2 released, and worked on releasing the hotfixes. He re-wrote the logic for "Coloracle 2: Whose Hue?" to reduce issues on crowded servers.

[b]JJosh[/b] continued working on Arcade plushes, prizes, and NPCs.

[b]Madmijk[/b] worked on bug fixes for the arcade.

[h2]Plaza: Shooting Gallery Ride[/h2]
[b]Johanna[/b] continued working on the Shooting Gallery ride.

[b]Wheezwer[/b] worked on murals for the Shooting Gallery ride.

notes.title: Arcade Phase 2! (0.14.3.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/6a743016b855ae8f4e105a3eb1c57146031c85b1.png[/img]

[h1]Arcade: Phase 2[/h1]
Phase 2 brings 8 new games, including 2 coin pushers! This update took us a lot of time as each game is fully networked and synced in multiplayer! Each one of these games is unique to the Arcade! We hope you enjoy these new games!

[previewyoutube=hFwTB_D3E6g;full][/previewyoutube]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/31eb1d25cc3355ec92cef185bb9c189928c3e808.png[/img][/td]
        [td][h2]Dragon's Treasure[/h2]
Coin Pusher with pachinko elements!

[i]Sometimes, a dragon has some treasure. Sometimes, that treasure should be shared. Mostly because the dragon probably stole it from you in the first place.

Luckily, Gerald the dragon doesn’t mind - So long as you can get the coins through his maze of tricks. 

Light up all 6 of the dragon's precious gems and the wheel of treasure will spin. If you wake the dragon, Gerald will add more to your push for treasure.[/i]
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/2597374bf83397a1dda5b4b232efcb4192e375c5.png[/img][/td]
        [td][h2]Coin River[/h2]
Coin Pusher with a coin gun!

[i]A long time ago, there was gold in a river. We’ve been told it was a pretty big deal. So, live the dream yourself by playing Coin River!

And don’t forget to remind yourself of the river’s importance by spelling out the word RIVER to begin launching more gold into your bucket![/i]
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/277ab6ac8923456065888a7ece4a230418afc059.png[/img][/td]
        [td][h2]Coloracle 2: Whose Hue?[/h2]
Roulette-like Guessing Game

[i]The wheel of fate is spinning. Can you decide what color it will land on? Step on in and experience COLORACLE 2. The sequel to the hit classic color deciding game COLORACLE 1: Hue's Saturation?

Select a color and hope the ball lands on the color. You will be rewarded with riches BEYOND EARTHLY IMAGINATIONS![/i]
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/bd102e03a6dea77044f66846b753200dea459f1b.png[/img][/td]
        [td][h2]Gears of Coin[/h2]
Coin Drop Game

[i]Do your duty to mankind: Unclog the machine. The gears cannot keep turning without you! 

And yes, you will be compensated, you feeble mortal.

This machine has no shortage of coins, it makes no cents. Be part of the revolution of the gear wars and become the light at the end of the funnel for the resistance treasurers. Grab a coin and slide down the hierarchy of the rich in the economic gaps and wealth inequality of trickle down economics.[/i]
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b2d2688acbb1af0067b0c7c834cb260184b9b514.png[/img][/td]
        [td][h2]Prismatic[/h2]
Pachinko-like Ball Drop Game

[i]It's a maze out there. Life. It's so hard to navigate.

That's why we invested in cutting-edge maze technology that will amaze you for all the days to come. Traverse through these carefully, hand picked, and locally sourced walls that will spin your head and put a smile on your beautiful face.[/i]
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/b1065fe7fcb516c7463c5340a31abe693122a137.png[/img][/td]
        [td][h2]Candy Slam[/h2]
Time Skill Multiplayer Game

[i]Have you ever wanted to punch candy in the face? Now you can. 

This candy must be punched off of the conveyor belts and into the candy piles to be safely packaged! It’s the only way to keep things interesting.

Don't punch anything else but candy though, we don't want any of that,[/i]
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/bf1759e8f4517f8e9d5686de73f4697388aca24c.png[/img][/td]
        [td][h2]Mas Feurte 2K[/h2]
Strong Hammer Test Game

[i]You are strong. But are you 2K strong? 

I didn’t think so. At least not yet.

Keep your mouse centered on the landing circle and press as many keys on your keyboard as you can within a short amount of time. Don't let up! The power meter will fill up the more you mash.[/i]
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/3dd9a3492482a13612312fcd29e78e5fef0b785f.png[/img][/td]
        [td][h2]Ultimate Cow Wheel[/h2]
Prize Pusher

[i]The cows are back FOR REVENGE. After centuries of being abducted by aliens, the cows have studied sorcery and magic. The aliens continue to invade their lands and attempt to graze on the cow's RIGHTFULLY OWNED GRASS! The cows will not stand for this any longer! The ULTIMATE revolution has begun!

Help the cows steal and destroy the alien UFOs and be rewarded with tickets. Grab the more important UFOs for larger rewards. And if you're feeling bold, grab letters and spell out M I L K to amplify the cows and bask in the milky goodness of the jackpot.[/i]

[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h1]Improved Voice Chat[/h1]
We've resolved lots of connection issues with voice chat in this update, including resolving various issues with hearing players while in Game Worlds. We've also made Virus and Little Crusaders use localized voice, allowing for more immersion and team planning.

[h1]Improved Workshop Browser[/h1]
The workshop browser no longer has pages! The browser will automatically fetch addons as you scroll down the list and it remembers where you were! Now you can easily see hundreds of workshop models with ease. We've also optimized the browser, massively improving FPS while using the workshop browser.

[h1]Improved Controller support for Zombie Massacre[/h1]
Controller support for Zombie Massacre has been improved. Aiming for controllers is now fixed. We've also added custom rumble feedback for each weapon. With the rumble feedback, you'll feel a difference in power when using shotguns, machine guns, and even explosions. We'll be continuing to improve on controller support for all Game Worlds.

[h1]Improved Canvas Safety Settings[/h1]
In this update we've added another layer of control for canvas loading. There is now a canvas safety setting where you can control the canvas images you can load. You can set the setting to none, friends only, and public (default).

While in public mode, we've reworked the canvas permission prompt to be more clear and easier to use. Show, Hide, Show & Trust, and Hide & Block options are now available. Show will display the canvas for that session and will ask you again the next time you join the same condo. Show & Trust will show the canvas data and never ask for permission again for that condo. Hide and Hide & Block will block canvas data from loading all together, with block never asking for permission again. By default now, all canvas data will not load until you have selected one of the Show options.

[hr][/hr]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Arcade: Phase 2 adds 8 new arcade games, including 2 coin pushers! Games added are: Dragon's Treasure, Coin River, Coloracle 2: Whose Hue?, Gears of Coin, Prismatic, Candy Slam, Mas Feurte 2K, and Ultimate Cow Wheel
[*] Added backer custom reward items to the Appearance and Rob's Imports stores: Burger Beanbag, Electric Chair, Marble Dogs, Cartoon Dragon Plush, DJ Glasses, Baby Dragon Hat, Big Foot Mask, Nipper9000, Spartan Helmet, Exo-Suit, Sweden Hat, Tiger Tail, Tiger Jacket, Scarf, Scarf Belt, Green Backpack
[*] The Pizza and Ice Cream stores in the arcade are now open with new items
[*] Added Canvas Tube to the D.I.Y. store
[*] You can now edit the Canvas Cylinder to be a half cylinder
[*] The chatting indicator now only shows while a player is currently typing, not just when they have the chat box open
[*] Workshop browser now has endless scroll loading. The workshop browser no longer has pages and instead loads new results (if it can) as you scroll down and does not clear past results until you do a new search
[*] Workshop browser no longer searches every time, so it'll keep where you were and not have to reload each time you open/close it
[*] Improved FPS when browsing workshop player models, items, and condos
[*] Teleporters now handle velocity of objects when exiting teleporters that have rotations. For example, if you toss an item into the teleporter at a high speed, it'll exit with the same high speed at the new angle of the teleporter's exit. This change applies to both players and physics objects
[*] Health bar now shows up in the bottom right when you take damage or gain health for Condos and Plaza
[*] Improved damage and hit indicators to be more impactful and satisfying
[/list]

[b]Arcade Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Planetary Piano: Added Multiplayer, 64-Note Sprint, Time Trial & 8 key modes
[*] Planetary Piano: Doubled the ticket payout
[*] Planetary Piano: Added a rule board to clarify new game modes and ticket payouts
[*] Planetary Piano: Cleaned up/polished cabinet art
[*] The Offering: The UFO beam now bounces back balls into the out of bounds zone, adding to difficulty
[*] Super Hoopers: Cabinet art redesign
[*] Wheel of Fire: Tokens required to play reduced to 5 (from 20)
[*] Avalanche: Tokens required to play increased to 15 (from 5)
[*] Avalanche: Tickets earned during bonus are now worth half a ticket (instead of a full ticket)
[*] It is now easier to use the token and ticket machines, you no longer have to be lined up exactly with the button, making it easier for people using third person
[*] Ice Cave: Added Hard gametype which brings back the classic Ice Cave challenge of 20 ball throws and 35 seconds on the clock. Payout is increased in this mode
[/list]

[b]Plaza Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added easy to access voice chat volume to the Plaza scoreboard directly below player list
[*] Poker: Added more sound feedback when a player raises or folds
[*] Poker: Added notification sound for when it is your turn
[*] Updated the character model for the Oasis Store shopkeeper (Sharon) with a new custom made, stylized model
[*]Bowling: Improved lighting and floor reflections
[/list]

[b]Condo Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Canvas trust prompt. Added Show, Show & Trust, Hide, Hide & Block buttons and reorganized the look of the UI to be more clear about what options you have when joining condos
[*] Added Canvas Safety levels. Disabled (disables all canvas data), Friends Only (load only canvas data you're friends with), and Public (load canvas data after asking permission - this is the current method)
[*] Added an option to teleports to disable rotation change on destination (the old functionality before you could set a rotation)
[*] Condo permission for noclip has been moved to the top category for easier access
[*] Condo admin permissions (for kick/ban, etc.) now have a redder background to show their importance and danger of applying said permissions
[*] Added easy to access voice chat volume to the Condo scoreboard directly below player list
[*] Food items in Condos now give you health
[*] Condo Saving Improvements: Condos now save on an interval and when you disconnect, instead of every item, resolving issues for players with large builds and reducing save errors overall.
[/list]

[b]Game World Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] ZM: When using controller, the aiming cursor will no longer show up and the combo/ammo indicator will follow your player
[*] ZM: Added force feedback while using controller for firing weapons, melee, special, and item placement
[*] Voice chat for Virus and Little Crusaders is now locational
[*] Ball Race: Pickup upgrades now have their own icons on the HUD
[*] Minigolf: Garden Art Polishing
[*] Accelerate: Reduced boost sound volume and added pitch changes based on drift boost power
[*] Accelerate: Reduced drift sound volume
[*] Accelerate: Removed camera shake when boosting
[*] Accelerate: Reduced drunk effects
[*] Accelerate: Bedzoom is now a Hard difficulty map
[/list]

[b]Settings Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Reorganized graphics settings by grouping the important settings together better
[*] Added an indicator of the default value on settings sliders
[*] Added a setting to completely disable mirror rendering in the mirror quality setting
[*] Made descriptions for settings larger
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list][*] Improved voice chat system to only connect voice chat with players who are near you, fixing various voice chat connection issues
[*] Fixed voice chat not working for Accelerate at all

[*] Arcade - Wheel of Fire: Fixed the wheel sometimes visually landing on the wrong spot and rewarding the wrong amount

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for August 16th, 2021
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for August 16th, 2021, detailing all the changes that have happened since August 9th, 2021. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]Summer Characters are Back![/h2]
Summer is here and the summer characters are back and visiting the Plaza once again! Talk with them to get free items and units.

[h2]Update 0.14.3.0 - Arcade: Phase 2[/h2]
We are getting very close to sharing this update with all of you!

Read more about this update [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/update-0-14-3-0-arcade-phase-2/42409]here[/url].

[h2]Accessibility Suggestions[/h2]
We've created a forum post asking the community for suggestions on how we can improve gameplay for players with certain conditions such as colorblindness, dyslexia, or anything else that might affect a players ability to use the standard presentation and controls of the game. 

If you have any ideas or suggestions, and possible solutions on how to solve a particular issue, please check out the forum post [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/accessibility-related-suggestions-megathread/40333]here[/url].

[h2]Arcade - Phase 2[/h2]
[b]macdguy[/b] worked on fixing various bugs and making gameplay changes observed during internal playtesting. 

[b]Johanna[/b] worked on optimizations for the Arcade.

[b]JJosh[/b] continued working on Arcade plushes, prizes, and NPCs.

[b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]Summer Characters are Back![/h2]
Summer is here and the summer characters are back and visiting the Plaza once again! Talk with them to get free items and units.

[h2]Update 0.14.3.0 - Arcade: Phase 2[/h2]
Work continues on the finishing touches for Arcade: Phase 2, introducing new games to the Arcade, and more.

[h2]June/July 2021 Condo Contest Over![/h2]
The June/July 2021 Condo Contest has concluded!

The winners are: 
1st place - 2,000,000 Units - @darkcoolyo
2nd place - 1,125,000 Units - @Frasler
3rd place - 800,000 Units - @Battlemark
4th place - 600,000 Units - @BubberDucky
5th place - 400,000 Units (200,000 Units each) - @LeTexPro (kivsune & Neddy)

Congratulations to everyone who won, and thank you to everyone who participated, both in the contest and deciding the winners! We can't wait to see you all in the next one!

You can check out all of the submissions [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/june-july-2021-condo-contest/42372/32]here[/url].

[h2]Condo: Canvas Permissions Rework[/h2]
[b]macdguy[/b] worked on reworking the Canvas permissions system to make it simpler, and fixed bugs that prevented the system from working properly the first time.

[b]Custom Content Warning[/b]

Upon entering a new condo, the player will be shown a redesigned Custom Content Warning prompt. 

The player will have four options they can choose.

[b][i]Temporary[/i][/b]
Show: This will show the canvas images just this once. 
Hide: This will hide the canvas images just this once. 

When the player leaves / re-joins the condo, the "Custom Content Warning" prompt will re-appear.

[b][i]Permanent[/i][/b]
Show & Trust: This will show the canvas images, and save the setting for the condo host. 
Hide & Block: This will hide the canvas images, and save the setting for the condo host.

When the player leaves / re-joins, the "Custom Content Warning" prompt won't re-appear.

The setting can be changed in the scoreboard later however if preferred.

[b]Canvas Caching[/b]

The Canvas caching system has also now been revamped. 

Previously, the game would cache the canvas images from condos that the player trusted.
Now, the game will only cache canvas images from condos whose owners you are friends with.

[b]Canvas Safety Level[/b]

There is also now a "Canvas Safety Level" in the settings, with three settings.

Public: The user will be asked before loading canvas data from any new condo.
Friends Only: Canvas data will be loaded automatically from Friend owned condos, but no one else.
Disabled: No canvas data will be loaded ever.

[h3]Condo: Redesigned Custom Content Warning[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/f325011e5c084047a9e4787e9dc589331db006d4.png[/img]

[h3]Condo: Canvas Safety Level[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/e495517bd0fc24f92ded86c02f48eb09d8bb12de.png[/img]

[h2]Condo: Teleporter Item Improvements[/h2]
[b]macdguy[/b] improved the teleporter item.

Before, objects and players would exit the teleporter with their velocity and angle being reset.

Now, objects and players will now keep their velocity and angle upon exiting a teleporter.

[previewyoutube=mnGu-VLSIfo;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=JdGRUjwbhG0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]
[b]macdguy[/b] worked on implementing a dialog on the main menu to advertise player surveys.

[b]Lifeless[/b] continued working on the Ball Race "Midori" map overhaul.

[b]Sketchman[/b] continued working on improvements and optimizations. He worked on optimizations and fixes for the Voice Chat system, as well as working on the Player Grouping system. He also finished the Steam achievements for Arcade - Phase 2.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for August 2nd, 2021
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for August 2nd, 2021, detailing all the changes that have happened since July 19th, 2021. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]Summer Characters are Back![/h2]
Summer is here and the summer characters are back and visiting the Plaza once again! Talk with them to get free items and units.

[h2]Update 0.14.3.0 - Arcade: Phase 2[/h2]
Work continues on the finishing touches for Arcade: Phase 2, introducing new games to the Arcade, and more.

Read more about this update [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/update-0-14-3-0-arcade-phase-2/42409]here[/url].

[h2]June/July 2021 Condo Contest CLOSED! Voting Open![/h2]
The June/July 2021 Condo Contest has closed.

We're now in voting mode, and the community will make its decision on who won!

Want to vote? Check out the contest thread [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/june-july-2021-condo-contest/42372/32]here[/url].

Voting closes August 4th at 11:59 PM CT!

[h2]Accessibility Suggestions[/h2]
We've created a forum post asking the community for suggestions on how we can improve gameplay for players with certain conditions such as colorblindness, dyslexia, or anything else that might affect a players ability to use the standard presentation and controls of the game. 

If you have any ideas or suggestions, and possible solutions on how to solve a particular issue, please check out the forum post [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/accessibility-related-suggestions-megathread/40333]here[/url].

[h2]Arcade - Phase 2[/h2]
[b]macdguy[/b] finished working on "Coloracle 2: Whose Hue?", "Ultimate Cow Wheel", "Dragon's Treasure", completing all of the gameplay for all of the machines. He worked with [b]Madmijk[/b] to play test and fix any bugs that appeared with the machines during the play test. He also optimized the leaderboard screens, and helped populate the Arcade with attract sounds for the new games.

[b]Madmijk[/b] worked on stats and achievements for the new games, along with helping play test and discover bugs with the new machines.

[b]Sketchman[/b] worked on icons for the achievements for all of the new machines.

[b]Will[/b] finished working on music and sounds for all of the new machines.

[h3]Arcade: Ultimate Cow Wheel Gameplay[/h3]

[previewyoutube=5PHgfJjnAj8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Accelerate: Moon City[/h2]
[b]Johanna[/b] continued working on the new Accelerate map, "Moon City".

[h3]Accelerate: Moon City WIP[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/550c9a360e6fae4d770cf720e5dcf8365b34547a.png[/img]

[h2]Zombie Massacre[/h2]
[b]macdguy[/b] worked on improving controller support for Zombie Massacre. He fixed bugs where players were unable to aim on certain maps, and added rumble feedback for firing and reloading. When using a controller in Zombie Massacre, the cursor will now hide and the cursor indicators (Gun Ammo remaining for example) will appear next to the player.

[h3]Zombie Massacre: Improved Controller Support WIP[/h3]

[previewyoutube=lI-9BREpZjk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Condo I/O[/h2]
[b]macdguy[/b] worked a bit on the upcoming Condo I/O system. He finalized the design for input/output. Using the system, players will be able to have multiple outputs from one item to another item, along with the ability to determine what that output does to the corresponding item. For example, a player can tie a Key Pad event of "On Success" to a door that will unlock the door when the "On Success" event fires. Alternatively, the Key Pad can tie an event of "On Failure" to the door to set the door on fire. 

He also implemented delays into all the output events, allowing the player to chain output events. For example, a player could have a button that opens a door, then 2 seconds later, play a sound, then 3 seconds later begin moving a spiked wall.

[h2]Miscellany[/h2]
[b]macdguy[/b] worked on improving the Setting Menu to add a panel that is intended to explain in more detail what each setting does.

[b]Sketchman[/b] continued working on improvements and optimizations, looking into issues with voice chat, working on implementing the server browser backend, fixes and tweaks to condo saving, and more.

[b]Wheezwer[/b] continued working on new Plaza posters, and started working on concept art for the planned Accelerate map, "Archenemypelago".

[h3]Improved Settings Menu WIP[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11783817/32264c05552284f1bacc7c2404565dd0ab16d0a9.png[/img]

[h2]Wrap It Up[/h2]
That about covers everything that happened since July 19th, 2021 at PixelTail Games. See you all next week.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Log for July 6th, 2021
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and welcome to the Weekly Dev Log for July 6th, 2021, detailing all the changes that have happened since June 14th, 2021. [b][i]Note: Devs that don't appear in the weekly log are not necessarily away or not doing work, but may be working on things currently not announced or backend work that doesn't need to be detailed.[/i][/b]

[h2]Tower Unite is on sale for only a couple more days for the Steam Summer Sales![/h2]
Grab a copy for a friend today!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/394690/Tower_Unite/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/394690/Tower_Unite/[/url]

[h2]Summer Characters are Back![/h2]
Summer is here, and starting today, the summer characters are back and visiting the Plaza once again! Talk with them to get free items and units.

[h2]Update 0.14.3.0 - Arcade: Phase 2[/h2]
Work continues on Arcade: Phase 2, introducing new games to the Arcade, and more.

Read more about this update [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/update-0-14-3-0-arcade-phase-2/42409]here[/url].

[h2]June/July 2021 Condo Contest IN PROGRESS![/h2]
July's contest has a beach theme! Basically, decorate and build on the beach however you like for this contest, making sure the sand and the ocean are visible.

The contest ends July 30th, 2021 at 11:59 PM CST!

1st Place will win 2,000,000 units, 2nd place will win 1,000,000 units, 3rd place will win 500,000 units, and all participants may be awarded 100,000 units!

Read more about the contest [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/june-july-2021-condo-contest/42372]here[/url].

[h2]Accessibility Suggestions[/h2]
We've created a forum post asking the community for suggestions on how we can improve gameplay for players with certain conditions such as colorblindness, dyslexia, or anything else that might affect a players ability to use the standard presentation and controls of the game. 

If you have any ideas or suggestions, and possible solutions on how to solve a particular issue, please check out the forum post [url=https://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/accessibility-related-suggestions-megathread/40333]here[/url].

[h2]Arcade - Phase 2[/h2]
[b]Johanna[/b] worked on the redesigned "Super Hoopers" cabinet model, along with working on finishing the cabinet model for "Ultimate Cow Wheel".
