[h1][b]Minigolf: Sweet Tooth Is Now Easier[/b][/h1]
After some great feedback, Steffen adjusted Sweet Tooth a bit to make it a little easier to live up to the Medium difficulty tag.

You can read the full change log at the bottom of this change log - it's quite a lot!

[h1][b]Little Crusaders Progress[/b][/h1]
We're working hard on our next Game World. We've shown it on our last live stream and it's making great progress! We are excited about Little Crusaders and we're approaching its beta release. We will have more information soon. For now, here's some cool screenshots:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/f91627c1ecb7cb808a1d13c8666e9e275b37fd83.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/4efeeffcff8cdb1e7c80ada4a2098f06c59ea916.png[/img]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjustable weather in Condos
[*]You can now pick up and throw the Beach Ball and Basketball physics items in your Condo
[*]Updated Basketball Hoop to have interaction with Basketball. You can now play some BBall in your Condo with your friends
[*]Completely redid the camera system for Game Worlds
[*]Minigolf - Sweet Tooth: Many changes and bug fixes to holes improving gameplay overall
[*]Added map title with difficulty tags to the waiting for players screen
[*]Minigolf: Increased HIO payout from 500 to 800 Units
[*]Plaza: Real Estate store now has a sign
[*]Plaza: Updated Condo sign
[*]Plaza: Added Little Crusaders Game World port (for when it's ready)
[*]Ball Race - Summit: Reduced the chance of getting stuck on Level 4
[*]Ball Race - Summit: Prevented a shortcut from Level 2 to 3
[*]Reduced amount of neck bend when rotating animation players in Lobby
[*]Added sound effects for Beach Ball and Basketball
[*]Slightly cleaned up UI for chat, settings, and a few other areas in the game
[*]Completely reworked player name tags (now more reliable and do not clip through walls)
[*]Condo physics items now don't simulate physics on init and also moving them (with inventory) will disable physics
[*]Trampoline now interacts with Condo physics items
[*]Condo physics items now float in the ocean and water properly
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an exploit where you could place down fireworks in places where people are playing games (such as the Casino)
[*]Fixed several camera issues with Game World (mostly Minigolf). Not camera collision stuff, but switching between overview cameras will be improved now
[*]Minigolf - Emission: Fixed out of bounds issue on Hole 17
[*]Minigolf: Fixed flamingo and phoenix payouts not working
[*]Plaza: Fixed missing material in Transit Station
[*]Plaza: Fixed small gaps in front of stores
[*]Fixed being able to toggle view self mode (in Lobby/Condo) while in first person
[*]Fixed odd graphical displacement in the Condo sand material
[*]Fixed Ceiling Fan player interaction (floating) being really glitchy
[*]Fixed Condo item finder camera and inventory glow not working properly
[/list]

[b]Sweet Tooth Changes[/b]
Map-Wide[list][*]Chocolate funnels now have a slightly different shade of brown to make it more clear that they are different from the hazardous chocolate rivers throughout the map.
[*]Certain sloped sections of track covered in the "ice" material will no longer allow the ball to get stuck (for example, when going down the failure slide in Hole 11 "overpass", the ball will never stop short of falling out of the chute, forcing the player to waste another stroke).
[*]More ice cream mounds and decorations have been placed around the map.
[*]Very slightly decreased the map fog.
[/list]
Hole 1[list][*]Increased the height of the blue barrier wall.
[/list]
Hole 2[list][*]Removed one of the wall segments to make the course less frustrating.
[*]Removed the wall segments on either side of the area right in front of the exit of the first pipes (before you go down the ramp).
[/list]
Hole 3[list][*]Removed camera collision from the course sign.
[/list]
Hole 4[list][*]Added another guide arrow.
[*]Added a high barrier behind the bottom ramp so players who hit the raising platform obstacle have less of a chance of bouncing backwards off of the course.
[*]The wall with the 5 holes at the beginning of the course no longer collides with the camera, making the camera less jerky when going through the holes.
[*]There is now a cavity under the raising/lowering platform obstacle, so if players land behind it, they can go straight through rather than have to frustratingly find a way around it.
[*]The wall behind the flag has been raised to decrease the odds of bouncing out of bounds.
[/list]
Hole 6[list][*]Increased the diameter of the final hole.
[*]Deepened the final hole.
[*]Removed camera collision from the walls around the hole at the top of the course.
[*]Removed camera collision from some pillars under the course.
[/list]
Hole 7[list][*]Fixed the lightmaps on the course.
[/list]
Hole 8[list][*]Removed the candy ring from the course, which significantly obscured players' view.
[*]Added another guide arrow.
[/list]
Hole 9[list][*]Deepened the "failure pit" so the ball rolls into the hole more quickly.
[*]The moving wall to bounce into the hole-in-one hole no longer moves.
[*]Fixed a bug where players would be marked as "out-of-bounds" when they were on the golf track.
[*]Fixed a typo in the hole's name.
[*]Reduced par from 5 to 4.
[/list]
Hole 11[list][*]Complex Collision Detection has been enabled on the course to reduce the chance of the ball being flung out of the overpass's curves.
[/list]
Hole 12[list][*]Players can no longer launch themselves onto course 18.
[*]Players can no longer turn around and launch across the course from the two failure pits.
[*]Removed the tiny ramps in front of the two holes on either side of the end-hole.
[*]Increased the wall height when entering the failure pits to prevent players from launching out the other side (although this rarely if ever happened before anyway).
[/list]
Hole 13[list][*]Increased the wall height at the back of the two whirlpool pits to decrease the chance that a high-speed player will bounce off the back of the course.
[*]Increased the wall height behind the ramp at the "failure area" so it's easier for players to bounce the ball into the hole right after going up the half-pipe.
[*]Increased the wall height at the large vortex pit section on either side of the end hole, to prevent players from flying out of bounds after coming around the bend.
[*]Fixed some of the camera jerkiness.
[*]The rock candy trees around the course no longer collide with the camera.
[*]The footbridges that immediately join the course no longer collide with the camera.
[*]The course sign and ice cream straws no longer collide with the camera.
[/list]
Hole 14[list][*]Increased the size of the ball-catcher to decrease the odds that the block at the top of the loop will incorrectly knock players out-of-bounds.
[*]Increased the size of the walls at the turns to decrease the chance that the ball will fly over the wall and go out of bounds.
[*]Complex Collision Detection has been enabled on the course to reduce the chance of the ball being flung through the loop.
[/list]
Hole 15[list][*]Fixed the lightmaps on a couple of the wall segments.
[*]Complex Collision Detection has been enabled on the course to reduce the chance of the ball being flung through the loop.
[/list]
Hole 16[list][*]Removed the chocolate pit at the beginning of the course, eliminating an out-of-bounds obstacle that was unnecessary.
[*]Doubled the height of the blue moving wall barricades to make them more visible.
[*]Fixed an issue where players could get stuck on the curved ramp between the boost pads.
[*]Filled in a hole next to the flag that served a needlessly frustrating out-of-bounds obstacle.
[*]Players can no longer roll backwards down the 90 degree curve ramp from the area in front of the flag.
[*]It is now possible to get into the flag with a stroke of two coming down the first (not the hole-in-one) chute.
[*]Decreased the odds of getting a hole-in-one (the lane has been narrowed slightly).
[/list]
Hole 17[list][*]The pipes no longer collide with the camera.
[*]The hole orbits are now violet colored in order to match the theme of the rest of the map.
[/list]
Hole 18[list][*]The ball now moves faster around the track, reducing the total travel time by around 15 seconds.
[*]The wall at the entrance hole to the track is now higher and has a lip to prevent the ball from bouncing up and out of the bowl.
[*]The ball should no longer bounce off of the blue moving wall at odd angles when it hits the seam between the blue and the pink walls.
[*]The pipe at the beginning of hole 18 no longer collides with the camera.
[*]Some of the wall segments no longer collide with the camera in order to provide a smoother experience.
[*]The loop segment's camera is slightly less jerky.
[*]The hole at the end of the course has been deepened.
[*]The hole orbits are now violet colored in order to match the theme of the rest of the map.
[*]Complex Collision Detection has been enabled on the course to reduce the chance of the ball being flung through the loops.
[*]Added a heightened wall at the back of the course-end to make sure the ball isn't bounced out the back.
[/list]


[b]You can follow our current developments on our Trello:[/b]
[url=https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap[/url]

[b]You can report bugs on our forums:[/b]
[url=http://forums.pixeltailgames.com/c/bug-report]http://forums.pixeltailgames.com/c/bug-report[/url]

[b]Or you may also report bugs on our Steam community, but please expect slower response time.[/b]

Get ready to try out our new sump[b]TU[/b]ous candy minigolf map!

notes.title: Canvas Presents For All (0.1.7.1)
notes.content:
Rev up those condos, get ready to build some new struc[b]TU[/b]res!

We hope you are all enjoying the wonderful holiday season. We've got a quick update here to address some issues.

Normally we would be more festive during this time of the year, but we're hard at work on our upcoming game world Little Crusaders which is making great progress (as you’ve seen on our development streams.) We've also got another Minigolf map, Sweet Tooth, very close to release (probably within a week or two).

We'd also like to take this time to let you guys know that we will be now be participating in future Steam Sales, when we find them applicable. We've been in Early Access for 8 months now, so we think putting the game on sale for a small discounted price will be a great incentive to bring new players into the game and expand our player base.

Since our release on Early Access, we've added 9 new maps, 132 new items, Casino, Bowling, Typing Derby, Trivia, the Monorail, and countless suggestions from you all. With every day that passes, we've been very hard at work giving you constant updates and new features. Again, thank you so much for supporting us and we'll keep pouring all our efforts into Tower Unite.

[b]Presenting Canvas Primitives...[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/e0710ac8efff0cf829b0faad9cf00bac8f8d4d24.png[/img]

With these shapes you can make all sorts of crazy creations in your condos. You could build a castle, build ramps, or completely new buildings. We're excited to see what you create!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added 5 new items: Canvas Cube, Canvas Cylinder, Canvas Sphere, Canvas Cone, and Canvas Wedge
[*]Instruments (such as piano) play sound on your client before sending to server host, providing a much better experience
[*]You can now adjust glow on Canvas Statue
[*]You can now scale certain Canvas items by the Z axis
[*]Changed "turbo" graphics label to "ultra" to avoid confusion
[*]Added reset buttons to FOV, UI scale, and resolution scale
[*]Changed the screen idle texture to make it more clear that the TV is off
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved/optimized player name tags
[*]Player ragdolls now remove properly when a player disconnects
[*]Fixed items with particles causes missing texture to appear while moving them
[/list]

[b]You can follow our current developments on our Trello:[/b]
[url=https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap[/url]

[b]You can report bugs on our forums:[/b]
[url=http://forums.pixeltailgames.com/c/bug-report]http://forums.pixeltailgames.com/c/bug-report[/url]

[b]Or you may also report bugs on our Steam community, but please expect slower response time.[/b]

notes.title: The Treasure Cove Minigolf Update (0.1.7.0)
notes.content:
Happy [b]T[/b]h[b]U[/b]rsday friends. We’ve got some fixes and a new Minigolf map for you!

[b]New Minigolf Map: Treasure Cove![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/451aafcdd944094167c3a76caf17de04dff84580.png[/img]

A fun mix of easy and challenging courses that sends you on the Minigolf adventure of a lifetime. Enjoy the view!


[b]Changes[/b][list]
[*]New Minigolf map: Treasure Cove
[*]Suite now has day/night and wallpaper/floor editing support
[*]Lobby/Condo player ragdolls now apply physical force in the direction you were running. You can now toss your ragdoll around like crazy
[*]We’ve revamped the House condo floorplan by combining some of the rooms. This creates a more open area and allows for flexibility when creating in the space.
[*]Improved the animations when a player looks and turns.
[*]Lobby/Condo only: You can now zoom in/out and rotate your camera while you ragdoll
[*]Lobby/Condo only: You can now instantly respawn by clicking or jumping while ragdolled
[*]Removed guide "ghost" stove from both Suite and House. Now the kitchen counters have ends so you can put anything in the stove area
[*]Added a total players online label on the main menu
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*]Your player will no longer rotate while you are viewing yourself
[*]Fixed Summit music not working with the music volume slider
[*]Fixed anti-macro popup freezing input if you had chat open when it popped up

notes.title: The Condo Real Estate Update (with a new Ball Race map as well)! (0.1.6.0)
notes.content:
Oh, hi there. Didn't want to dis[b]TU[/b]rb you, but NEW CONDOS ARE HERE AND THEY'RE YOURS! That is, provided you can afford the Units.

[b]The Condo Real Estate Is Here![/b][list]
[*]3 new Condos maps to decorate are now available! You can unlock them at the Condo Real Estate store, located on the second floor of the Tower Lobby. Each Condo map has unique save files, so you can decorate away with the same items across all your Condos! Isn't that cool? Going forward, we plan to make more of these Condo maps to add variety to your home.

[h1][b]Suite[/b][/h1]
A small, familiar Condo that's similar to a cozy hotel room. By popular demand, this is an HD remaster of GMTower's original suite!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/293ae197f10cc3b1d5e07e427e2ab592d78ee223.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]House[/b][/h1]
A two story house (with basement) surrounded by northwestern trees and a neighbourhood. This little abode has lots of rooms and a garage for your invisible car.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/f07e338367cd7459dbf455c58ebefbed77c7082e.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Smooth Dirt[/b][/h1]
This one is for builders. It's a completely flat surface that is really large. In our tests, it took us roughly 8 minutes (with speed shoes) to get to the edge of the map.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/db258c9d305c3374629efe3e840bdf3c27b21b22.jpg[/img]
[/list]


[b]New Ball Race Map[/b]

[h1][b]Summit[/b][/h1]
Winter is here, so to celebrate, we've got a fun-filled snow level for Ball Race now.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/120d76a50fdcb27a71559be95912ac747613a849.jpg[/img]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Canvas issues (VRam, cause of blurry textures in Condos)
[*]Improved Canvas load times
[*]Fixed player locations on the scoreboard not updating while the scoreboard is open
[*]Fixed appearance camera not working in Condo or main menu
[*]Fixed Automatic Doors colliding with other items while dragging. Now you can place things around and inside Automatic Doors properly!
[*]Minigolf: Fixed Out of Bounds issue on the blue path of Hole 5 on Emission
[/list]

[b]You can follow our current developments on our Trello:[/b]
[url=https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap[/url]

[b]You can report bugs on our forums:[/b]
[url=http://forums.pixeltailgames.com/c/bug-report]http://forums.pixeltailgames.com/c/bug-report[/url]

[b]Or you may also report bugs on our Steam community, but please expect slower response time.[/b]

notes.title: Linux Public Beta
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/771977fe4d7db063d5ddea4ea4b277b82fb82a88.jpg[/img]

Greetings [b]TU[/b]x Enthusiasts,

We are pleased to announce to our Linux users that we are releasing a beta version of the Linux client for Tower Unite! Users will need to opt-in to the beta branch on Steam to download the client and play it. 

[h1]To opt-in to the beta, right click on Tower Unite in Steam, go to Properties, go to the Betas Tab, and select from the dropdown “linuxbeta - Linux Public Beta”.[/h1]

First off, we want to stress that while we are providing this client to Linux users, we offer no guarantee at this time that everything will work. There will be issues, there will be crashes, there will be problems. This should be treated as a beta test. Due to this, we are not advertising on our store page that we have a Linux client until we bring it up to our standards.

While most functionality should work exactly how it does on Windows, there are many graphical issues in this release. These issues seem to be localized to our effects systems. Certain maps such as Alpine and Midori are affected more than the other maps due to this issue. 

At this point in time, the Linux and Mac OS X clients are low priority. Closer to the end of the Early Access period we will shift our focus towards improving these clients. There are no planned dates for a Mac OS X beta at this time.

Now to get into the more technical details. The Tower Unite Linux client was tested on Ubuntu 16.04 LTS using a Nvidia GTX 980 with the proprietary Nvidia drivers version 367.57. Your results may vary. Running Tower Unite with the “-opengl4” flag may improve or degrade the visuals.

Due to some of the graphical issues in the Linux Client, we recommend the following settings to minimize visual artifacts in the game:

[list]
[*]Screen Mode -> “Windowed”
[*]Effects Quality -> “Low”
[*]Ocean Quality -> “Potato”
[/list]

Here is the list of things that we can confirm are broken in the current versions of the Linux client.

[list]
[*][b]Effects.[/b] Some textures may be multicolored or just blacked out entirely. Some objects with glare don’t render correctly and can make some maps like Midori unplayable. Alpine also suffers from this with the snow particle issues. We recommend changing your “Effects Quality” to “Low” to mitigate this issue.

[*][b]Ocean.[/b] The ocean shader we use for the Lobby, Condo, and the upcoming Treasure Cove minigolf map does not currently have OpenGL renderer support. Due to this, the water will have a grey default texture applied to it. We recommend changing your “Ocean Quality” to “Potato” as this shader does work with OpenGL.

[*][b]Fullscreen and Borderless Fullscreen.[/b] While these settings are functional, there are issues that arise when alt-tabbing out of the game, which can even cause the game to crash. We recommend that you play in Windowed Mode if you alt-tab frequently.

[*][b]VOIP. [/b]Voice chat is completely non functional in the Linux client. Linux clients will see that people are talking, but no audio will be transferred.

[*][b]Midori.[/b] The Midori map for the Ball Race gamemode functions perfectly fine, but the glare and graphical issues, including blinding lights, may make the map impossible to play. Playing Tower Unite with the “-opengl4” flag may mitigate this issue, but only on this map alone.

[*][b]Steam Cloud. [/b]Steam Cloud currently does not work with the Linux clients. Linux users will need to transfer and backup their condos and persona files manually at this time. We’d advise just to disable Steam Cloud in the game’s Properties -> Updates -> Steam Cloud settings on Steam.

[*][b]Media Player. [/b]While playing back video, there will be a intense flicker from the screen, and some videos won’t play video at all, but they will have audio.
[/list]

Understanding all this above, we invite our Linux fans to give the beta a try, and to enjoy Tower Unite on Linux.

notes.title: Bowling Update (with guest appearance: Monorail!) (0.1.5.0)
notes.content:
Hey there, TUrkey gobblers, bowlers and enjoyers (unless you are vegetarian, then hey possible TUrnip eaters).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x_6hdOgm5BM

[b]Major Changes[/b][list]
[*]Bowling!
A new Plaza activity is ready for your enjoyment.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/806e10eb083f08aa093743b89e2cd8240d42de6b.jpg[/img]

Bowling is a 4 player (per lane) game based on real 10-frame bowling. Bowling employs mouse gesture controls and has unlockable bowling balls.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/b3bdce5dc411bc8d7a069cda4db438cb0f28a376.jpg[/img]

[*]Monorail
The Monorail is now running! Take the scenic route to the boardwalk and board the monorail.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/d5643071594a1b0bb766b2bef733bca6cebe9b91.jpg[/img]

[*]New Water
We've added an improved water shader to both the Plaza and Condo. Please keep in mind that setting it to Turbo (Highest) quality will be demanding. We also added graphic settings to adjust the water quality performance.
[/list]

[b]Plaza Changes[/b][list]
[*]Bowling is now playable
[*]Monorail now works
[*]New ocean shader for Plaza and Condo
[/list]

[b]New Unlockables![/b][list]
[*]Added 10 new Bowling related unlockable items that enhance your Bowling experience:[list]
[*]Chrome Bowling Ball
[*]Fireball Bowling Ball
[*]Skull Bowling Ball
[*]Metallic Bowling Ball
[*]Gold Bowling Ball
[*]Earth Bowling Ball
[*]Moon Bowling Ball
[*]8 Ball Bowling Ball
[*]Golf Ball Bowling Ball
[*]Plasma Bowling Ball[/list]
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b][list]
[*]Canvas images cache in VRAM now rather than redownloading the same image everytime
[*]Player colors/wearables now save on Steam Cloud
[*]Tower Unite related game settings (not graphics or input) now save on Steam Cloud
[*]Add ocean graphic settings: Potato (Lowest), Low, Medium, High, Turbo (Highest)
[*]Added sounds to the Bubble Gun
[/list]

[b]Ball Race Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed case where other players would sometimes jitter
[*]Fixed Memories level 12 sometimes getting players stuck on the exit attractor
[/list]

[b]Minigolf Changes[/b][list]
[*]Improved collisions on Emission
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*]Fixed third person camera not working while using slot machines
[*]Fixed CRT Monitor dynamic lights and collision
[*]Fixed Golden Watch key binding not actually changing
[*]Fixed Wheel of Money and Grand Quest notifying about spins/actions before the reels finish spinning
[*]Fixed collision bounds in Bumper Cars Lobby and Subway Station
[*]Fixed media player UI not drawing over top of chat messages
[*]When buying items, the transaction UI will now handle transaction timeouts and not soft lock the game
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Some objects may appear floating at the origin of the map such as monorail connectors, or bowling pins
[*]Sometimes the bowling pins will appear to be missing from the lanes. This is a networking issue, the pins will appear once you bowl
[*]After playing a round of Bowling, the mouse cursor may not appear in menus. Pressing Q for a moment to view your inventory should fix this
[*]After playing a round of Bowling, the camera may appear in the center of the player model and then a couple seconds later adjust it’s height to the correct position
[/list]


[b]You can follow our current developments on our Trello:[/b]
[url=https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap[/url]

notes.title: The Ball Race Networking Update (with Plaza changes, too!) (0.1.4.0)
notes.content:
Hello again, fellow vir[b]TU[/b]al sphere rollers. We've got exciting changes for Ball Race and Plaza!

[b]Major Changes[/b][list]
[*]Ball Race player movement networking overhauled. Players with high ping will notice massively improved controls. Ball Race is actually playable in multiplayer now!
[/list]

[b]Lobby Changes[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/3debf2c29c27748087a42cd7542b479f816a5584.png[/img]
[list]
[*]New Game World Ports Design
[*]Gameworld Ports now have launch pads to move around the area easier
[*]Added new Boardwalk/Beach area
[*]Added new TV's to Beach Houses. These work the same way as the Theater's
[*]New Subway/Transit Station Design
[*]Bowling interior artwork pass
[*]Fixed various holes in the Plaza
[*]Improved performance with Plaza activities
[*]Optimized the Plaza more (and will continue to do so)
[/list]

[b]New Items![/b][list]
[*]Added 7 new items: Paper Crown, Strainer, Computer Head, CRT Monitor, Old Keyboard, Stove, and Diving Helmet
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b][list]
[*]Added media refresh button to the media request UI
[*]Added chat messages when a player enters and leaves their Condo from the Lobby
[*]P2P now automatically connects/disconnects from Lobby when changing permissions settings
[*]Added 'Antique' tag to applicable items in Rob's Imports
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list]
[*]Fixed spectating HUD not updating when a player spectating was switched
[*]Fixed gamma/brightness related issues with media players
[*]Fixed Condo materials not always resetting sometimes when switching Condo snapshots
[*]Fixed Minigolf sounds not adjusting with the volume settings
[*]Fixed Ball Race hats not showing up for every player
[*]Fixed hair not always coming back when switching from hats that disable hair
[*]Fixed lights being on for vacant Condo doors sometimes
[*]Fixed collision issues on counter in Virus: Hospital
[*]Fixed canvas poster (square) being slightly off center and clipping the imagery
[*]Fixed canvas frame (square) being slightly off center from canvas
[/list]


[b]You can follow our current developments on our Trello:[/b]

notes.title: The Slightly Spooky Update (0.1.3.0)
notes.content:
Happy au[b]TU[/b]mn, everyone!

[b]Major Changes[/b][list]
[*]You can now save multiple Condo layouts! This will be very useful if you want to save your current Condo and make a spooky Halloween one. You can access this in the Condo management menu. All snapshots save to your Steam cloud.
[/list][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/6e918a862967c61f0670884aa3500e10b7696db9.png[/img]

[b]New Items![/b][list]
[*]Added a frightening Skeleton Playermodel
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/ae8669a21c386b277b6b27465d015800bd681035.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Added 6 new cosmetic items (including 2 scary ones): Pumpkin Head, Evil Eyes, Soda Drink Hat, Bow Tie, Monocle, and GP5 Mask
[*]Added 14 spooky new items: Catsack Jack-o'-Lantern, Pumpkin Cluster 1, Pumpkin Cluster 2, Pumpkin Cluster 3, Pumpkin Cluster 4, Pumpkin Cluster 5, Pumpkin Tower, Pumpkin with Candle 1, Pumpkin with Candle 2, Pumpkin with Candle 3, Medium and Small Pumpkin, Three Pumpkins, Large and Medium Pumpkin, and Four Pumpkins[/list]

[b]Condo Changes[/b][list]
[*]You can now search for Condos while in your Condo through the pause menu
[*]The game now shows how many items are loading in the top left (for Condo, stores, etc.)
[*]Added the ability to adjust sun angle in Condo menu
[*]Renamed Day/Night button in Condo menu to "Environment Settings" in preparation for upcoming weather system
[*]Reduced shininess of certain materials in the Condo (like the bathroom sink, doors, stairs, floors, etc.)
[*]Improved rendering performance in Condo
[*]Added a status UI (top right of your screen) when you are connected to P2P
[*]Condos/Lobby doors are occupied in order of door number
[/list]

[b]Virus Changes[/b][list]
[*]Added enraged mode. Enraged mode gives the First Infected a boost of extra health and speed until they infect another player.
[*]Pressing C will now quickly use adrenaline and then switch back to the previous weapon
[*]Players will no longer get selected twice in a row for First Infected
[/list]

[b]Ball Race Changes[/b][list]
[*]Ball Race will now use your Lobby playermodel, colors, and hats!
[/list]

[b]Lobby Changes[/b][list]
[*]Added chat message that tells players who are in the Theater that someone wants to skip the media currently being played
[*]Removed AFK symbol above player heads, the AFK status will only be shown on their player tag
[/list]

[b]Game World Changes[/b][list]
[*]Spectating HUD now displays the player user bar which includes ping information, block and voice status, and tags (AFK, backer, developer, etc.)
[/list]

[b]Item Changes[/b][list]
[*]Added the ability to color the Milk Carton playermodel
[*]Canteen Table is now colorable

Hello again, unit vul[b]TU[/b]res!

[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*]Anti-macro solution for Casino games[/list][i][h1]Developer Notes: We know that macroing has been a rampant issue with the Casino since day one. Due to that, we spent a lot of time trying to figure out the best solution that would be both powerful enough to combat macros and pleasant for real players. The system will popup a notification every 15 minutes (while on a slot machine) and present a key that the player must press to continue playing. A successful key press will award players with Units. We're interested in seeing how it goes for everyone and we hope that it isn't too much of a hassle.[/h1][/i][list][*]Condo P2P chat messages now display the condo name it came from

notes.title: Optimization Patch for Casino (Update 0.1.2.3)
notes.content:
Hello, you friendly [b]TU[/b]rnips! 

You wanted more bug fixes? We’ve got ‘em. Everyone’s been hard at work optimizing things around the Plaza.

[b]Plaza/Casino Optimizations[/b][list][*]Reduced ticks on various machines and activities
[*]Made idle screens for machines while not in use
[*]Reduced a few draw calls[/list]

[i][h1]Developer Note: These optimizations should see FPS increases for all users, especially those with lower end CPUs.[/h1][/i]

[b]Changes[/b][list][*]Video Poker now pays out twice as much
[*]Wheel of Money now requires 5 credits to spin the wheel, just like Triple Diamonds
[*]Video Blackjack now pays out 5 times the bet amount instead of 3 times[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b][list][*]Fixed blocking players not removing chat text
[*]Fixed Game World votemap not showing what map was chosen
[*]Fixed issue where if no one votemaps for a Game World map, it wouldn't select any map. It now roulette all maps of that game
[*]Fixed issue where the Game World votemap roulette would stop on the wrong map icon
[*]Fixed Spin to Win wheel becoming blurry for lower end machines or low settings
[*]Fixed name tags not fading out properly[/list]

[b]We're actively investigating many issues, including:[/b]
[list][*]FPS issues
[*]Crashes[/list]

Please keep in mind that some issues are easier to solve than others and could take time to be resolved. We thank you for being patient while we work them out!

[b]Or you may also report bugs on our Steam community, but expect slower response time.[/b]

notes.title: The Casino (0.1.2.0)
notes.content:
Hello, [b]TU[/b]bular players. Let’s cut right to the chase with this update. This one has the Casino.

https://youtu.be/EXlpdsbl0ck

[h1]The Casino Is Now Open![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/45467681ce3db6ddc4211b78ccad8d86b736aa13.jpg[/img]
[b]The following games are now available to Tower Unite:[/b]
[list][*]Casino
  [list][*]Texas Hold'em
[*]3 different slot machines
    [list][*]Triple Diamonds: A basic 3 reel slot machine
[*]Grand Quest: A 3 reel slot machine with some RPG elements
[*]Wheel of Money: A 3 reel slot machine with a bonus money wheel[/list]
[*]Video Poker
[*]Video Blackjack
[*]Spin to Win
[*]Double or Nothing[/list]
[*]Trivia
[*]Typing Derby[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/9ee558e2b9a02fb0ade5cc3930c6cc404176f19a.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/d72e9412162fab523dd7ca51a5a52065a6d077b9.jpg[/img]
[i]Developer Note: Most functionality of the Casino Update will initially be limited to Official Servers. Typing Derby and Trivia will still show up on community servers, but they will not payout. Support for other servers will come later.

We are now hosting more Official servers located in Seattle, Dallas, Chicago, New York, and two in Frankfurt. We are also currently setting up a server in Sydney. 

Please be aware that there may be initial issues on launch and we will be closely watching all Casino related transactions.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/32a9e76eded4814864af64421addf8b318847cc8.png[/img]

[h1]Major New Features[/h1]
[list][*]The Casino
[*]Added Trivia to the Plaza
[*]Added Typing Derby to the Plaza
[*]Key Binding
[*]Added AFK support for Game Worlds	
[list][*]AFK players will not earn units
[*]AFK players will be automatically skipped when everyone else has finished the hole/level in Minigolf/Ball Race
[*]AFK players are denoted by an emote over their heads and on the scoreboard
[*]AFK players will be kicked from slot machines and will auto-fold in poker[/list]
[*]Mediaplayer Voteskip and Voting
[list][*]This applies only to Theater and will soon be added to Condos in a later update[/list][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/8a9bcc74cd8a4e5519f498a4065a68892acbea3f.png[/img]
[*]Added a new Minigolf course, Emission[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/637c7cdf8f86b3ba081b400022d58a9c9c97e989.png[/img]

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list][*]Added a bunch of new items (32!):
Wood Wardrobe, Wood Bookshelf, Wood Coffee Table, Wood Dresser, Wood Round Table, PBB Trash Can, PBB Stool, PBB Coffee Table, PBB Dresser, PBB End Table, PBB End Table Capped, PBB Desk, PBB Dresser Capped, PBB Desk Capped, PBB Coffee Table Capped, PBB Wardrobe, PBB Wardrobe Capped, PBB Bookshelf, PBB Bookshelf Capped, Wall Torch, Hula Doll, Cactus, Garden Flamingo, Bubble Gun, Waffle, Potato, Piggy Bank, Ancient Jar, Grandfather Clock, Bubble Machine, Laser Projector, Wooden Hot Tub
[*]Added adjustable grid snapping for item movement
[*]Jetpack is now predicted. Jetpack will no longer be really glitchy when being used
[*]Fog machine now actually blows out fog instead of fog magically appearing around it (this is still an option though)
[*]Added location text to the left of player chat in Plaza so you can tell where people are
[*]Reduced the "waiting for players" timer to 5 seconds (from 10 seconds) when everyone is ready to play
[*]Player user bar now shows tags first instead of ping to align pings
[*]Added key support for rotating inventory items
[*]Added support for rebinding leaving drivables (instruments, slot machines, games, etc.)
[*]Added support for rebinding the backer item "Golden Watch"
[*]Added support for rebinding Trivia and Slots shortcuts
[*]You can now display FPS through a graphics settings option
[*]Patched up a few holes in the Plaza map
[*]You can now sit on more of the seats in the Plaza (casino, casino lobby, bowling, beach chairs, etc.)
[*]Added chat sounds (from GMT) with option to disable them in the sound settings
[*]Added "clear search" button to the search bar in stores
[*]Added basic Parental Controls (more will be added in later updates)
[list][*]Disable chat
[*]Profanity filter[/list]
[*]Added setting to disable Lobby crosshair
[*]Added setting to disable Lobby HUD[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]
[list][*]Implemented level streaming for Plaza (phase 2, Game World Ports, etc.)[/list]

[b]Minigolf Changes[/b]
[list][*]If everyone has clicked "finished" on the customize window, it'll automatically end customize timer so people don't have to wait
Minigolf scoreboard now aligns all names by accounting the width of the flag icon (finished or not)
[*]Fixed the sombrero hat not showing up on your golf ball
[*]Fixed the splash effect from occurring in some of the holes on Waterhole
[*]Fixed pocket effect lagging (really bad for lower end computers)[/list]

[b]Ball Race Changes[/b]
[list][*]Added "READY"..."GO!" to Ball Race before the round starts so players can have a chance to be ready
[*]Fixed the camera (for all non-hosts) not facing the right way when first spawning
[*]Fixed the issue where you would sometimes be randomly thrown into the air on the speed boost of the last level of GLXY[/list]

[b]Planet Panic Changes[/b]
[list][*]At the end of each round all players have their team scrambled
[*]Team select automatically ends in 3 seconds if everyone has selected a team

notes.title: Patch for Update 0.1.1.7 (and some news on Casino!)
notes.content:
Hello again, all you s[b]TU[/b]nning people out there!

Developer note: The Casino is a massive undertaking and is under heavy, constant development. We hear you and understand your concerns, but we can't afford to rush it out. We will be announcing a date of the Casino's release very soon. Thank you for your patience!

[b]Here's a small update about the Casino developments, while we're here:[/b]
[list][*]We have working slots as shown on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pixeltailgames/v/82182658]latest Twitch stream[/url]
[*]We have 3 different types of slot machines shipping with the Casino update (with more coming in future updates)
[*]What's left to do is:[list]
[*]Payouts for Casino games (very close to being done)
[*]Betting for Casino games (very close to being done)
[*]Persistent/progressive jackpots (very close to being done)
[*]Spin to Win
[*]Texas Hold'em[/list]
[*]Why is the Casino taking so long?[list]
[*]We've gone to monumental lengths to ensure security of the Casino games. The Casino uses a piece of proprietary backend software we’ve been developing internally. This software took months to develop and was absolutely necessary to complete the Casino. Development was stalled on some Casino games until the necessary framework on the backend was completed.
[*]The Plaza needed to be optimized before we put the Casino in. This took up a sizable chunk of development time. If a developer wasn't working on Casino, they were doing optimization work. Without these optimizations, the Casino would run at unplayable framerates.
[*]Casino games are written in two parts. The gameplay part runs in the game, the game-logic part runs securely on a backend server to prevent fraudulent behavior. Because of this, Casino games take longer to create than most other games in Tower.[/list][/list]

[b]Don’t forget to follow Casino development on our Trello:[/b] https://trello.com/c/3Kd7gd9o/101-casino


[b]Optimizations:[/b][list][*]Disabled distance field shadows in all maps, not just Plaza

[h1][i]Developer note: This was causing the performance issues in the Condo and other levels. Players should now see better performance when on the “TURBO” Shadow setting on those levels.[/i][/h1]

[*]Optimized seats a bit, which should help performance in the Plaza more[/list]
[b]Linux Dedicated Server Changes:[/b][list][*]Fixed an issue where Linux dedicated servers wouldn’t stream certain levels[/list]
[b]Planet Panic Changes:[/b][list][*]Pressing T no longer respawns all players in Planet Panic[/list]
[b]UI Changes:[/b][list][*]Updated menu pictures[/list]

[b]You can follow our current developments on our Trello:[/b]
[url=https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap[/url]

notes.title: The Big Optimization One (Update 0.1.1.7)
notes.content:
Oh, hello there [b]TU[/b]rbos. We didn’t see you come in. We know everyone’s been asking for more optimizations. So, we’ve answered your call. We’ve added an actual buttload of optimizations in this update, just for you! Everyone should see better performance in general, because we just love you guys that much. 

This update may look small, but it’s actually incredibly complicated. Casino is coming up soon, and we’re still hoping to have it out this month. This update needed to come out before we do the Casino update.

You can watch our recent stream on Twitch to see the progress we've made with the Casino here:
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/pixeltailgames/v/81983274]https://www.twitch.tv/pixeltailgames/v/81983274[/url]

[b]Major Changes:[/b][list][*]Minigolf: Fixed host FPS issue where the ball could not be putted sometimes[/list]

[h1][i]Developer notes: Foohy rewrote a lot of the golf ball code to make this system work a lot better. This change required us to mess with the ball physics a bit. There's still a few minor issues to work out with Minigolf in general and this is a step towards addressing them.[/i][/h1]

[b]Miscellaneous Changes:[/b][list][*]You can now block other player's chat messages

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/366322de66165f4d4a590378dccab6b60bddfc85.png[/img][/list]

[h1][i]Developer notes: When admins are not available, players can easily annoy other players. The blocking feature allows you to completely cut off communication with another player. You can block a player by clicking on their profile and hitting "Block Chat and Voice". As a bonus, the blocking system will remember who you blocked.[/i][/h1]

[b]Optimizations:[/b][list][*]Optimized day/night sky (increased FPS by up to ~30 in some cases)
[*]Lighting and shadows are now cheaper
[*]Reduced draw distance of players and hats
[*]Added lots of LODs
[*]Reduced draw calls

[h1][i]Developer notes: Not all players will see the same big benefits these optimizations bring to our game. Those on older PC’s will notice a much larger change than those on newer PC’s. More work is still to be done for lighting specifically. The reduction of draw calls and introduction of more LOD’s is also more of a constant process as the game develops. These changes affect the Plaza and Condo performance.[/i][/h1]

[*]Implemented level streaming for Plaza

[h1][i]Developer notes: Level streaming is a way to load/unload pieces of the map in real time. This is not perfect yet, but it helps Plaza performance quite a lot. You might notice stuttering on the first load of an interior. Phase 2 of level streaming is going to come later, but for now, this will help immensely with performance. Noclipping isn't supported with level streaming at the moment.[/i][/h1][/list]


[i]Thanks for your support and for waiting patiently![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/a2b67226caba8cbeb03fd1330e1f5fcb916273eb.png[/img]

[b]As always, you can follow our current developments on our Trello:[/b]
[url=https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap[/url]

notes.title: Update 0.1.1.6
notes.content:
Hey there sTUd muffins, we’ve got a little update here to address a few things. Being disconnected from Steam should be a lot less frustrating and confusing to everyone from now on.

Also, be sure to check out our latest development blog about our progress with the Casino.
[url]http://forums.pixeltailgames.com/t/what-the-heck-is-an-agc-and-what-does-it-have-to-do-with-casino/11963[/url]

We've got the Casino Update coming as quickly as possible, should be out by mid-August. 

We're also preparing our next awesome update, called the Boardwalk Update. The upcoming Boardwalk Update will make some of the most anticipated Boardwalk games fully playable.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/5f086f1a418177f685818678f90e01e4a062cf0e.jpg[/img]

[b]Plaza Changes:[/b][list][*]Laser Tag building has been completely remade
[*]Celebrations building has been completely remade
[*]Bowling building has been improved, but still under reconstruction
[*]Fresh building has been improved
[*]New Monorail station above the stores[/list]
[h1][i]Developer Notes: The old Laser Tag building was a quickly made placeholder. We came up with a few concepts with the new building over the months. After the new building was put in, the other buildings needed more detail and texture variants as the Laser Tag building made them feel smaller than they should. The old building was tragically torn down in a construction accident.[/i][/h1]

[b]Miscellaneous Changes:[/b][list][*]Improved player movement feel in Condo

[h1][i]Developer Notes: The movement friction in the Condos has been vastly improved - meaning walking around will feel more smooth and less like you're on sticky paper.[/i][/h1]

[*]Improved look of hair on characters models
[*]Clothing and hair on player models no longer shine like they are wet[/list]

[b]UI Changes:[/b][list][*]Added difficulty tags to Ball Race map selection

[h1][i]Developer Notes: Finding a Ball Race map that meets your skill level was always a blind decision. Now with the tags, players can easily understand what they're about to jump into.[/i][/h1]

[*]Each Game World now has their own sub menu to make creation of servers a little more easier

[h1][i]Developer Notes: The change to the Game World menus should help newer players find things more naturally. We found through playtesting & feedback that the create button was not obvious enough.[/i][/h1]

[*]More informative loading screens
[*]Units will now display “OFFLINE” when Steam is unavailable instead of 0
[*]When Steam is offline, the user will be presented with a dialogue that explains why the game doesn’t work without Steam
[*]Friend list will now say if you couldn't connect to Steam networks
[*]Vending Machine now has use prompt[/list]

[b]Item Changes:[/b][list][*]Outside Chair is now colorable
[*]Closed Cardboard Box is now colorable
[*]Stairs are now colorable
[*]Increased character limit on Notebook from 500 to 1000 characters
[*]When you drink Wine or Margarita, it removes the liquid properly now[/list]

[b]Optimizations:[/b][list][*]Optimized the main menu level, improving FPS overall
[*]Reduced VRAM usage on Plaza (around 120MB less in most areas)
[*]Optimized icon resolutions (lowers VRAM usage quite a bit! 135MB less VRAM usage to be exact!)[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b][list][*]Fixed media input box not letting you type into it
[*]Fixed getting drunk leaving the DOF effect on forever
[*]Fixed player name tags being massive white blocks when first spawning
[*]Fixed being able to open the Notebook multiple times[/list]

[b]You can follow our current developments on our Trello:[/b]
[url]https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap[/url]

notes.title: Patch for Update 0.1.1.5
notes.content:
[b]New to the Condo: Item Finder![/b]
Tired of losing track of your items? Well, look no further, as we’ve added a new item finder to the condo management menu. Just hold C while in your condo, click "Find Items," and the menu will display. You'll see a list of all the items that are currently placed down in your condo. Hover over them in the list to visually see the item or stash it back into your main inventory. Finally, never lose those pesky beach balls.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/cd7005bcd00eb9f1f14f1db24fd7a379fc708a9c.jpg[/img]

[b]Changes:[/b][list][*]Item tooltips now appear below the inventory UI as we noticed they get in the way of finding specific item icons and that's just terrible
[*]Made Lobby 1 plate inventory icon a little bit better[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b][list][*]Fixed Lobby 1 trophy being really dark
[*]Fixed a bug where you could pick up items that are in the trash state (empty pizza boxes, etc.)
[*]Fixed inventory items (and pets) teleporting to the entrance of the Condo wrongly
[*]Fixed a bug where the inventory would instantly close if the key binding was changed in the DefaultInput.ini
[*]Reduced water splash sound effect volume
[*]Fixed a bug where if you were noclipping and hit a ceiling fan or trampoline, you would fall forever[/list]

Please note that servers do not need to be updated for this patch.

[b]You can follow our current developments on our Trello:[/b]
[url=https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap[/url]

Thanks again for being patient with us while we got this sorted out. We love you.

notes.title: Update 0.1.1.5
notes.content:
Hey sTUpendous players, got a hot new update for you. No Casino features are in this update, stay tuned and [url=https://trello.com/c/3Kd7gd9o/101-casino-june-2016]follow our progress on Trello[/url].

[b]28 New items:[/b][list][*]Placeable doors: Theater, Cubicle, Glass, Metal, Wood, Kitchen, Bedroom, Sliding, Club, Automatic, Fancy Automatic
[*]Gramophone, Basket Ball Hoop, Basket Ball, Punching Bag, Barber Pole, Pizza, Dance Floor, Umbrella, Umbrella Stand, Ship Wheel, Closed Cardboard Box, Boxing Ring, Beach Volleyball Net, Microphone Stand, Outdoor Cushioned Chair, Canvas Statue[/list]

[b]Attention GMT Legacy Donors, GMT players, and Indiegogo backers![/b]
In this update, we're happy to give you some special exclusive items, as we previously promised.
[list][*]GMT Legacy Donors will get: Golden Plate, VIP Basket, Lobby 1 Plate, Lobby 2 Plate, the original GMT trophies (10!), Lobby 1 Trophy, Classic Sunabouzu Shrine, Classic Catsack, and Classic Stash of Goods.
[*]All GMT Players will get: Lobby 1 Plate, Lobby 2 Plate, and the original GMT trophies (10!)
[*]Indiegogo Backers ($15+) will get: Lobby 1 Trophy, Classic Sunabouzu Shrine, and Classic Catsack[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b][list][*]Added media player SoundCloud support
[*]Changed media player web browser to use the Steam SDK’s ISteamHTMLSurface API; this means we have support for additional video encodings. YouTube should no longer report that Adobe Flash player is required on some videos.
[*]Any webpage URL can now be requested for media players in the Condo
[*]Local chat messages are now labeled "Local"
[*]When a player's ping is bad, it'll color their ping signal bars yellow. When the ping is REALLY bad, it'll be red. This should help inform who has a bad connection a lot easier
[*]Virus: When a gun is out of ammo, it'll be red in the selection menu
[*]Virus: You now have to fully charge the alt fire for Sonic Shotgun to have it air blast
[*]Beer, Wine, Margarita, and Soda Can are no longer "Spawn Once" and will save in the Condo now
[*]Edible items will turn into a "trash" state after being fully consumed which will allow the owner to delete them if they want, but they can choose not to allowing them to build giant walls of beer and wine again
[*]Item property sliders (such as scale for Canvas) have been vastly improved and also allow for manual number entry
[*]You can now hold Q and it'll display all player name tags at once
[*]When another player is behind a wall, their voice chat volume will be reduced and muffled
[*]The Shooting Gallery can now be played, but is still largely unfinished and is just a test of our Lobby game systems
[*]You can now interact with the Globe item[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b][list][*]Fixed some YouTube videos reporting that Adobe Flash is required
[*]Fixed Ball Race round HUD going past the amount of levels in the map
[*]Fixed being able to alt fire Double Barrel even when you don't have enough ammo to
[*]Fixed certain items not saving their color properly
[*]Fixed Alpine map icon looking bad at lower settings
[*]Fixed Planet Panic overview camera flickering
[*]Fixed trampoline bouncing you when you hit underneath it
[*]Fixed replication for Speed Shoes/potions upon spawn/respawn
[*]Fixed missing collisions on Old Computer
[*]Minigolf - Garden: Hole 1 Stuck in Tube
[*]Minigolf - Garden: Hole 13 Stuck in Tube + HIO Guarantee
[*]Minigolf - Garden: Stuck in Plinko
[*]Fixed spacing between name and ping text on player name tags
[*]Fixed a hole in the collision in the Laser Tag waiting room
[*]Fixed stair item UI not remembering width properly
[*]Virus - Desertion: Ceiling inside Temple no longer dev texture
[*]Virus - Desertion: Previous kill volume above level is now just a blocking volume, to make the Sonic Shotgun less powerful outside
[*]Fixed a bug where the Beach Ball (or the new Basket Ball) could fall through the ground and be lost until you restart the Condo. Now it respawns the physics items at the spawn point
[*]Fixed Beach Ball and pets clipping through the item store stand when being viewed
[*]Fixed the store checkout button only allowing you to check out with 29 items in the cart instead of 30
[*]Fixed red flowers in the plaza planters having collision when they shouldn’t
[*]Fixed bug where if you drag an item and then click a non-item, it will close the inventory menu even if you have Q held
[*]Fixed a bug where if you drag an item, you will not be able to highlight or drag another item
[*]Fixed a bug where if you clicked on something that is not an item it would close the inventory menu even if you have Q held
[*]Fixed a bug where the crosshair would display while you are dragging items
[*]Fixed Theater ceiling and wall collisions
[*]Fixed a bug where releasing the Q key would sometimes not close the inventory[/list]

You can follow our current developments on our Trello:
[url=https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap[/url]

notes.title: Update 0.1.1.3
notes.content:
Today we're releasing new maps for Ballrace, Minigolf, and Virus as well as many improvements to our game.

[b]3 New Maps![/b][list]
[*]New Ballrace Map: GLXY
[*]New Minigolf Map: Alpine
[*]New Virus Map: Overtime[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11783817/5816134805557c5000949a0125c2fed5f244565e.png[/img]

[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Steam Cloud support added for Condos. Your condo data will now save on Steam Cloud
[*]More optimizations made to the Plaza Map, tests show up to 20 fps for some users in many areas of the map. This will be more noticeable for those with older PCs, less on newer. Optimizations will continue to be made in future updates
[*]Linux P2P Condo to Lobby connections now work!
[*]Store transactions have been improved and are now way faster
[*]Added local chat (so you can stay connected to P2P, but talk to just your Condo). Just press tab while typing to switch channels
[*]Fireworks are now finished!
[*]Trampolines now bounce players in the direction they face
[*]Hid media screen info after 5 seconds of starting or last Q pressed time
[*]You can now toggle off HUD key prompts in Settings > Gameplay
[*]Dynamic media lights are disabled by default now and can be toggled on in Settings > Graphics > Media
[*]You can open the fridge now
[*]Removed the Fridge and Toilet from the Condo as you should use the items instead
[*]You can now press R to reset rotations on the item you are dragging[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Fixed dragging items having terrible rotations on the walls
[*]Fixed pause menu and Condo menus quickly closing with low FPS
[*]Fixed Minigolf trails not always working
[*]Fixed Minigolf not correctly scoring late joining players
[*]Fixed seats not ejecting players to the correct position; often falling through the ground
[*]Fixed the computer screen being upside down
[*]Fixed small openings on the Condo doorways
[*]Fixed being able to move wearables in Inventory
[*]Fixed chat CTRL+A and arrow keys not always working properly
[*]Fixed theater display turning off when you hit the ceiling
[*]Fixed items in store cart not being previewable[/list]

[b]Update for dedicated server owners:[/b]
We’ve made a few improvements to allow multiple servers on one machine:[list]
[*]Fixed '-Port=7778' command-line flag not working as intended
[*]Custom TowerServer.ini files can be specified via the command-line with 'TowerServerINI=Custom.ini'
[*]Hosting a dedicated server on the same machine as the game client is possible with the '-nosteamclient' flag[/list]

Read the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=662378924]Lobby Dedicated Server Setup guide[/url] for up-to-date documentation.

[b]You can follow our current developments on our Trello:[/b]
[url]https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap[/url]

notes.title: Update 0.1.1.2
notes.content:
[b]Attention Dedicated Server Owners![/b]
We made adjustments to where the server configuration files are stored in this update. We have moved all the settings from Game.ini to TowerServer.ini. You'll need to move your server title and player count to the new file or your server title will not work. The [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=662378924]dedicated server guide[/url] has been updated to reflect these changes.

[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Added chatting icon when a player is currently typing a message in the chat box
[*]Reduced chat message size, so more can fit
[*]You can click on player names in the chat box now
[*]Admins can now ban players from P2P chat messages
[*]Players who are banned are now banned from all P2P chat messages
[*]You can now view profiles of players who sent P2P chat messages the same way as everyone else
[*]Server bans now refresh automatically every 5 minutes
[*]Lobby servers are now sorted by player count
[*]Renamed Single Use tag to Single Spawn to clarify its meaning more
[*]Pets now teleport to their owners when they are far from their owners
[*]Right click now cancels current item being dragged to avoid mistake dragging
[*]Added some minor UI feedback for slots[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Notebook text limit reduced to 500 characters to prevent disconnect issue (won't delete existing data)
[*]Fixed a bug where the ghost inventory item would collide with the item you are moving
[*]Fixed a bug with chat where you couldn't close the chat if the message was blank
[*]Fixed mic icon for when a player is voice chatting not appearing
[*]Fixed chat input not allowing CTRL+A
[*]Fixed chat input not allowing caret select
[*]Fixed character feet clipping through the ground while you are standing still
[*]Fixed weapons flickering
[*]Fixed hats not casting shadows in first person
[*]Fixed mute button not updating the mic icon
[*]Fixed scrolling in the chat toggling third person and first person
[*]Fixed collision issues with pets
[*]Fixed flashlight not moving while in thirdperson
[*]Fixed not being able to close the Condo management menu by pressing C again
[*]Fixed Condo cliff collisions
[*]Fixed drag icons not being centered while dragging[/list]

[b]What we’re actively working on:[/b][list]
[*]Memory leaks
[*]Linux dedicated Lobby servers crashing
[*]Condo / Lobby door connections
[*]Casino
[*]Theater vote skip
[*]Key binding
[*]Virus weapons sometimes appear out of the hands of other players[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.1.1.0
notes.content:
We're happy to release 0.1.1.0 for you all!

[b]Indiegogo Backer Digital Items[/b]
This update includes the digital backer items for our Indiegogo backers. If you have linked your Steam Account to the backer panel, you'll receive your digital items directly after the splash screens in-game. We are still working on custom backer rewards and you can follow progress on our Trello.

[b]Condo To Lobby Link (Peer 2 Peer)[/b]
We've been ramping up development on the Condo peer 2 peer system. This system powers the condo lobby doors and connects all condo chat with corresponding lobby chat. We've gotten the groundwork done and it works pretty well on Windows dedicated servers. However, it does not currently function on Linux dedicated servers. We're actively looking into this issue and we hope to further development of this powerful feature.

[b]GMT to Tower Unite Transfer[/b]
The GMT to Tower Unite transfer system is ready for your use. You can perform the transfer in-game or out of game (through [url]http://www.gmtower.org[/url]). The transfer is an opt-in feature for our most dedicated GMod Tower players. Transferring will not erase your Tower Unite progress.

To those who have lost their condo at some point, we are sorry to say that we cannot bring them back for this transfer. We also have noticed certain items missing that we also cannot bring back for this transfer. Plates and VIP Baskets will be given out at a later date and are unrelated to this transfer program.

notes.content:
We're happy to release 0.1.1.0 for you all!

[b]Indiegogo Backer Digital Items[/b]
This update includes the digital backer items for our Indiegogo backers. If you have linked your Steam Account to the backer panel, you'll receive your digital items directly after the splash screens in-game. We are still working on custom backer rewards and you can follow progress on our Trello.

[b]Condo To Lobby Link (Peer 2 Peer)[/b]
We've been ramping up development on the Condo peer 2 peer system. This system powers the condo lobby doors and connects all condo chat with corresponding lobby chat. We've gotten the groundwork done and it works pretty well on Windows dedicated servers. However, it does not currently function on Linux dedicated servers. We're actively looking into this issue and we hope to further development of this powerful feature.

[b]GMT to Tower Unite Transfer[/b]
The GMT to Tower Unite transfer system is ready for your use. You can perform the transfer in-game or out of game (through [url]http://www.gmtower.org[/url]). The transfer is an opt-in feature for our most dedicated GMod Tower players. Transferring will not erase your Tower Unite progress.

To those who have lost their condo at some point, we are sorry to say that we cannot bring them back for this transfer. We also have noticed certain items missing that we also cannot bring back for this transfer. Plates and VIP Baskets will be given out at a later date and are unrelated to this transfer program.

notes.title: A Quick Status Update
notes.content:
Greetings Tower Inhabitants,

We want to thank everyone for being patient as we work hard to bring you the quality Tower you deserve.
Your support keeps us motivated and helps us make Tower Unite better every day.

We have a few announcements today:

[h1]Tower Economy:[/h1]
A couple updates back, we found some exploits in our economy systems.
Players who were aware of these exploits could cause these systems to pay them more Units than anyone else.

The last thing we want for our game is to have honest players feel inferior to players who had cheated.
We want to make an experience that is fun for everybody.

In response to these attacks we have reset the inventory and Unit counts of players who were caught cheating.

Future attacks against our systems will be met with more severe countermeasures.
We’re very concerned about the integrity of our game and we won’t tolerate people who try to mess with that.

This delayed Tower Unite development for several days.

[h1]New End-User License Agreement:[/h1]
After poring over many legal documents and rules we have constructed a much more accurate and informative EULA.

This new EULA will help cover some of the grey areas regarding how we operate and how the Tower Unite product is to be used.

We have designed this EULA with our community in mind, it allows us to make decisions and changes that benefit our community.

You can read the EULA here: [url]http://store.steampowered.com/eula/394690_eula_1[/url]

By continuing to play Tower Unite, you agree to the new updated terms of this agreement.

[h1]Casino:[/h1]
Work has begun on the Tower Unite Casino!
We've started designing/programming the backend systems and our artists have been creating really neat looking new Casino assets, such as new slots and a blackjack table. We're really excited about the Casino and hope to get it out in several phases over April and May. You can follow our progress on our trello: [url]https://trello.com/c/3Kd7gd9o/101-casino-phase-1-april-may-2016[/url]. We'll be posting some screenshots there as well.

[h1]GMT To Tower Unite Transfers:[/h1]
GMod Tower players: we've been getting a lot of the major aspects for the transfers developed. We've still got a few things to sort out and test before releasing the transfer system. The transfer will be done through the gmtower.org website and will require you to log into the same account you used while playing GMod Tower.

We hope to roll this out soon, so stay posted.

[h1]Unreal Engine 4.11:[/h1]
Programmers have been focused on migrating to our Unreal Engine version to 4.11. The switch over may increase performance with the game, but it also could not. 4.11 boasts some pretty neat features that may improve our game overall.

Thanks again for all of your support.
- PixelTail Games

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.8
notes.content:
[b]Fixes:[/b][list]
[*]Fixed various Unit exploits
[*]Fixed FOV and mouse sensitivity resetting to defaults when you join a game
[*]Fixed sectional couches being way too large
[*]Fixed sell prompt showing up for appearance items that were not unlocked
[*]Fixed Minigolf customize window being cut off at the bottom
[*]Fixed colorable items not networking properly the colors to condo visitors
[*]Fixed a payout exploit in Virus
[*]Fixed "Winning Team" payout in Virus showing up multiple times
[*]Fixed neon bar being brighter than the sun at certain angles
[*]Improved lamp brightnesses on certain lamps (mainly outdoor ones)
[*]Fixed outdoor wood lamp not respecting its lamp color properly
[*]Fixed color UI picker (for colorables) not initially setting the RGB values
[*]Fixed Ball Race camera issues where the camera will still not exit out of cinematic mode properly[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b][list]
[*]Reworked every level of Nimbus to be easier and fair
[*]You can only see the hats you own in the Minigolf customize menu  to avoid confusion and simply the selections
[*]Added mouse invert option
[*]Improved Virus payouts for infected players
[*]Added new Virus payout: Biohazard (per infection bonus) and Bringer Of Death (bonus for infecting the last survivor)
[*]Nighttime is a lot prettier
[*]Improved nighttime performance in Lobby
[*]You can sit in sectional couches now
[*]Added Victorian Couch Chair (Sweet Suite's Furnishings)
[*]In Virus, when the last infected leaves mid-round - the game infects another random player to keep the game going
[*]"Manage Condo" hud prompt no longer shows up to players who are not the owner of the Condo
[*]Plushies are now interactable and colorable
[*]Added Condo locations, so you know where your friends are at
[*]Added more roof textures to Condo editor
[*]More of the condo can be colorable/wallpaper edited[/list]

[b]What we’re actively working on:[/b][list]
[*]Memory leaks
[*]Linux dedicated Lobby servers crashing
[*]Condo / Lobby door connections
[*]Casino
[*]Theater vote skip
[*]Key binding (requires 4.11)
[*]Server sorting
[*]Virus weapons sometimes appear out of the hands of other players
[*]Not being able to shoot in some areas (mainly doorways) in Virus
[*]Placing canvases (and other items) on walls does not work properly and rotates around like crazy[/list]

Just a heads up, we're migrating to Unreal 4.11 this week, so patches may be slower.
You can track our progress with future updates on our Trello: https://trello.com/b/6BwRMiPw/tower-unite-roadmap

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.5
notes.content:
This update continues our focus on further stabilizing the game and improving player experience.

Fixes:
- Fixed not being able to interact with stuff while in third person
- Fixed voice being disabled during Minigolf waiting phase
- Fixed Minigolf ball colors being wrong upon first spawn
- Possible “Waiting for host” improvement. Valve helped us out with this one.
- “Waiting for host” timeout no longer kicks the player to the main menu
- Possible fix for fatal error crash related to Lobby queue boards
- Fixed Planet Panic timer being weird (ex. displaying 1:3 instead of 01:03)
- Minigolf pocket music jingles can now be turned down just like all other music
- Fixed Planet Panic HUD reporting the wrong team, pickup amount, or health
- Fixed flashlight not being deleted upon death

Changes:
- Added mouse settings: sensitivity (does not save yet)
- Players can now continue playing in the Lobby while the “Waiting for host” UI is displayed
- Connecting to hosts through Lobby queues can now be cancelled
- Added admin global voice muting (server mute in moderation panel)
- Disallowed duplicate media requests in the theater/condo
- Sorted player names in the Lobby scoreboard
- Optimized the Condo
- Increased chatbox size
- Increased duration of chat message visibility
- Added higher quality map preview images
- Made the unfinished tag on items more noticeable
- Changed "purchase" to "unlock" to make it clear these are in-game unlocks only
- Turned up 3D voice volume

What we’re actively working on:
- Memory leaks
- Some game settings don’t save
- Linux dedicated Lobby servers crashing
- Condo / Lobby door connections
- Virus weapons sometimes appear out of the hands of other players
- Ball Race overview camera does not disable on the first level sometimes
- Theater vote skip
- Key binding

Notes:
Key binding is still in progress, but will require us to upgrade our Unreal Engine version to 4.11.
This upgrade will take us a bit of time. We understand how important this is and we are working quickly to get it finished and in your hands.

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.4
notes.content:
We’re shipping out a small update with a few important fixes. Dedicated servers will need to be updated.

Fixes:
- Resolved issues where "Waiting for hosts" loading screen would never connect
- Fixed region issues with server browsing; more servers will appear in each game world’s server browser and condos
- Improved nighttime performance in the Lobby
- Fixed refreshing servers causing a slight hitch
- Fixed players getting stuck sitting down on Lobby benches

What we’re actively working on:
- Mouse settings: sensitivity, inverted (almost there)
- Key binding
- Some settings don’t save
- Linux dedicated Lobby servers crashing
- Admin global player voice muting (almost there)
- Voice chat during waiting for players does not work in Minigolf and Ball Race (this is due to some incompatibility issues and will be addressed soon)
- Condo / Lobby door connections
- Virus weapons sometimes appear out of the hands of other players
- Ball Race overview camera does not disable on the first level sometimes

----

[h1]We are getting reports that "Waiting for hosts" is still happening. We have contacted Valve about the issue and we're awaiting their response. The issue crops up during peak hours.[/h1]

notes.title: Update 0.1.0.3
notes.content:
In this update, we’ve focused on continuing fixing bugs and improving the Lobby experience.

Fixes:
- Fixed issue with servers refreshing forever after attempting to return to a server
- Fixed end game "return to lobby" state not returning to the main menu instantly when needed
- Fixed Virus Hospital map exploit where survivors couldn’t get infected due to seats and other objects
- Fixed canvas Condo item not displaying the saved material on load
- Fixed votemap screen logo being always Ball Race
- Fixed Planet Panic votemap not displaying any maps
- Fixed Virus Sonic Shotgun air blast sound playing as a 2D sound
- Fixed Lobby and Condo tutorials popping up with nothing (we just disabled them for now)
- Fixed Condo saving consumable items (soda, drinks, fireworks, etc.)
- Fixed Condo not triggering a save when stashing an item
- Fixed possible “Connection Lost” after immediately rejoining a server
- Fixed camera not following the ragdoll upon death
- Fixed being able to sell or stash wearables or equippables in the world
- Mostly fixed the Minigolf overview (per hole) camera not always working

Changes:
- Added voice settings: disable voice, voice receive volume
- Added 3D positional voice chat when in the Lobby or Condo
- Added media volume setting
- Added kick/ban message dialog when returned to the menu
- Added friends list back to the menu
- Added server title to the Lobby scoreboard
- Limited Media player requests to 10 minutes for the Theater and non-Condo hosts

What we’re actively working on:
- Mouse settings: sensitivity, inverted (almost there)
- Key binding
- Some settings don’t save
- Linux dedicated Lobby servers crashing
- Admin global player voice muting (almost there)
- Voice chat during waiting for players does not work in Minigolf and Ball Race (this is due to some incompatibility issues and will be addressed soon)
- Condo / Lobby door connections
- Virus weapons sometimes appear out of the hands of other players
- Ball Race overview camera does not disable on the first level sometimes

notes.title: Post-release Update 0.1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we know that the initial release has been shaky. We wanted to let you know that we’re heavily focused on fixing crashes with the game and server. An update has been pushed out with this announcement, make sure to update your dedicated servers. Here’s what we’ve been up to since release:

Recent fixes:
- Removed friends list on menu to fix frequent game stuttering
- Fixed Linux Lobby server crash when players queue into a game world
- Fixed Minigolf customization UI (C button) not working in some cases
- Fixed early access notice button getting cut off at the bottom of the screen
- Fixed player customization options not appearing on Linux dedicated Lobby servers

Other minor changes:
- Changed Refresh server button color to place more attention on the Create server button
- Fixed RC car/boats being spawned in the air

What we’re actively working on:
- Lobby servers reporting the server is full when it isn’t
- “Your connection to the host has been lost.” message when attempting to join a Lobby server
- Mouse sensitivity, mouse invert options
- Key binding
- Waiting for confirmation on resolution set
- Virus weapons sometimes are invisible on first spawn

Thanks for supporting us and hopefully we can meet everyone’s expectations soon.
